title: HR Intern
description:
About BAT MASTER

BAT MASTER is a growing sports manufacturing and branding company based in Meerut, India's sports goods manufacturing hub. We manufacture and supply cricket bats, leather cricket balls, tennis balls, bat covers, bat stickers, cricket shoes, cricket accessories, badminton products, and provide private label (OEM) manufacturing for sports brands across India.

As we expand rapidly, we are looking for an enthusiastic HR Intern who is excited to build HR systems from the ground up—not just recruit people.

Internship Objective

This internship is designed for candidates who want to understand how HR contributes to business growth.

You will learn the complete sports manufacturing ecosystem while helping create professional HR systems, recruitment processes, company policies, training manuals, and documentation that will support BAT MASTER's future expansion.

Key ResponsibilitiesHR Policies \& Systems

* Design HR policies and employee handbook.
* Create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Develop onboarding and induction processes.
* Prepare HR forms, templates, and checklists.
* Design performance evaluation systems.
* Develop attendance and leave policies.
* Assist in creating organizational structure and HR workflows.

Product Knowledge \& Manuals

* Learn BAT MASTER's complete product portfolio.
* Understand manufacturing processes and product specifications.
* Prepare Product Manuals for employees and sales teams.
* Create knowledge documents for cricket products and accessories.
* Document branding, OEM, and private\-label processes.

Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Source candidates through Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri, and other job portals.
* Screen resumes and schedule interviews.
* Coordinate with department heads.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and HR MIS.
* Assist in onboarding new employees.

Sports Industry Research

Study and document the sports ecosystem, including:

* Cricket equipment manufacturing
* Sports retail market
* Dealers and distributors
* Cricket academies
* Sports brands and competitors
* Private\-label manufacturing
* Market trends and customer expectations

Prepare research reports that support business decisions.

Documentation \& Process Improvement

* Create process documents.
* Develop training presentations.
* Maintain HR documentation.
* Recommend improvements in HR and operational systems.

Skills Required

* Excellent written and spoken English
* Strong research and analytical skills
* Documentation and report writing
* MS Excel, Word \& PowerPoint
* Google Workspace
* Attention to detail
* Ability to learn quickly
* Good communication skills
* Interest in HR and business systems

Preferred Qualifications

* MBA (HR) pursuing or completed
* BBA / B.Com / BA with HR specialization
* Freshers are encouraged to apply
* Passion for sports or manufacturing is an added advantage

What You Will Learn

* HR Policy Development
* SOP Creation
* Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
* HR Documentation
* Organizational Development
* Performance Management Systems
* Sports Goods Manufacturing Industry
* Product Knowledge Management
* Business Process Design
* Leadership \& Communication

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who enjoys:

* Building systems from scratch
* Researching industries and competitors
* Writing manuals and policies
* Solving organizational challenges
* Learning how a manufacturing business operates
* Working in a fast\-growing startup environment

Career Growth

Successful interns may receive:

* Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO)
* Full\-Time HR Executive Role
* HR Business Partner Opportunity
* Performance\-Based Salary Increments
* Leadership Opportunities

How to Apply

Submit your updated resume along with a brief note (100–150 words) explaining:

**"Why do you want to build HR systems for a sports manufacturing company instead of only working in recruitment?"**

**BAT MASTER**  
**Manufacturing \| Branding \| OEM \| Private Label \| Sports Innovation**

*"Join us to build the HR foundation of one of India's emerging sports brands."*

description:
**Intern: Procurement \& Resource Development**

**Place of Posting: Purnea, BIhar**

**About Company:**

AgroKisan, a brand owned by Krishi Samriddhi Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an innovative Agritech startups, leveraging cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize agriculture in India. AgroKisan focus on precision farming, agriculture value chain, and sustainable solutions for efficiency and resilience in agricultural sector. With a commitment to modernizing practices, AgroKisan play a vital role in shaping a more sustainable and productive future for Indian Agriculture Ecosystem. We are supported by Govt. of Bihar and incubated under Indian Institute of Technology, Patna.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Intern to join our Agribusiness team. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in various aspects of agricultural industry. This role offers exposure to a fast\-paced and innovative environment where you will work closely with our sales and marketing professionals to support our business objectives.

**Role Overview**

The Intern – Procurement (Agri Commodity) \& Resource Development will be responsible for sourcing agricultural commodities, managing field\-level procurement operations, and developing a strong network of farmers, FPOs, vendors, and field resources. The role ensures high\-quality, cost\-effective procurement while building sustainable relationships across the agriculture value chain. It also involves developing and training field partners, enabling efficient supply aggregation, and strengthening resource planning for ongoing agritech operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Agri Commodity Procurement**

* Identify and onboard farmers, FPOs/FPCs, aggregators, and traders for commodity sourcing.
* Conduct market research to track commodity prices, demand patterns, and seasonal availability.
* Negotiate procurement terms, quality parameters, and logistics with suppliers.
* Ensure timely procurement of commodities such as fruits, vegetables, grains, spices, pulses, or any crop aligned with company operations.
* Coordinate quality checks during procurement and ensure adherence to grading and standard specifications.
* Support contract farming or buy\-back arrangements with growers where applicable.

**2\. Field Resource Development \& Network Expansion**

* Develop a robust field network including farmers, FPOs, community leaders, agri\-input dealers, and rural micro\-entrepreneurs.
* Train and support field partners on procurement processes, quality parameters, and digital reporting tools.
* Conduct field visits to assess crop readiness, farmer engagement, and resource availability.
* Build a database of field resources to support sourcing, aggregation, and logistics operations.
* Identify new sourcing clusters and build market linkages in potential agri\-growing regions.

**3\. Supply Chain \& Operational Support**

* Coordinate logistics, transportation, and last\-mile pickup from sourcing locations to warehouses or processing centers.
* Work closely with operations and quality teams to ensure a seamless procurement\-to\-delivery pipeline.
* Assist in planning procurement volumes based on demand forecasts and operational needs.
* Ensure minimal wastage, efficient handling, and cost\-effective aggregation.

**4\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Relationship Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with suppliers, farmers, FPO leaders, and local market stakeholders.
* Conduct periodic supplier evaluations based on quality, reliability, and pricing.
* Resolve field\-level issues related to quality disputes, procurement delays, or logistics challenges.
* Collaborate with government agencies, NGOs, or agri institutions for field\-level resource development.

**5\. Resource Planning, Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain updated records of procurement volumes, sourcing locations, farmer databases, vendor details, and field activities.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly reports on procurement performance, price trends, and field resource development.
* Ensure documentation compliance including purchase orders, agreements, receipts, and quality reports.
* Use digital tools or ERP systems to log procurement and field data accurately.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s/Master degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Supply Chain, or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Agribusiness or Rural Management preferred.

**Work Experience**

* Freshers can also apply
* Prior experience in agri commodity procurement, field sourcing, supply chain, or rural operations will be prefered.
* Experience working with farmers, FPOs, mandi operations, rural networks, or agritech companies is highly desirable.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong understanding of agri commodities, market dynamics, crop cycles, and quality standards.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and vendor management skills.
* Ability to build rapport with farmers and rural stakeholders.
* Knowledge of mandi operations, auction systems, and procurement compliance.
* Good analytical and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, procurement tools, and mobile\-based field reporting apps.
* Willingness to travel extensively to sourcing clusters.

**Key Personal Attributes**

* Field\-focused attitude with problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong interpersonal skills with empathy toward farmers and rural communities.
* Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently.
* Ability to handle pressure and dynamic procurement requirements.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work at the intersection of agriculture, technology, and supply chain innovation.
* Hands\-on exposure to emerging agritech business models.
* Career growth in procurement, rural operations, and supplier development.
* Direct impact on farmer livelihoods and sustainable sourcing.

Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL") is a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited. ABFL is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABFL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Dec’20, ABFL has a pan\-India presence with 91 branches and a lending book of Rs. 45,560 Crores.  

ABFL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The Small ticket segment comprises primarily Digitally sourced accounts with ticket sizes ranging 10k – 5 lacs. This role is responsible for enhancing business profitability through effective management of the delinquent portfolio in the respective zone.

**Location:** 100% Remote

**Experience:** Minimum 2 Years of experience in Recruitment

**Talent Sourcing Specialist (Apprentice)**

**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


We are currently seeking fresh Graduates to join the Talent Acquisition team as Apprentice for duration of 12 months.


This role forms part of the Talent Acquisition team and will have responsibility for driving excellence in the Sourcing function. The role will work closely with the HR and business leaders across the organisation and be an advocate/champion for TA.

**PRIMARY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Delivery of Sourcing ‘assignments’ which could include supporting Executive Search, talent mapping/pooling, succession planning or open roles
* Proactively sourcing, screening and talent pooling for candidates through various channels including internal databases, LinkedIn and other external job boards and open web searching
* Develop and execute against Sourcing plans for specific assignments
* Contribute to the ongoing evolvement of HSBC’s proactive Sourcing capability and effectiveness
* Staying connected with and tracking market trends, competitor analysis and regional changes that are relevant to our business stakeholders
* Designing and implementing bespoke recruitment campaigns for key recruitment drives
* Working in partnership with Resourcing Specialists and working closely with hiring managers from the outset – from market research, job briefs through to interviews and offer management
* Ensure that the EVP for your assignments is defined and will have impact
* Ensure that the EVP for your assignments is defined and will have impact
* Ensure the metrics set against deliverables is met
* Provide input to the TA Leadership Team on key components of the function
* Ensure HSBC fully leverages its CRM tools, resources and tactics to engage talent

**Qualifications \- External**

* Graduation / Post\-Graduation (Bachelor’s degree holder of an UGC recognised University and must possess mark sheets and provisional / Degree certificate of passing)
* Only Fresh Graduates within 0\-5 years of completing their Bachelor’s degree can apply
* Candidate should not have done any Govt. regulated Apprenticeship in past
* Basic knowledge of full cycle recruiting and Sourcing
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and facilitation skills
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and critical thinking
* Professional and strong presentation skills to senior level stakeholders
* Culturally diverse and aware and able to work with people of different backgrounds and languages

**Additional Information**

* The tenure of the Apprentice will be 1 (one) year as defined under Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992 amended from time to time.
* All Apprentices engaged by the Bank will also be featured in NATS portal as an ‘Apprentice’. By virtue of them being covered under the provisions of the Act, a candidate profile will be created for each apprentice in the NATS portal, which will be available to them for viewing.
* On completion of the one\-year Apprenticeship tenure, a Certificate of Proficiency will be issued to the apprentice by the Govt. of India, as applicable under the Act and the enrollment under the Apprenticeship Act will cease.
* All other clauses regarding the tenure of engagement as an Apprentice with HSBC will stand as mentioned in the offer letter issued by the Bank at the time of joining.


Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.


You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:
Overview:

For more information, please visit:* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud*

  

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than **5,500\+ employees** and **\~30,000 customers** worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.


Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.


Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

*Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection.*

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**


Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.


Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

**About this role:**


This is predominantly a leadership role within the Learning \& Organizational Development (L\&OD) function. We are looking for a seasoned professional who combines sharp strategic thinking with strong execution capability — someone who can design, drive, and scale impactful learning and organizational development initiatives while also partnering closely with business leaders to build capability and culture.

  


In This Role, You Will::
### **1\. Strategic Learning Delivery \& Business Impact**

* Lead the design and execution of the Open Enrollment Learning Calendar, Management Development programs, and enterprise L\&OD initiatives aligned to business strategy.
* Partner with business leaders to identify capability gaps and build targeted learning journeys for emerging and senior leaders.
* Deliver high\-impact facilitation sessions (20–30 hours/month) across virtual, in\-person, and hybrid formats.
* Apply measurement frameworks such as Kirkpatrick (Levels 1–4\) to evaluate effectiveness, impact, and ROI of learning programs.

### **2\. Instruction Design \& AI\-Enabled Learning**

* Design learner\-centric solutions using ADDIE, Bloom’s Taxonomy, and adult learning principles.
* Build structured learning journeys, microlearning, and blended programs incorporating experiential methodologies (case studies, simulations, real\-world problem solving).
* **Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Azure AI, Synthesia, Glean, etc.) to design, personalize, and scale learning experiences — AI fluency is a critical requirement for this role.**
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled learning solutions to enhance efficiency, learner engagement, and content effectiveness.
* Ensure seamless integration of content within LMS platforms.

### **3\. Talent Development \& Succession Enablement**

* Partner in talent review cycles to identify high\-potential talent and critical skill gaps.
* Design and implement individualized and cohort\-based development plans aligned with succession pipelines and leadership capability building.
* Aligning learning strategies with career frameworks and long\-term organizational capability needs.

### **4\. Strategic Learning Projects**

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of large\-scale training and capability\-building initiatives (leadership development, functional academies, enterprise interventions).
* Define project scope, timelines, success metrics, and governance.
* Manage cross\-functional stakeholders and external vendors to ensure high\-quality delivery within timelines and budgets.
* Track risks, monitor outcomes, and present insights to senior leadership.

### **5\. Organizational Development \& Business Partnership**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on organization effectiveness, capability building, and culture transformation.
* Diagnose organizational needs and recommend targeted OD interventions including team effectiveness, leadership alignment, and change initiatives.

### **6\. Leadership \& Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of L\&OD professionals, building strong capability in facilitation, instructional design, and consulting skills.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Enable team members to effectively leverage digital and AI tools in learning design and delivery.

### **7\. Learning Analytics \& Insights**

* Track, analyze, and interpret learning data (participation, engagement, effectiveness, business impact).
* Build dashboards and executive reports on talent readiness and capability outcomes.
* Use data\-driven insights to continuously refine learning strategies and interventions.


Here's What You Need::
* **Education**:
* + MBA in HR / Master’s in Organizational Psychology or related field (preferred)
* **Experience**:
* + 15\+ years of experience in Learning \& Development, Talent Development, or Organizational Development
	+ Proven experience leading large\-scale, cross\-functional L\&OD initiatives
* **Core Expertise**:
* + Strong instructional design expertise (ADDIE, Bloom’s Taxonomy, adult learning principles)
	+ Deep experience in leadership development and capability building
	+ Strong facilitation and executive presence
* **AI \& Digital Capability (Critical Requirement)**:
* + **Hands\-on experience with AI\-powered tools (e.g., Copilot, Azure AI, Glean, Synthesia, etc.) in learning design, content creation, and personalization**
	+ **Ability to integrate AI into learning strategy, delivery, and analytics**
	+ Strong digital fluency with LMS platforms and learning technologies
* **Technical \& Analytical Skills**:
* + Expertise in LMS platforms (Docebo or similar)
	+ Advanced MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and data visualization tools
	+ Knowledge of Kirkpatrick Model and learning ROI measurement
	+ Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capability
* **Leadership \& Consulting Skills**:
* + Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills with senior leadership
	+ Ability to operate as both strategic advisor and execution leader
	+ Experience managing and developing high\-performing teams
* **Certifications (Preferred)**:
* + Instructional Design, Facilitation certifications
	+ Assessments/tools such as MBTI, Harrison, Situational Leadership II
* **Other Requirements**:
* + Comfortable working in global environments (including periodic East Coast shift alignment)

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, manage a field service team to deliver excellent technical support while growing service business. You'll manage a team of Field Service Engineers (FSEs) providing installation, maintenance, repairs, and customer support for sophisticated analytical and scientific instruments. This role combines technical leadership, people management, and strategic business development to ensure excellent customer experiences and meet organizational goals.  

  

Help advance scientific service delivery by implementing effective solutions, optimizing team performance, and building strong customer relationships. * **Conflict Management:** Skilled at handling difficult customer situations and critical technical escalations with a "soft\-spoken" yet firm professional demeanour.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to balance immediate technical fixes with long\-term business objectives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** **10\+ years** of total working experience.
	+ Minimum **5 years** in Customer Service Management.
	+ **3\+ years** in a direct supervisory/leadership role managing technical teams.
* **Technical Hands\-on:** Experience on Analytical instruments and Direct experience with **XRF/OES/Process analyzers analytical instruments** is additional advantage.
* **Language:** Proficiency in English; multilingual skills are a plus depending on the specific region.

description:
**ADP** is hiring a **Lead Product Manager**


* Are you passionate about building products that solve real customer problems?
* Do you thrive at the intersection of business, technology, and customer experience?
* Are you excited about driving product strategy and delivering measurable business outcomes?

**Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?**


In this role, you will own and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of marketplace for one of ADP’s HCM offerings. You will work cross\-functionally with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, validate solutions, and deliver products that create value for our clients and business.


No two days are the same. You may spend one day analyzing customer insights and market trends, another prioritizing features with engineering teams, and the next aligning stakeholders on product direction. From product discovery through launch and optimization, you'll play a key role in creating solutions that improve customer outcomes and support business growth.


To thrive in this role, you'll need a strong foundation in product management, customer\-centric thinking, and data\-driven decision\-making. You'll bring experience defining product strategies, managing roadmaps, and influencing cross\-functional teams. Our most successful Product Managers are curious, adaptable, analytical, and passionate about solving customer challenges through technology.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**


**Product Strategy \& Vision**


* Define and execute product strategy aligned with business goals and customer needs.
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery activities.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and business growth.
* Build and maintain a product roadmap based on customer value and business priorities.

**Product Development \& Execution**


* Gather, analyze, and prioritize product requirements; create specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Collaborate with Engineering and Design throughout the development lifecycle
* Leverage available tools to drive AI adoption into the product development lifecycle

**Customer \& Market Focus**


* Engage with customers to understand their pain points and requirements.
* Analyze customer feedback, usage metrics, and industry trends.
* Translate customer insights into impactful product features and enhancements.
* Ensure product decisions are data\-driven and aligned with market needs.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner with Engineering, Operations, and go\-to\-market teams
* Communicate product vision, priorities, and progress to stakeholders
* Influence and drive alignment across teams

**Product Performance Management**


* Define and track key product metrics (adoption, engagement, satisfaction, business outcomes)
* Conduct post\-launch analysis and recommend improvements
* Drive continuous optimization based on performance insights

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:**


* You'll have a bachelor's degree OR equivalent.
* 7\-10 years of experience in Product Management or related roles with a proven track record of delivering successful products.
* Experience and understanding of marketplace platforms, APIs and integrations.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, and roadmap planning.
* Experience translating customer needs and business goals into scalable product solutions.
* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Preferred: Experience in SaaS, cloud\-based platforms, enterprise software, FinTech, or HCM technology solutions.
* Preferred: Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner, or Pragmatic Product Management.

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**


* **Collaborate.** Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
* **Deliver at epic scale.** We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
* **Be surrounded by curious learners.** We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
* **Act like an owner \& doer.** Mission\-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems.
* **Give back to others.** Support our associates, clients, and communities through meaningful philanthropic initiatives.
* **Join a company committed to equality and equity.** Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

**What are you waiting for? Apply today!**

description:
### **Product Manager**


* JR\-162158
* Hybrid
* Bengaluru
* Technology Enablement
* Full time

**Who are we?**



Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

  


A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.



A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
**Job Summary**



We're building HR and Legal data products that power workforce planning, talent strategy, compliance, and risk management across the enterprise. These products unify data from core systems (HRIS/HCM, ATS, contract lifecycle, and compliance tooling) and are delivered through a unified enterprise analytics and intelligence platform—a trusted single source of reference that exposes insight through APIs, semantic models, dashboards, and conversational and agentic AI experiences.



As Product Manager, you'll help drive the data \& analytics product strategy and roadmap for our Corporate Functions (HR and Legal). You'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand their strategic priorities, operating rhythms (talent review cycles, workforce planning cadence, compliance calendars, contract renewals), and pain points—fragmented data, manual reporting, limited scenario planning, and governance gaps—and translate them into high\-impact, AI\-enabled data products that increase insight precision, automate reporting, and elevate HR and Legal as strategic advisors to the business.



**Responsibilities**


* Partner \& advise: Build trusted relationships with HR and Legal stakeholders by understanding their objectives, operating cadence, and core processes; translate pain points (attrition risk, headcount reconciliation, skills and talent gaps, DEI reporting, contract bottlenecks, compliance governance) into data product solutions. Manage stakeholder expectations within and across functions
* Shape strategy \& roadmap: Support development of the product strategy and an ROI\-informed roadmap, balancing quick\-win delivery with foundational platform efforts
* Build data products: Contribute to function\-grade semantic models (employee, talent, headcount, contract, compliance) that integrate with the enterprise platform, its model store, and query APIs. Help productize analytics and AI/ML services—workforce forecasting, talent dashboards, compliance reporting packs, conversational insights, governance\-enabled data catalogs—while upholding platform principles: system of reference (not system of record), domain data ownership, and full lineage, provenance, and auditability
* Analyze the market: Research industry practices, competitors, and verticals; report on emerging HR and Legal analytics and AI trends (predictive attrition modeling, skills intelligence, contract analytics, compliance automation). Introduce best\-in\-class external practices and governance frameworks (GDPR, data privacy, records compliance)
* Develop business cases: Collaborate on—and may create—financial business models; conduct business opportunity reviews with senior team members
* Measure success: Define metrics that inform product success and drive user experience improvements (adoption, reporting cycle\-time reduction, forecast accuracy, model quality, automation ROI)
* Collaborate cross\-functionally: Work closely with data platform, data science, AI/ML, and engineering teams; support backlog refinement, test case definition and UAT, and design product training curriculum


**Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of experience preferred, ideally with exposure to HR and/or Legal data products
* Bachelor's degree preferred, ideally in Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field
* Familiarity with modern enterprise data platforms, semantic/data modeling, APIs, and AI/ML concepts; experience delivering products on an analytics/intelligence platform is a strong plus
* Understanding of data governance principles—lineage, provenance, auditability, and domain data ownership
* Knowledge of HR and/or Legal concepts (workforce planning, talent management, people analytics, compliance, data privacy, contract lifecycle management) is a strong plus
* Excellent communicator who can simplify the complex and build trusted relationships with business stakeholders
* Ability to work across HR, Legal, IT, Engineering, Data Science, and AI/ML teams
* Bias for action, ownership, and the ability to break down complex problems, drive alignment, and remain decisive

We're building a category\-defining institutional partnerships arm for one of India's fastest\-scaling personalised print and gifting operations — expanding from a single\-city base into a multi\-city, franchise\-backed network across Madhya Pradesh. title: Head of Employee Relations, India
description:
Req ID: 60995
Job Function: HR
Posting Start Date: 23/07/2026
Posting End Date: 03/08/2026
Division: People \& Culture
Job Location: IND\-Gurugram\-IQ
Advertised Salary: Competitive
**Hyrbid working \- 3 days in the office 2 days working from home**

  

**About the role**
------------------

The India Head of Employee Relations leads the full ER and People Relations agenda for BT India across \~14,000 colleagues. The role is responsible for ensuring BT operates a fair, safe, compliant, and values\-driven workplace by driving ER governance, leadership advisory, POSH compliance, labour law readiness, transformation support, investigations, and proactive risk mitigation.

  

This role provides full leadership to the People Partners team who manage ER advisory, investigation support, redeployment, redundancies, manager guidance, business partnering for transformation, and colleague relations.

  

The role is also responsible for interpreting and operationalising India’s Four Labour Codes (Wage Code, Social Security Code, Industrial Relations Code, and OSH Code), leading policy redesign, transformation change, and cross\-functional compliance readiness.

  

Given the scale, regulatory complexity, and risk exposure, this role must be held by leader capable of influencing senior stakeholders, balancing commercial and legal perspectives, driving organisational change, and safeguarding BT’s reputation and culture.


**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead the Employee Relations strategy for BT India, ensuring fair, consistent and timely resolution of complex and sensitive employee matters.
* Provide strategic ER leadership across business transformation, organisational change, workforce planning, redeployment, redundancy and restructuring activity.
* Lead, develop and coach the People Partners team, strengthening advisory capability, stakeholder influence and leadership support across the business.
* Partner with HR, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Security and senior business leaders to manage people risk and enable successful business outcomes.
* Oversee ER governance, reporting, quality assurance, case auditing, documentation standards and continuous process improvement.
* Act as the senior advisor and final authority on disciplinary matters, ensuring consistent, proportionate and legally defensible outcomes.
* Lead BT India's POSH framework, ensuring compliance, robust investigation standards, leadership awareness and proactive risk prevention.
* Provide expert guidance on Indian employment legislation, including Labour Codes, industrial relations, workforce regulations and statutory obligations.
* Lead policy and process redesign to ensure compliance with evolving employment laws and organisational requirements.
* Own employment compliance governance across BT India, including audits, statutory filings, inspections, record keeping and regulatory reporting.
* Represent BT with labour authorities, government bodies and regulators, managing enquiries, inspections and compliance matters.
* Oversee contractor labour compliance, vendor governance and remediation activity where required.
* Monitor external industrial relations trends and advise leaders on emerging risks and organisational impacts.
* Drive manager capability through training and coaching on employee relations, investigations, grievances, conduct, performance and workplace behaviours.
* Promote a culture of fairness, accountability, inclusion and psychological safety, using insights to influence leadership behaviour and organisational culture.
* Build organisational readiness for change by guiding leaders through legal, cultural and operational impacts of transformation initiatives.
**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Employee Relations \& Employment Law Expertise: Deep knowledge of Indian employment law, including the Four Labour Codes, POSH legislation, complex ER investigations, disciplinary processes, redeployment, redundancy and industrial relations advisory.
* Strategic Leadership \& Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence and advise senior leaders across India and the UK, make sound decisions in complex situations, and lead organisational change with confidence and credibility.
* Data\-Driven \& People\-Focused Approach: Strong analytical capability with experience using ER metrics and ServiceNow insights, combined with high emotional intelligence, conflict resolution skills and the ability to navigate sensitive employee matters effectively.
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Demonstrates exceptional integrity, discretion and professional courage, handling sensitive and complex employee relations matters with confidentiality, fairness and accountability.
* Exercises balanced judgement and empathy, carefully considering business, legal and people implications to deliver pragmatic and equitable outcomes.
* Exhibits strong executive presence, confidently influencing, challenging and advising senior leaders on high\-risk and business\-critical issues.
* Builds credible and effective stakeholder relationships, fostering collaboration and maintaining constructive engagement across all levels of the organisation.
**Our Package**
---------------

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

description:
Here is the updated, neutral Job Description with all specific company references removed.

**Job Description: Senior Finance Associate / Manager – Accounting \& Audit**

**Industry:** EdTech

**Location:** \[JP Nagar, Bangalore]

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Experience Level:** 3–6 Years

**About the Company**

We are a fast\-growing startup building next\-generation learning solutions in the EdTech space. As we continue to expand, we value speed, accountability, and operational excellence. We are seeking a hands\-on, meticulous Finance professional to own our financial reporting, month\-end closures, and audit workflows.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Month\-End \& Year\-End Financial Close**

* Drive the entire **month\-end and year\-end closing process** to ensure timely and accurate closing of books.
* Prepare and post critical journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and provisions in accordance with **Ind AS / Indian GAAP**.
* Perform monthly **reconciliations** of bank accounts, intercompany balances, revenue schedules, and balance sheet line items.
* Maintain fixed asset registers (FAR) and handle depreciation calculations under the Companies Act and Income Tax Act.

**2\. Audit Management \& Compliance**

* Act as the **primary point of contact** for Statutory Auditors, Internal Auditors, and Tax Auditors.
* Prepare comprehensive audit schedules, balance confirmations, and notes to accounts (P\&L and Balance Sheet).
* Resolve audit queries promptly to ensure smooth and clean audit completion within strict deadlines.
* Ensure strict adherence to internal financial controls, accounting policies, and statutory regulations.

**3\. Financial Reporting \& Analysis**

* Prepare monthly Trial Balance, P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements.
* **Variance Analysis:** Compare actual financial performance against budgets and prior periods, identifying key operational drivers.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Operations, Tech, HR) to streamline vendor payments and expense tracking.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** CA (Inter) / Qualified CA / M.Com / MBA in Finance.
* **Experience:** 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in core accounting, financial closes, and external audit support (Startup or EdTech experience is a plus).
* **Technical Expertise:**
* Strong working knowledge of **Ind AS / Indian GAAP** and Schedule III presentation.
* Proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., Zoho Books, Tally, NetSuite, or SAP).
* Advanced **MS Excel** skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data manipulation).
* **Soft Skills:**
* High ownership mindset with the ability to manage tight close schedules independently.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills to interface with auditors and management.
* Adaptability to thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to shape and scale the financial operations of a fast\-growing business.
* Direct working exposure with leadership and key stakeholders.
* Competitive salary package and clear growth trajectory.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Dayforce is a global human capital management (HCM) company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, with operations across North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), and the Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) region.
  
Our award\-winning Cloud HCM platform offers a unified solution database and continuous calculation engine, driving efficiency, productivity and compliance for the global workforce.
  
Our brand promise \- Makes Work Life Better™\- Reflects our commitment to employees, customers, partners and communities globally.
  
  

About the opportunity
  
The Centre of Excellence (CoE) Services Consultant Sr. plays a critical role in the successful delivery of implementation projects by actively participating in key phases of the lifecycle. Working closely with the Project Manager and the project team, the consultant is responsible for delivering high\-quality work on projects, including but not limited to, solutioning, configuration, system readiness, data loads, cutover to production, etc. This role requires a strong understanding of best practices, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across various teams to ensure customer requirements are accurately translated into functional solutions. **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading learning initiatives across multiple global regions or distributed teams.

Experience supporting large\-scale client transitions, operational launches, or transformation programs.

**Keys to Success**


* Lead a high\-performing Learning team that delivers engaging, scalable, and business\-focused learning solutions.

* Drive continuous improvement through learning analytics, operational insights, learner feedback, and quality performance.

Dynamic and entrepreneurial culture.

title: Senior US HR & Compliance Specialist – Contract (Trivandrum, US Shift)
description:
**Senior US HR \& Compliance Specialist — Contract, Trivandrum**
----------------------------------------------------------------


**Location:** Trivandrum (Thiruvananthapuram), Kerala  

**Market:** US HR operations and staffing compliance  

**Shift:** US hours (EST / CST overlap required)  

**Engagement:** Contract, 6–12 months, extendable based on performance and volume  

**Compensation:** Commensurate with experience — discussed during the interview


### **Read This First**



This is an expert\-level role. We are not building a training runway. You will own the compliance layer from day one, with no one reviewing your I\-9s behind you. If your experience is in collecting documents for someone else to verify, or you have covered onboarding paperwork without owning work authorization tracking and immigration coordination, this role is not the right fit and we would rather tell you now than at the offer stage. Compliance errors here carry legal and financial consequences, so we are hiring for judgement that is already formed.


### **About the Role**



You will own the paperwork and compliance layer sitting behind every consultant we place from our Trivandrum office: work authorization verification, onboarding documentation, contract paperwork, and audit\-ready record\-keeping. This is a role for someone who reads the fine print, chases the missing document, and does not let an expiry date slip past.


### **What You Will Own**


#### **Onboarding \& Documentation**


* Run end\-to\-end onboarding for US consultants and employees — offer paperwork, background checks, drug screening coordination and start\-date readiness
* Independently complete and verify **Form I\-9**, manage **E\-Verify** cases including tentative nonconfirmations, handle reverifications and correct errors on existing files
* Validate right\-to\-work documents, education and employment verifications without escalation
* Maintain personnel files to inspection standard with correct retention schedules

#### **Work Authorization \& Immigration**


* Own work authorization tracking and expiry control across USC, GC, H1B, H4 EAD, L2 EAD, OPT/CPT and TN populations
* Coordinate directly with immigration attorneys on LCA postings, public access files, H1B amendments, transfers and extensions
* Flag upcoming expiries early and drive renewal follow\-up to closure — no lapses

#### **Contracts \& Engagement Paperwork**


* Prepare and control employment agreements, MSAs, NDAs, right\-to\-represent forms and subcontractor documentation
* Own W2, C2C and 1099 engagement setup and vendor onboarding paperwork
* Maintain a clean contract repository with full renewal and expiry visibility

#### **Compliance \& Reporting**


* Own multi\-state compliance: state registrations, workers compensation, unemployment claims and state wage and hour requirements
* Run FLSA exempt and non\-exempt classification reviews, and EEO\-1 and ACA reporting inputs
* Support timesheet, payroll and invoicing data accuracy in coordination with finance
* Own documentation readiness for internal reviews and client, vendor or agency compliance audits
* Keep HRIS and ATS records accurate, current and audit\-defensible

### **Non\-Negotiable Requirements**


* **5\+ years** in US HR operations, US staffing compliance or HR shared services supporting US clients
* **Independent, hands\-on ownership of I\-9 and E\-Verify** — including reverifications, tentative nonconfirmations and correcting existing file errors. This is the core of the role
* Direct ownership of work authorization tracking across H1B, H4 EAD, OPT/CPT, GC and TN, with expiry follow\-up driven to closure
* Hands\-on coordination with immigration attorneys on LCA postings, public access files or H1B amendments
* Working command of US federal and multi\-state employment compliance applied in real decisions
* Independent preparation of US engagement paperwork — MSAs, NDAs, right\-to\-represent, and W2 / C2C / 1099 setup
* Strong Excel skills and fluency in HRIS or ATS platforms
* Precise written and spoken English for unsupervised contact with US consultants, client HR teams, agencies and attorneys
* Available for US shift hours from Trivandrum
* Graduate degree in HR, Commerce, Law or a related field; HR or compliance certification is a strong plus

### **Strong Advantages**


* Prior experience at a US staffing firm, RPO, EOR or PEO
* Exposure to MSP / VMS portals such as Fieldglass, Beeline or IQNavigator
* Experience preparing for I\-9 audits, SOC 2, ISO or client compliance audits
* Track record of finding and remediating compliance gaps that had passed prior review

### **What We Offer**


* A defined contract engagement with clear scope and extension potential
* Full ownership of US employment law, immigration processes and multi\-state compliance
* A small team where your judgement carries real weight and is not second\-guessed
* Compensation discussed during the interview and aligned to genuine expertise

### **How to Apply**



Send your CV along with a short note covering: which compliance areas you have owned independently, your hands\-on I\-9 and E\-Verify experience including any error remediation, the work authorization types you have tracked, your direct experience with immigration attorneys, and your notice period. Applications that do not address independent ownership will not be shortlisted.


We never charge candidates any fee at any stage of the hiring process.

* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in Workday configuration.

* We do not currently have Workday Financials or Recruiting.

description:
Finance Operations \& Strategy Analyst Intern

**Internship Type:** Full\-Time Internship (6 Months)**Work Mode:** Remote / Hybrid (Based on Business Requirements)**Company:** Magnetar AI Solutions LLP

About Magnetar AI Solutions LLP

Magnetar AI Solutions LLP is an AI, software development, and technology consulting company building intelligent software products, enterprise platforms, SaaS applications, workflow automation systems, and AI\-powered business solutions.

We help businesses improve operational efficiency through technology while developing innovative products for global markets. As an intern, you will gain practical exposure to startup finance, commercial operations, strategic planning, investment readiness, and business growth while working directly with the Founder on real\-world projects.

Internship Overview

We are seeking a motivated **Finance Operations \& Strategy Analyst Intern** who is eager to learn finance beyond traditional bookkeeping.

This internship provides practical experience in financial operations, commercial pricing, budgeting, business analytics, investment preparation, SaaS business models, and strategic decision\-making within a fast\-growing AI technology company.

The role is designed for individuals who aspire to build careers in corporate finance, startup finance, business strategy, financial consulting, or entrepreneurship.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the internship, you will gain practical exposure to:

· Startup Finance Operations

· Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A)

· Accounting Fundamentals

· Financial Reporting

· Budgeting \& Forecasting

· Cash Flow Planning

· Cost Analysis

· Commercial Pricing Strategy

· SaaS Financial Models

· Business Analytics

· Investment Readiness

· Financial Modelling

· Commercial Proposal Evaluation

· Business Strategy

· Operational Finance

Key ResponsibilitiesFinance Operations

· Assist in maintaining financial records and documentation.

· Support bookkeeping and accounting activities.

· Prepare expense tracking reports.

· Assist in accounts receivable and payable monitoring.

· Support bank reconciliation activities.

· Organize financial documentation for audits and reporting.

Financial Reporting \& Analysis

· Assist in preparing:

o Profit \& Loss Statements

o Balance Sheets

o Cash Flow Reports

o Monthly Financial Summaries

o Business Performance Reports

· Analyze:

o Revenue

o Operating Expenses

o Project Profitability

o Business Performance

o Cost Trends

· Support KPI tracking and management reporting.

Budgeting \& Forecasting

· Assist in preparing annual and quarterly budgets.

· Monitor budget utilization.

· Support cash flow forecasting.

· Analyze budget variances.

· Track organizational burn rate.

· Assist founders with financial planning activities.

Commercial \& Pricing Strategy

· Assist in preparing commercial quotations.

· Support software project pricing.

· Estimate project implementation costs.

· Evaluate project profitability.

· Assist in SaaS pricing analysis.

· Compare pricing against competitors.

· Support proposal costing and commercial evaluations.

Investment \& Strategic Finance

· Prepare financial projections.

· Assist in investor documentation.

**About the Role:**


We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented **Associate Data Engineer** to join our growing data team. If you are a recent graduate passionate about data and eager to build a career in data engineering, this is the perfect opportunity for you!


In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers to build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines. You will get hands\-on experience with modern data infrastructure, transitioning your basic academic or project\-level knowledge into production\-grade skills. We focus heavily on mentorship, ensuring you have the support you need to grow as a professional.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Pipeline Development:** Assist in writing and maintaining ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) scripts to move data across various systems.
* **Database Management:** Write basic SQL queries, create tables, and interact with **PostgreSQL** databases to support data storage and retrieval.
* **Data Orchestration:** Help schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot automated data workflows using **Apache Airflow**.
* **Stream Processing:** Collaborate with the team to build and monitor real\-time or near\-real\-time data streaming applications using **Apache Flink**.
* **Coding \& Debugging:** Write clean, readable, and well\-documented code in **Python**.
* **Continuous Learning:** Actively participate in code reviews, learn best practices from senior team members, and stay updated on the latest data engineering trends.

 **Must\-Have Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field (Recent graduates from batch \[Year] are welcome).
* **Python:** Solid foundational knowledge of Python programming (data structures, loops, functions, basic libraries like Pandas).
* **PostgreSQL (SQL):** Basic understanding of relational databases, table design, and the ability to write standard SQL queries (SELECT, JOINs, GROUP BY).
* **Apache Airflow:** Theoretical understanding or project\-level exposure to how Airflow works (DAGs, tasks, scheduling).
* **Apache Flink:** Basic conceptual knowledge of distributed data processing or stream processing using Flink.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and a genuine eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

 **Good\-to\-Have (Bonus Points):**

* **Spatial Data:** Knowledge of the **PostGIS** extension for PostgreSQL and a basic understanding of how to write geo/spatial queries.
* **Version Control:** Basic understanding of tools like **Git/GitHub**.
* **Cloud Basics:** Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* **OS:** Comfortable with basic Linux/Unix command\-line operations.
* **Portfolio:** Any personal or academic projects showcasing data pipelines or data processing.

You are part of a team in India responsible for building sustainable cocoa sourcing strategies to meet Cocoa\-Life objectives on best practices in sustainable cocoa farming, improving livelihoods in cocoa communities, protecting the forest and the environment, and building and maintaining Mondelēz International’s reputation.

To help with benchmarking and performance improvement, you will closely track KPIs and regularly report on their progress. You will also conduct education in the field about cocoa, including educating others about how cocoa is grown, why cocoa should be planted, good agricultural practices (GAP), and how to implement sustainability initiatives (e.g. training women, drip irrigation and supporting marginal farmers). In addition, you will:


* Work with government officials in horticulture and agriculture departments to implement cocoa programs.
* Collect data for crop forecasting and market intelligence for pricing decisions.
* Work with third\-party operations for cocoa procurement and processing.

**What you will bring**


A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career with experience and knowledge in:


* Strong analytics and process discipline
* Hands\-on knowledge of agriculture with a commercial orientation
* Communication, with strong interpersonal and influencing skills
* Ability to work alone and independently without direct supervision

title: Technical Executive
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**


**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.**


You are part of a team in India responsible for building sustainable cocoa sourcing strategies to meet Cocoa\-Life objectives on best practices in sustainable cocoa farming, improving livelihoods in cocoa communities, protecting the forest and the environment, and building and maintaining Mondelēz International’s reputation.


**How you will contribute**


You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management of the nursery, ensuring that processes are strictly followed and that the Cocoa nursery is well\-tended and respected. To help with benchmarking and performance improvement, you will closely track KPIs and regularly report on their progress. You will also conduct education in the field about cocoa, including educating others about how cocoa is grown, why cocoa should be planted, good agricultural practices (GAP), and how to implement sustainability initiatives (e.g. training women, drip irrigation and supporting marginal farmers). In addition, you will:


* Work with government officials in horticulture and agriculture departments to implement cocoa programs.
* Collect data for crop forecasting and market intelligence for pricing decisions.
* Work with third\-party operations for cocoa procurement and processing.

**What you will bring**


A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career with experience and knowledge in:


* Strong analytics and process discipline
* Hands\-on knowledge of agriculture with a commercial orientation
* Communication, with strong interpersonal and influencing skills
* Ability to work alone and independently without direct supervision

Additional Job Description
**More about this role \-**

The Technical executive managing the Cocoa operations at Andhra Pradesh locations should be able to deliver as per the job responsibilities listed below which will ensure effective involves the promotion of cocoa crops among farmers, training Cocoa GAP, Management of nurseries, Cocoa Life activities, Cocoa procurement, quality control and bean dispatch to factories. The resource should be good at Agronomy, Horticulture, Farmer training and extensive field visits, Nursery management, networking with farming \& rural communities. The resource should be a committed team person building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. The person should be committed towards fulfilling Mondelez's policies and compliance requirements and implement Cocoa Life initiatives towards achieving economic, social, and environmental sustainability.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* **Cocoa Area development** – Farmer identification and new area identification
* **Cocoa Crop Science** – Nursery Management, P\&D management, Agronomy, Extension and farmer retention
* **Cocoa Procurement** – Coordinate with third\-party buying partners who operate on a commission\-per\-kilo basis. Receive and account for cocoa deliveries at collection sites. Monitor quality of beans purchased against specific quality requirements. Manage documentation and dispatch of beans to factory. Effectively train farmers on Post\-Harvest and Quality management.
* **Cocoa Life Program** – Involve in Cocoa Life programs like Community Development Programs through NGO partnerships, Young Farm Survey, Agro\-forestry, CSR and Sustainability program Mondelez International Internal
* **People management** – Cocoa Nursery and TPO collection staff, workers education on quality requirement.
* **Research \& Institutional Collaboration** – Support research projects with institutions such as Kerala Agriculture University and CPCRI. Assist senior staff on research and project\-related activities.
* **Government \& Stakeholder Liaison** – Liaise with local government officials, Horticulture and Agriculture Departments at village level. Coordinate with Govt depts including FSSAI and other licenses as required.
* Implementing Sustainability and Safety Initiatives.
* **Digital Onboarding** of Farmers, Polygon mapping of Farms and Digital tools for procurement

**Education / Certifications:**

* BSc. Agriculture/ Horticulture/Forestry or MSc in Botany
* Exceptional talent with Diploma in Agriculture
* Knowledge of South Indian languages ideally Telugu \& Hindi are essential.

**Job specific requirements:**

***Experience \-***


* Freshers are welcome to apply
* 0–4 years of experience in agriculture, horticulture, or related field
* Experienced candidates from seed companies, fertilizer companies, or agri\-related firms are also considered

***Field Readiness \-***


* Role requires extensive field visits involving travel to farms
* Practical field readiness is essential

***Skills \-***


* Hands on Knowledge of Agriculture
* Commercial Orientation
* Innovation, Communication and Negotiation skills
* Computer skills – AI, Excel, Word, Power Point
* Accounting – Tally/SAP/Data analysis/Taxes

***Competencies \-***


* Organization, planning and management
* Attention to detail
* Analytical thinking
* Human relations and influencing
* Teamwork
* Interpersonal effectiveness
* Application of knowledge
* Persistence and ability to update

**Travel requirements:** Role requires extensive field visits involving travel to farms.


\&\#xa;\&\#xa;
No Relocation support available
**Business Unit Summary**
-------------------------


### **Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth\-watering and well\-loved local and global brands such as** ***Cadbury*** **chocolates,** ***Bournvita*** **and** ***Tang*** **powdered beverages,** ***Oreo*** **and** ***Cadbury Bournvita*** **biscuits, and** ***Halls*** **and** ***Cadbury Choclairs Gold*** **candies get safely into our customers hands—and mouths*****.*** **Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research \& Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 – the fourth time we’ve received this award.**


Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


**Job Type**
------------


Regular

**What We're Looking ForExperience**

* 3\+ years of professional experience in Graphic Design \& Branding.

**Freshers are also encouraged to apply** if you possess an exceptional portfolio that demonstrates outstanding design thinking, premium aesthetics, and strong branding capabilities.

**The Portfolio**

* Brand Identity Systems

* Packaging Design
* Editorial Layouts
* Social Media Campaigns
* Marketing Creatives
* Print Design

* Branding \& Visual Identity

* Editorial Design
* Visual Hierarchy
* Layout Design
* Grid Systems
* Colour Theory
* Design Psychology

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (FS)** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are building a next\-generation product engineering organization where we are looking for Business Analysts who will transform business problems, customer needs, and market opportunities into well\-defined product capabilities that engineering teams can build with confidence.
 



  





 The Business Analyst will combine
 **strong business analysis skills, product thinking, domain modelling, systems thinking,** 
 and AI\-assisted analysis to discover requirements, define product behavior, and enable rapid product delivery.
 



 This role focuses on
 **understanding customer journeys, analyzing complex business domains, documenting functional and non\-functional requirements, modelling business processes, and collaborating across product, engineering, architecture, and AI teams.** 
 We are looking for analysts who can effectively use AI as a force multiplier to accelerate research, documentation, requirement analysis, and product discovery while ensuring business accuracy and completeness.
 



  





**Experience level** 
 : 5 to 10 years
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Discovery:** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, customers, domain experts, and engineering teams to discover business problems and identify product opportunities.
* Conduct workshops, stakeholder interviews, and collaborative discovery sessions.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined product capabilities and solution requirements.



  





**Business Analysis:** 



* Analyze complex business processes and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and digital transformation.
* Define functional and non\-functional requirements for product capabilities.
* Document business rules, workflows, decision logic, user journeys, and system interactions.
* Maintain complete traceability from business objectives through implementation.



  





**Domain Modelling \& Product Design:** 



* Develop and maintain business domain models that accurately represent customer processes, products, entities, relationships, and business events.
* Bring the perspective of FS centric regulatory requirements, financial security context to product design.
* Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure domain models align with system architecture and product design.
* Continuously refine domain models as product capabilities evolve.



  





**Requirements Engineering:** 



* Prepare high\-quality: User Stories, Epics, Features, Acceptance Criteria, Business Rules, Functional Specifications, Process Flows, Decision Models
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, implementable, and aligned with business objectives.



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, Architects, UX Designers, Engineers, Data Scientists, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Clarify business requirements during development and testing.
* Support product validation and customer acceptance activities.



  





**AI\-Augmented Business Analysis:** 



* Use AI\-powered tools to accelerate market research, business analysis, requirement documentation, user story creation, process modelling, and product documentation.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs for business correctness, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
* Apply AI responsibly while maintaining domain expertise and analytical rigor.



  





**Product Validation:** 



* Participate in product demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and solution validation.
* Verify implemented functionality against business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Work with QA teams to ensure comprehensive business test coverage.
* Gather customer feedback and continuously improve product capabilities.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong experience in Business Analysis within software product development environments.
* **Financial Services Domain Knowledge**
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience of creating business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies.
* Experience with business process modelling and workflow analysis.
* Familiarity with modern product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, Figma, or similar platforms.
* Experience using AI\-powered tools to improve business analysis, documentation, and research productivity.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Desired Skills** 



* Product Thinking, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD)
* Business Process Management (BPM)
* Customer Journey Mapping
* AI\-assisted Product Discovery
* Design Thinking
* Systems Thinking



  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 




 Within the first year, you will:
 


* Successfully translate complex customer problems into clear, implementable product requirements.
* Develop reusable business domain models that improve product quality and engineering efficiency.
* Improve requirement quality, reducing ambiguity and downstream rework.
* Enable engineering teams to deliver features faster through well\-defined user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Be the custodian for the product backlog in the respective product area.
* Help establish AI\-assisted business analysis practices that improve productivity while maintaining business accuracy.
* Contribute to building customer\-centric, scalable, and high\-quality software products that solve real business problems.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 
  

 We are looking for a Business Analyst – GBO Support to join us in developing ways for IKEA to stay relevant for our customers.
   

  

 Our diverse team for is growing and we would love to talk with you, if you recognize yourself in some of the following:
   

  

 Passionate about understanding complex business processes, the strategic impact of digital tools on operational excellence, and how digital systems can optimize them.
   

 Have a strong background in business analysis, IT operations, data\-driven problem solving, and driving digital transformation initiatives in collaboration with functions like AMS, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Platforms.
   

 Love being creative through identifying opportunities for efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement using digital solutions.
   

 Take ownership and independently drive towards desired outcomes
   

 Know about developing strategic roadmaps for IT enablement, operational optimization through digital tools, and effective collaboration frameworks across digital functions.
   

 Have experience working in cross\-functional teams, bridging the gap between business and IT stakeholders.
   

 Are a team player who takes ownership, builds cross\-functional relationships with peers and loves sharing knowledge with others
   

 Proactively manage relevant stakeholders
   

 Are curious, self\-directed and want to keep learning!
   

  

 This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
   

 The must\-haves we see for this role is though:
   

  

 Proven experience as a Business Analyst with a strong focus on IT systems, operational efficiency, and digital transformation.
   

 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather, interpret, and present data to identify bottlenecks, opportunities for optimization, and the impact of digital solutions.
   

 Demonstrated ability to establish and manage governance processes that rigorously track the impact of IT incidents and system performance on Global Business Operations (GBO) Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), driving accountability and continuous operational improvement
   

  

 The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day\-to\-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more about our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.
   

  

**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 
  

 You’ll be a vital part in the transformation of IKEA into a more front line obsessed company by ensuring that Global Business Operations are seamlessly powered by digital innovation, leading to a low\-cost, agile, and customer\-centric IKEA experience.
   

  

 This mean that you will:
   

  

 Partner closely with the GBO function to deeply understand existing operational processes, digital system utilization, and identify opportunities for optimization and digital tool adoption.
   

 Gather and analyse data from various sources to identify IT\-related bottlenecks and areas where digital systems can be leveraged for greater operational efficiency and cost savings.
   

 Bridge the gap between business needs and IT capabilities, translating GBO requirements into actionable IT solutions and improvements, actively collaborating with Digital Functions like AMS, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Platforms.
   

 Design, implement, and run a governance framework to track the impact of IT incidents, digital tool implementations, and operational improvements on GBO KPIs and overall business value.
   

 Proactively identify, evaluate, and propose automation opportunities and new digital tools within existing GBO processes to drive significant operational efficiency and cost benefits for the company.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 We see ourselves as influencers – we steer the IKEA business by finding the truth behind the figures. Together we secure compliance with local and international laws and reporting standards; we assure that accounting processes are efficient and that tax compliance meets business needs. We’re a diverse group of people driven by providing reliable financial data to a wide variety of stakeholders. At the end of the day, that’s one of the foundations to make IKEA even better!

As the world’s largest manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last 22 years, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. You will become a part of India’s proudest legacy, a brand that is celebrated by 110 million Indians and is now taking over the world with its manufacturing superpower. If you are someone who dreams big and goes after their dreams with absolute conviction, Hero is your place to be. At Hero, we are building a cutting\-edge future of mobility, pushing frontiers of innovation and aiming for the very best. Choose to be with the best, choose to be your best.
  
  

About Hero
  
  

Headquartered in New Delhi (India), Hero MotoCorp is the world's largest manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for 22 consecutive years. We are at the forefront of developing modern, technologically superior and eco\-friendly mobility solutions for its millions of customers around the world. Hero MotoCorp has rapidly transformed into a true multinational organization with a presence in 47 countries across Asia, Africa, Latin America and the Middle East. We have achieved the coveted milestone of 110 million cumulative production and sales since inception. Aligned with its Vision “Be the Future of Mobility”, Hero MotoCorp plans to achieve its next 100 million sales by 2030\. We have a globally benchmarked manufacturing and Research \& Development (R\&D) ecosystem that is spread across global geographies. Its R\&D facilities are located in India and Germany \- the Centre of Innovation and Technology (CIT) at Jaipur, India, and the Tech Centre Germany (TCG), near Munich. Hero MotoCorp’s eight ‘green’ manufacturing facilities are spread across India (6\), Colombia (1\) and Bangladesh (1\). Hero MotoCorp is the pre\-eminent leader in the Indian two\-wheeler market. It is the only motorcycle manufacturing company listed in Dow Jones Sustainability Index. In 2022, Hero MotoCorp launched a separate brand for emerging mobility solutions, including Electric Vehicles (EV) \- VIDA, Powered by Hero. VIDA has commenced sales of VIDA V1 – its first EV – in India and plans to launch the product in global markets. We are one of the largest global corporate promoters of multiple sporting disciplines. Hero is globally associated with golf, football, field hockey, cricket and motorsports. Hero MotoSports Team Rally is one of India’s flag\-bearers in global rally racing. The iconic golfer Tiger Woods is Hero MotoCorp’s Global Corporate Partner. Read more about us. Be with the best. Be your best. Catch\-up on all our latest openings. Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news.
