title: National Program Officer/ National Program Manager – Laboratory Systems
description:
Overview:
**About the Organisation**


Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.  

Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).**About the Program**


The NPO or National Program Manager Laboratory Systems will work under the Reaching Impact, Saturation, and Epidemic Control (RISE) and Enhanced Global Health Security (EGHS) Projects in support of prevention, detection, and response to emerging infectious disease threats.  

The two main objectives are Enhance Outbreak Containment Efforts and Improve Laboratory Confirmation**About the Position**
Jhpiego is hiring for the position of National Program Officer – Laboratory Systems based at New Delhi for its RISE project. The position will work closely with the India country office and state office teams for strengthening of lab capacity. The position will report to the Associate Director.### 


Responsibilities:
* Lead national\-level planning, budgeting, and project management for laboratory systems strengthening under the RISE project.
* Develop—and continuously refine—national strategies and roadmaps for laboratory capacity enhancement, aligning with government priorities.
* Serve as the principal liaison for laboratory systems between Jhpiego, the Ministry of Health \& Family Welfare, Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, state health departments, and other stakeholders, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment of objectives.
* Implement comprehensive gap assessments of laboratory infrastructure, workflows, biosafety, and biosecurity systems; drive targeted improvements through infrastructure upgrades, equipment deployment, and optimized SOPs.
* Champion the introduction and scale\-up of advanced diagnostic modalities, including metagenomic (NGS) and other molecular techniques, to enhance pathogen identification and genomic surveillance.
* Establish a rigorous quality management system—encompassing proficiency testing, audits, and corrective action plans—to sustain high standards in diagnostic accuracy and biosafety
* Design and lead national\-level training programs for laboratory personnel on pathogen\-specific diagnostics, data management, biosafety, and laboratory leadership skills.
* Mentor state\-level laboratory teams and focal points, building their capacity to manage laboratories independently and to train others.
* Document and disseminate best practices, guidelines, and policy briefs on laboratory strengthening, facilitating knowledge exchange among government partners and technical
* Architect and oversee the roll\-out of a robust national laboratory network, including sample referral pathways and electronic data management platforms that support real\-time reporting and analysis.
* Collaborate with digital health teams to optimize laboratory information management systems (LIMS) integration with national health surveillance databases
* Analyze laboratory performance metrics and surveillance data to inform strategic decision\-making and to produce high\-quality reports for donors and government counterparts.
* Cultivate and manage strategic partnerships with international agencies, NGOs, academic institutions, and private sector stakeholders to leverage resources and technical expertise.
* Represent Jhpiego at national and international forums, advocating for investments in laboratory systems and shaping policy dialogues around diagnostic preparedness.
* Identify and pursue new funding opportunities, contributing to proposal development and budget design.


Required Qualifications:
### **Abilities/Skills:**

* Familiarity with Biosafety norms, Quality management systems and laboratory information management systems
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced
* Experience working with government agencies, international organizations, and
* Ability to analyse data and produce documents and reports of professional quality and coordinate activities independently.
* Fluency in spoken and written English and Hindi
* Computer skills demonstrating competency in MS Office Suite
* Ability to handle a variety of assignments under pressure of deadlines
* Ability to multitask and work in a multi\-cultural
* Ability to develop productive working relationships with other team members, agencies, stakeholders and other organizations.

* MD/PhD in microbiology/pathology.

title: Assistant Manager / Program Manager
description:
Overview:

Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).

**About the Program**


Jhpiego provides strategic technical assistance to the Government of India's National TB Elimination Program (NTEP) to accelerate TB elimination through health systems strengthening, implementation research, digital innovations, and evidence\-based interventions. Working closely with the Central TB Division (CTD), State TB Cells, the National Health Mission (NHM), and development partners, Jhpiego supports the delivery of high\-quality, people\-centered TB services across the continuum of care.
The program implements several national and multi\-state initiatives, including the Pro TB Impact Project, which strengthens TB service delivery at the primary healthcare level by integrating routine TB screening into Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (AAMs) and maternal health services, promoting differentiated care for high\-risk TB patients, and establishing learning labs to generate evidence for scalable interventions. Jhpiego also leads the **Cough Syrup Sales Surveillance** and **Integrated TB \& Tobacco User Screening** initiatives under TIFA. These innovative models leverage digital technologies, community engagement, and structured referral systems to identify individuals with presumptive TB at the community level and ensure their timely linkage to NTEP diagnostic and treatment services.**About the Position**


The Assistant Manager/Program Manager – Tuberculosis will be responsible for providing technical and programmatic leadership in planning, coordinating, implementing, and monitoring national and multi\-state TB initiatives. The position will support the successful execution of donor\-funded projects by ensuring high\-quality implementation, effective stakeholder coordination, timely reporting, and continuous program improvement.
The incumbent will work closely with the State TB Cells, implementing partners, and internal cross\-functional teams to strengthen TB prevention, screening, diagnosis, treatment, and care services. The role also involves supporting the design and implementation of innovative interventions, capacity\-building activities, monitoring and evaluation, knowledge management, and policy advocacy.
The position requires strong project management, technical expertise in tuberculosis, stakeholder engagement, analytical skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Regular travel to project states and districts will be required to provide technical assistance, monitor implementation, and support program quality.


The position will report to the Associate Director – ID (or designated supervisor) and will work collaboratively with national and state program teams, technical experts, monitoring and evaluation specialists, finance, procurement, communications, and government counterparts to achieve project objectives.


Required Qualifications:
* **Program Management and Technical Leadership**
* Lead the planning, implementation, coordination, and periodic review of national and state\-level TB projects in alignment with organizational priorities, government strategies, and donor requirements.
* Develop annual work plans, implementation strategies, activity calendars, risk mitigation plans, and project timelines to ensure timely achievement of project milestones and deliverables.
* Provide technical leadership for the implementation and scale\-up of innovative interventions across the TB care cascade, including screening, diagnosis, treatment, TB preventive treatment (TPT), adherence, digital health, and differentiated service delivery models.
* Develop, review, and update technical documents, standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational guidelines, implementation frameworks, training curricula, e\-learning modules, job aids, proposals, concept notes, and other knowledge products.
* Establish and maintain effective collaboration with the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP), State TB Cells, National Health Mission (NHM), development partners, academic institutions, and other stakeholders; represent the organization in technical working groups, review meetings, and national/state\-level forums.
* Design and facilitate capacity\-building initiatives, including in\-person and virtual training programs, mentoring, supportive supervision, and continuous professional development of project staff and field teams.
* Coordinate with finance, procurement, operations, and state teams to ensure efficient implementation of project activities, effective utilization of resources, compliance with donor and organizational policies, and timely reporting.
* Support operational research, implementation research, documentation of best practices, scientific writing, dissemination of findings, and preparation of manuscripts for publication.
* Prepare high\-quality technical reports, donor updates, presentations, policy briefs, and periodic program reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Perform any other technical or programmatic responsibilities assigned by the supervisor to support organizational objectives.
* **Monitoring and Data Management**
* Oversee project data management systems, ensuring timely collection, validation, analysis, interpretation, storage, and reporting of high\-quality program data.
* Monitor project performance against key performance indicators (KPIs), donor milestones, and work plans; identify implementation gaps, recommend corrective actions, and support adaptive program management.
* Conduct routine data validation, supportive supervision visits to strengthen data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability.
* Develop analytical reports using appropriate data visualization and analytics tools to support evidence\-based decision\-making by program teams and stakeholders.
* Analyze routine program data findings to identify trends, measure project outcomes, generate actionable insights, and inform strategic planning and program improvement.
* Ensure timely submission of high\-quality reports, donor reports, government reporting requirements, and project databases while maintaining compliance with data protection and confidentiality standards.
* Build the capacity of project staff and government counterparts in monitoring systems, data management, and data use for decision\-making through training, mentoring, and supportive supervision.
* Perform any other programmatic or technical responsibilities assigned by the supervisor to support organizational and project objectives.


Preferred Qualifications:
**Qualifications and Experience**

* MBBS/ Other allied health sciences/ with MD/MPH/ Other relevant master’s degree is essential.
* 5\-12 years of progressively responsible experience in public health programs.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of experience managing national or multi\-state tuberculosis programs and Ni\-kshay.
* Experience working with Government of India, National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP), international NGOs, donor\-funded projects, or multilateral agencies will be highly desirable.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong project planning, implementation, monitoring, and project management skills, with the ability to track progress against work plans and performance indicators.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement, partnership management, and interpersonal skills.
* Strategic thinking, analytical ability, and problem\-solving skills, with experience in using program data to inform decision\-making and improve performance.
* Proficiency in monitoring, data management, analysis, interpretation, and evidence\-based decision\-making, including experience in ensuring data quality, validation, and performance reporting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, including the ability to present monitoring findings and data\-driven insights to diverse stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience in technical writing, proposal development, and preparation of high\-quality reports, monitoring reports, dashboards, and knowledge products.
* Strong organizational, coordination, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet competing deadlines.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in multidisciplinary and cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); familiarity with project management, data visualization, and data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, DHIS2, or similar platforms) is strongly preferable.
* Willingness to travel extensively and work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

  

Jhpiego is an equal opportunity employer and offers highly dynamic and enabling work environment.


Jhpiego offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive employee benefits package. Women candidates will be preferred.

title: Senior Total Rewards Specialist
description:
### **About Keyloop**



Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.



We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers and buying and owning cars better for theirs.



We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?



### **Purpose of role**



The Senior Total Rewards Specialist will play a pivotal role in driving data\-led decision\-making across our global rewards programs. The prime focus on the role will be on global benefits management, with a secondary focus on other rewards activities.


In this role, you will own the reporting, analytics, budgeting, and systems infrastructure that underpins our benefits offering, while coordinating global renewals and vendor performance in partnership with regional HR teams and our global benefits broker.



The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and systems capability with the ability to coordinate effectively across cultures, time zones, and functional areas.

### **Key Duties and Responsibilities**


**Reporting \& Analytics**


* Own analytics for benefits renewals — consolidating data from regional HR teams and the local broker to support evidence\-based renewal decisions.
* Conduct joint pay gap and pay equity analysis in partnership with the Compensation Manager.
* Monitor market trends and benchmark data, translating findings into clear recommendations on competitiveness, cost\-effectiveness, and employee impact.
* Maintain accurate, audit\-ready benefits documentation, cost tracking, and compliance records globally.
* Lead the preparation of global benefits budgets and forecasts in partnership with regional HR Managers, tracking actuals against budget throughout the year.
* Model the cost impact of renewal outcomes, plan design changes, and new benefit introductions across regions.
* Flag budget variances and cost drivers proactively, providing commentary and scenario analysis to support decision\-making.


**Benefits Systems Management**


* Owns the benefits management system, ensuring system\-generated data feeds are reliable and fit for purpose for downstream reporting and analytics.
* Coordinate system configuration, updates, and enhancements to support new or amended rewards programs.
* Troubleshoot system issues, working with vendors and internal teams as needed, process guides.


**Global Benefits Management \& Renewal Coordination**


* Act as the central point of contact between regional HR teams, Finance, and external brokers on all benefits\-related reporting, budgeting, and systems matters.
* Coordinate annual renewals globally with the company's broker, managing timelines, data collection, and reporting to ensure on\-time, well\-informed renewal decisions.
* Partner with regional HR Operations teams and local broker to ensure benefit offerings remain consistent, competitive, and compliant across all countries of operation.
* Manage day\-to\-day relationships with the global broker and other benefit vendors, reviewing performance data and proposing improvements where service levels or value are at risk.
### **Experience and Skills**


* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in HR COE roles, with a strong focus on total rewards in a global or multi\-country environment.
* Proven experience in vendor management, ideally with a global benefits broker.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data analysis) and system reporting tools.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple geographies and cultures.
* Highly organized, able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines


**Why join us?**



We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.


**An inclusive environment to thrive**



We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.


**Be rewarded for your efforts**



We believe people should be paid based on their performance, so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organization to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled



Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.


**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. We are looking for a **Strategy and Integration Lead** who is equal parts Architect, Diplomat, and Operator. You don’t just manage tasks; you manage the flow of logic and influence across the enterprise to ensure our most critical priorities are delivered.

  

This is a high\-visibility role at the heart of Ford’s transformation. You will not just be managing a roadmap; you will be designing the future\-state operating model for how Ford meets its global environmental and corporate responsibilities in an increasingly complex world.


As the **Strategy \& Integration Product Manager**, you will serve as the strategic architect and connective tissue for the Environmental \& Sustainability Compliance (E\&SC) and Corporate Footprint organizations. This is a macro\-level leadership role designed to navigate a period of significant transformation driven by a rapidly evolving global regulatory landscape.


You will join a high\-impact Global IT Team spanning North America, the UK, Germany, and India. Sitting at the core of our transformation, you will bridge the gap between the Executive team’s "North Star" vision, and the Product Line leads within the Product Driven Organization (PDO). Your mission is to ensure that business value is clearly understood, prioritized, and delivered amidst a rapidly changing regulatory environment that stresses both legacy processes and modern technical/data integrations.


In addition, part of the team’s responsibilities will be to work on Partner Management, providing strategic support to functions across all regions to harmonize how Ford interacts with external entities. This involves architecting standardized Playbooks and engagement patterns that bridge the gap between high\-level strategy and operational execution.


A critical component of this responsibility is "devolving" these patterns into concrete legal relationship frameworks and technical capability requirements. By establishing common engagement models and rigorous data definitions, you will ensure the seamless and accurate flow of information required to meet Ford’s Corporate Compliance commitments and mandatory global regulatory reporting.

* **Executive Presence \& High EQ:** A trusted advisor with the discretion to handle sensitive information and the poise to represent senior leadership in any forum.
* You need to be a Strategic Force Multiplier \- As the "connective tissue" of our enterprise, you will operate at a macro level to bridge the gap between high\-level conceptual strategy and disciplined operational execution. In this high\-visibility role, you will act as a force multiplier for leadership—synthesizing complex information, driving the "Rhythm of Business," and navigating cross\-functional dynamics to transform a North Star vision into measurable enterprise value.
* **Strategic Synthesis \& Systems Thinking:** An ability to "connect the dots" across diverse functions (Finance, HR, Product), creating the frameworks and mental models that simplify complex enterprise challenges into actionable pillars.
* **Operational Excellence:** Mastery of the "Rhythm of Business," ensuring leadership accountability, seamless meeting cadences, and the ability to adopt the executive voice in high\-stakes communications.
* **Cross\-Functional Diplomacy:** A proven track record of influencing without authority, navigating organizational "nodes of power," and mediating conflict to maintain strategic alignment.
* **Analytical \& Financial Literacy:** The ability to speak the language of the business, translating raw data into a "single version of truth" through rigorous KPI/OKR design and deep business acumen.
* **Change Agility:** An agile mindset capable of pivoting strategies in real\-time and cascading complex changes from the executive suite to the front line.

**Must\-have**

* **Futuring:** String ability to make assessment on possibilities and distill them into proposed recommended strategies for both process and data opportunities, especially working with AI models.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Strong ability to analyze complex datasets and technical workflows to identify bottlenecks or misalignments.
* **Technical Literacy:** Ability to understand software development lifecycles (SDLC) and how integrated enterprise systems (PLM, ERP, MES) function.
* **Agile Proficiency:** Hands\-on experience managing backlogs and dependencies in Jira. You should be comfortable using Jira data to tell a story about progress and risks.
* **Communication:** Ability to take complex technical status updates and distill them into clear, concise reports for the Program Lead and Executive Level Leadership.
* **Systems Thinking (Foundational):** An understanding of how a change in a regulations might impact both upstream and downstream systems such as PD, Manufacturing or Supply Chain systems.
* **Ford\+ Alignment:** A commitment to the Ford\+ behaviors, focusing on transparency, speed, and technical excellence.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* **Tool Experience:** Hands\-on experience with Ford\-specific or industry\-standard tools like 3DX (Dassault Systèmes), SAP, or MMP.
* **Technical Background:** Experience in either associated business process or software development, data engineering, or systems engineering is a significant plus.
* **Data Visualization:** Proficiency in Jira, Power BI to create automated status dashboards.
* **Project Management Foundations:** 5\+ years of experience in a technical coordinator, business analyst, or similar role.
* **Change Management:** Experience documenting new "to\-be" processes and helping technical teams adopt new ways of working.

**Preferred**

* **Experience Level:** 5\+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Product Manager role within a large\-scale enterprise transformation.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Previous exposure to E\&SC (VH\&C, ASO) or Corporate Footprint environments.
* **Technical Documentation:** Proven ability to create high\-quality documentation, process maps, and integration diagrams.
* **Modernization Experience:** Familiarity with Cloud\-native architectures, MDM (Master Data Management), and migrating legacy data to modern platforms.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Delivery Manager – Global Services Center**
=============================================

**Location:** Chennai, India  

**Department:** Global Services Center (GSC)  

**Reporting to:** Sivakumaran Venkatraman / Mahesh Mahale

**About the Role**
------------------


Corporater is looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to join our Global Services Center in Chennai.


This is a hybrid leadership role combining people management, regional delivery ownership, and high\-level technical guidance. You will lead a team of approximately 10–12 consultants and be accountable for the successful delivery of projects within a designated region.


The position sits between the traditional responsibilities of a Project Manager and a Solution Architect. You will not be expected to act as a deeply specialized technical architect; however, you must have the experience and confidence to guide solution delivery, address complex challenges, and ensure that projects meet client expectations.


You will work closely with regional delivery teams, project managers, solution architects, product teams, and other global stakeholders to ensure consistent delivery excellence and further strengthen the contribution of our offshore delivery organization.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **People Leadership and Development**

* Lead and manage a team of approximately 10–12 consultants, supporting their engagement, performance, and professional development.
* Set clear expectations and provide regular coaching, feedback, and guidance.
* Conduct performance reviews and create individual development and career growth plans.
* Support the Delivery Head and PMO in planning and allocating resources across multiple projects.
* Help optimize team capacity, utilization, and delivery effectiveness.
* Foster a collaborative, innovative, accountable, and customer\-focused team culture.

### **Regional Delivery Leadership**

* Act as the primary point of accountability for delivery outcomes within your designated region.
* Work closely with regional stakeholders to define project scope, delivery plans, timelines, and resource requirements.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within agreed budgets, and in line with client requirements and quality standards.
* Monitor delivery progress and proactively address risks, dependencies, and potential obstacles.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex delivery and technical challenges.
* Maintain transparency and clear communication across local, regional, and global stakeholders.

### **Technical Guidance and Solution Support**

* Provide high\-level technical direction and solution\-design guidance for Corporater implementations.
* Support consultants in translating business requirements into effective and scalable solutions.
* Act as a bridge between consultants, solution architects, product teams, and regional stakeholders.
* Help resolve technical and delivery\-related challenges without losing sight of the client’s business objectives.
* Ensure that implementation approaches align with Corporater’s product roadmap, delivery standards, and established best practices.

### **Customer Success and Business Growth**

* Build trusted relationships with clients and regional stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction, business value, and long\-term client success.
* Identify opportunities to expand the involvement and capabilities of the GSC team in regional projects.
* Support pre\-sales activities by contributing delivery expertise, solution insights, and knowledge of offshore capabilities.
* Help position the GSC as a reliable, scalable, and value\-adding delivery partner.

### **Delivery Excellence and Continuous Improvement**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of standardized delivery processes, frameworks, tools, and templates.
* Monitor key delivery metrics, including customer satisfaction, utilization, project velocity, quality, and delivery performance.
* Use data and delivery insights to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Proactively identify project and operational risks, escalate where appropriate, and implement effective mitigation plans.
* Promote knowledge sharing, innovation, and consistent delivery practices across teams and regions.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification would be an advantage.
* At least 10 years of experience in IT consulting, enterprise software, or SaaS implementation and delivery.
* A minimum of three years’ experience in a delivery leadership, project leadership, or comparable people\-management role.
* Demonstrated experience leading small to mid\-sized consulting or delivery teams.
* Experience managing complex client projects within a global or matrix organization.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS platforms; experience with GRC, BPM, performance management, or related business applications would be highly advantageous.
* Knowledge of both Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* A sound understanding of solution\-design principles and enterprise software implementation.
* Proven stakeholder\-management skills, including experience working with clients and cross\-functional global teams.
* Strong communication, leadership, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities.
* The ability to balance technical oversight, people leadership, client expectations, and commercial priorities.
* Excellent written and spoken English.


Experience with the Corporater platform or a comparable enterprise performance and GRC solution would be an advantage but is not essential.

**The Personal Qualities We Value**
-----------------------------------


You are a versatile leader who is comfortable wearing several hats: people manager, delivery strategist, client partner, and technical guide.


You are:

* Customer\-centric and committed to delivering measurable value.
* Strategic in your thinking but willing to be hands\-on when required.
* Comfortable taking ownership and being accountable for delivery outcomes.
* A strong collaborator who can influence stakeholders across functions, cultures, and geographical locations.
* Calm and solution\-oriented when dealing with complexity or escalations.
* Passionate about developing people and creating high\-performing teams.
* Results\-driven, with a strong interest in process improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.

**Why Join Corporater?**
------------------------


At Corporater, you will join an international organization that delivers enterprise solutions to customers worldwide. You will work with talented colleagues across regions and functions while playing an important role in the development of our Global Services Center in Chennai.


This position offers the opportunity to shape delivery practices, develop consultants, strengthen global collaboration, and directly influence the success of our client implementations.


If you are an experienced delivery leader who enjoys combining people leadership, customer engagement, and technical oversight, we would be delighted to hear from you.

**Apply today and help us strengthen delivery excellence across Corporater’s global organization.**

**How to Apply**
----------------


Ready to shape delivery excellence and lead talented consultants at Corporater?


Apply now by submitting your résumé and a brief cover letter through our recruitment portal. Please note that applications submitted by email will not be accepted.


**Contact:**  

Jude Bruno, Manager – HR \& Operations (Chennai)  

\+91 994 1007 768

------------------

title: HRIS Analyst - Oracle Specialist
description:
The HRIS Analyst \- Oracle Specialist will serve as a functional subject matter expert (SME) for the Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) / Oracle Fusion HCM platform, with primary responsibility for the configuration, optimization, support, and expansion of HR technology capabilities across a multinational operating environment. This role will lead the design, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Oracle HRMS solutions and act as a key partner to HR, IT, Payroll, and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands\-on Oracle HRMS expertise and a strong track record supporting global HR processes across Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, Oracle Time and Labor (OTL), and related modules.


**What You Will Do:**

* Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM and provide day\-to\-day support, configuration, enhancement, and optimization across key HR modules.
* Lead system design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and production support activities for Oracle HRMS in a multinational environment.
* Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into scalable Oracle HRMS solutions, and recommend best\-practice system designs.
* Support and optimize Oracle HRMS modules, including Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, and Oracle Time and Labor (OTL).
* Research, configure, and document solutions that address global business requirements, local country requirements, and process standardization opportunities.
* Coordinate and support system upgrades, patches, releases, and enhancements, including impact assessments, test strategy, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
* Maintain system configuration, tables, security roles, workflow setup, and related controls to ensure system reliability, usability, and compliance.
* Develop, validate, and support reports, dashboards, and analytics that enable HR decision\-making and improve operational visibility.
* Ensure data integrity through audits, controls, interface monitoring, issue resolution, and process improvements.
* Train and support end users, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders on reporting, system functionality, and process changes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, improve user experience, and strengthen HR operational effectiveness through Oracle HRMS.

**What You Will Need:**

Education and Experience


* BA/BS in MIS, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* Strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM required.
* Significant progressive HRIS experience, including hands\-on experience supporting Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM.
* Demonstrated experience with Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, enhancements, implementations, testing, and production support required.
* Experience supporting global or multinational HR operations and country\-specific process requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting HR and/or Payroll systems, self\-service platforms, and related integrations preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities


* Deep functional expertise in Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, workflows, security, testing, troubleshooting, system maintenance, upgrades, and release support.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle HRMS business processes across Core HR, recruiting, compensation, benefits, talent, time and labor, and payroll\-related workflows.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Oracle HRMS solutions with strong attention to process design and user impact.
* Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, and large\-scale enhancements in a complex business environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data validation skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve system and process issues effectively.
* Advanced reporting skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and complex Microsoft Excel functions; Power BI experience is a plus.
* Strong customer\-facing, consulting, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across HR, IT, Payroll, and business teams.
* Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, and control requirements related to HR data.
* Experience in a high\-volume, transactional environment preferred.
* Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM reporting, dashboarding, and analytics experience preferred.
* Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality \& Environmental Management System.

**Reporting Relationships:**

The incumbent reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position. This position does not have any direct reports.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**HR MANAGER** 

1\. Job Information

**Job Title:** HR Manager

**Department:** Human Resources

**Reporting To:** HR Director

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Industry:** Real Estate

**Experience:** 3–5 years of professional experience in Human Resources (Mandatory). Experience in the Real Estate industry will be preferred.

**Educational Qualification:** MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management from a recognized institution. Additional HR certifications or professional qualifications will be an added advantage.

2\. Role Description

The HR Manager is responsible for managing the organization’s human resource function by aligning HR practices with business objectives and operational requirements. The role focuses on strengthening people processes through effective talent acquisition, HR operations, policy implementation, employee relations, performance management, learning and development, and statutory compliance.

The position is expected to drive standardized HR practices, improve organizational processes, support business leaders in people\-related matters, and contribute towards building an efficient, compliant, and performance\-driven work environment. The role also ensures accurate HR reporting, process governance, and continuous improvement across the employee lifecycle.

3\. Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs)

* HR Strategy, Policy \& Organizational Process Development
* Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
* HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management
* Performance Management \& Organizational Development
* Employee Relations, Learning \& Development
* Compliance, HR Analytics \& Governance

4\. Key Responsibilities

4\.1 Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning

* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, including manpower planning, sourcing through recruitment portals, candidate screening, interview coordination, offer management, onboarding, and recruitment reporting.
* Partner with business leaders to understand workforce requirements and ensure timely hiring of competent talent aligned with organizational goals.
* Monitor recruitment effectiveness through defined hiring metrics and recommend improvements to sourcing strategies and recruitment processes.

4\.2 HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle including onboarding, induction, employee documentation, attendance, leave administration, confirmations, transfers, separations, and exit formalities.
* Ensure timely preparation, maintenance, and confidentiality of employee records and HR documentation.
* Coordinate attendance, leave records, and payroll inputs with the Accounts Department to facilitate timely payroll processing.

4\.3 Performance Management \& Organizational Development

* Administer the Performance Management System (PMS) by coordinating goal setting, appraisal cycles, performance reviews, KPI monitoring, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Support organizational development initiatives through process improvement, role clarity, competency development, and workforce planning.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend appropriate interventions to improve employee productivity and organizational effectiveness.

4\.4 Employee Relations, Learning \& Development

* Foster a positive work environment by managing employee relations, grievance handling, disciplinary matters, employee queries, and engagement initiatives.
* Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA), coordinate learning and development programmes, and monitor training effectiveness.
* Plan and execute employee engagement activities, recognition programmes, internal communication initiatives, and team\-building interventions.

4\.5 Compliance, HR Analytics \& Governance

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, company policies, and internal governance standards while supporting compliance audits.
* Develop and maintain HR MIS, dashboards, workforce reports, and HR analytics to support informed business decisions.
* Monitor key HR metrics, identify process improvement opportunities, and recommend initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and organizational governance.

4\.6 HR Strategy, Policy \& Organizational Process Development

* Lead the development, implementation, review, and continuous enhancement of HR policies, employee manuals, SOPs, and governance frameworks while ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and statutory requirements.
* Collaborate with departmental stakeholders in developing and standardizing departmental SOPs, policies, workflows, and operational processes to improve organizational efficiency.
* Drive policy communication, implementation, monitoring, and periodic amendments based on changing business needs and regulatory requirements.

5\. Authority \& Decision\-Making

* Approve employee leave requests as per the organization’s Leave Policy and delegated authority.
* Conduct employee counselling sessions, disciplinary inquiries, and recommend appropriate disciplinary actions.
* Issue warning letters, disciplinary notices, and HR\-related communications as per approved organizational procedures.
* Conduct performance appraisal discussions and facilitate performance review processes in coordination with departmental heads, subject to final approval by the HR Director and Management.
* Recommend recruitment decisions, compensation proposals, employee confirmations, promotions, transfers, and separations for management approval.
* Recommend amendments to HR policies, SOPs, organizational processes, and governance practices based on business requirements and statutory changes.
* Coordinate with departmental stakeholders to standardize operational processes, documentation, and workflow practices.
* Recommend HR process improvements, employee engagement initiatives, learning interventions, and organizational development programmes.

6\. Functional Competencies

* Human Resource Management
* Policy, Process \& Organizational Development
* HR Analytics \& Technology
* Labour Laws \& Statutory Compliance

7\. Behavioural Competencies

* Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
* Analytical Thinking \& Problem Solving
* Professional Integrity \& Confidentiality

8\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Time to Hire
* Offer Acceptance Rate
* Employee Retention Rate
* Performance Review Completion Rate
* Training Completion Rate
* Statutory Compliance Score
* HR Audit Score
* Attendance \& Payroll Input Accuracy
* Employee Engagement Score
* Timeliness \& Accuracy of HR MIS Reports

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹650,000\.00 per year

Education:

* Master's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Human resources management: 3 years (Required)
* Real estate Industry: 3 years (Required)

Location:

The role holder will lead a team of regional in charges and marketing managers and will be responsible for achieving the sales, collection and market penetration targets for the assigned zone. The role is responsible for ensuring review and adherence to zonal sales and accounting processes, dealer processes and new dealer appointments, new product and demand generation initiatives, accurate forecasting and inventory control in coordination with Supply Chain, resolution of customer complaints and other escalated issues.

**Strategic Responsibilities**

* Develop annual sales plan and budgets for the assigned zone (for example, sales revenues by product category, sales realization, new product sales).

title: Revenue Compensation Lead
description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**


We're looking for someone to join our Revenue Operations Team. **This is the first dedicated compensation headcount in the team** and will play a key role in scaling our compensation operations. This role sits at the intersection of operational rigor and cross\-functional partnership, focusing on administering compensation programs, building scalable processes, and ensuring our GTM teams are paid accurately and on time.


As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate with Legal, HR, Finance, and Sales Leadership to design and maintain the systems, workflows, and governance structures that power our variable compensation programs. This is an exciting opportunity to bring operational depth and analytical expertise to a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


In this role, you will be responsible for:

* **Process Design \& Maintenance** \- Design and maintain scalable processes that support efficient compensation administration, including payout cycles, reconciliations, and operational close processes.
* **Compensation Administration** \- Administer compensation plans, quotas, credits, adjustments, exceptions, and payout processes, ensuring accuracy and consistency across GTM teams.
* **Governance \& Compliance** \- Partner with Legal, HR, and Finance to support approvals, compliance, and audit requirements. Execute compensation letter generation, distribution, tracking, and record management.
* **Reporting \& Analytics** \- Develop dashboards, reports, and quality assurance processes that improve visibility, accuracy, and trust in compensation programs.
* **Field Support** \- Manage compensation\-related inquiries from GTM personnel, streamlining communication between field teams and back\-office functions. Build and maintain support resources, FAQs, documentation, and intake processes.

**Who you are**


We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

* Are **passionate about audio AI** driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.
* Are a **highly motivated and driven individual** with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.
* Are **analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges** with a first principles mindset.
* Consistently **strive for excellence**, delivering high\-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.
* **Take initiative and work autonomously** from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

**What you bring**

* **6\+ years of Compensation Operations, Revenue Operations, or Finance Operations** at high\-growth technology companies
* Demonstrated ability to build and improve scalable operational processes in high\-growth environments.
* Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps
* Foundational analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and process improvement.
* Comfort balancing strategic context with day\-to\-day operational execution.

**What we offer**

* **High\-velocity innovation:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **A truly global team:** Collaboration with teammates across 30\+ countries, a global customer footprint and office hubs in New York, London and Warsaw. Annual company offsite for the whole team to get together (the last one in Croatia!)
* **Remote first:** We prioritize your talent, not your location, with structured asynchronous workflows for maximum impact and minimal meetings.
* **Continuous growth**: Collaborate with AI leaders, shape your path, and contribute where you excel most.


This role is remote, so it can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York, London and Warsaw.


\#LI\-Remote

**Description**


Principal Compensation Analyst
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

* Conduct comprehensive market research using external salary surveys (e.g., Mercer, Radford) to gather data on competitor compensation practices for various job roles.
* Analyze market trends and identify industry benchmarks to assess company competitiveness.
* Conduct ad\-hoc market analysis to support specific compensation initiatives.
* Clean, manipulate, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources to generate actionable insights aligned to business strategy.
* Develop detailed reports and presentations showcasing compensation trends, market positioning, and recommendations for salary adjustments.
* Maintain salary ranges based on market data in alignment with company strategy.
* Annually review survey participation and budget and make recommendations for changes.
* Manage the annual survey matching process. Own the relationship with our survey providers. Maintain and enhance our market database.
* Explore new ways of working leveraging AI in benchmarking.


QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

* BA/BS degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or related field
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools
* Experience with compensation survey platforms
* Experience with Payfactors is a plus
* Strong understanding of compensation principles and best practices
* Ability to interpret complex data and translate insights into actionable recommendations
* Knowledge of industry trends and competitive landscape
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively present findings to senior management and HR stakeholders
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams

**Get to know Syneos Health**


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Summary**


Employees in the Total Rewards job family are responsible for all processes and teams associated with work across both compensation and benefits including compensation design and management, benefits design and management, executive rewards design and management, reward plan evaluation and analysis, reward plan communication and vendor management. Impact and Contribution Individual contributors with responsibility in a professional or technical discipline or specialty, but may manage two or fewer employees. May direct the work of lower level professionals or manage processes and programs. The majority of time is spent contributing to the design, implementation or delivery of processes, programs, and policies, using knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. Leading expert individual contributor who is viewed as a valuable resource by peers. Works to achieve organizational, functional, and/or business targets with measurable impact on department results. Manages or contributes to projects, programs, or processes that span multiple related areas. title: Solutions Engineer Intern
description:
FlytBase


Every drone deployment starts with a technical conversation across the globe \- you'll learn to own it. Master the art of solving Fortune 500, defense, and industrial customer problems, and turn autonomous systems into real\-world outcomes across six continents.


Solutions Engineering
 Pune, India (Onsite)
 Internship
 Fresher
  
### **What We Do**


FlytBase builds the world's leading Physical AI drone autonomy platform, powering mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Its customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole and Statnett. Explore some of our key deployments here \- flytbase.com/case\-studies. With a presence in the US and Pune, India, FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
### **The Role**


We’re scaling our Solution Engineering team and this role takes you global from Day 1\. You’ll work directly with enterprise customers across six continents, helping Fortune 500s, defense innovators, and industrial leaders deploy autonomous drone systems that change how the world operates. If you’re an early\-career engineer who’s built real projects (robots, drones, AI systems) and wants to solve global\-scale problems, this is your runway. You’ll travel across regions, engage with customers, and shape the future of autonomous operations. This isn’t a support role, it’s a strategic, problem\-solving seat where every decision you make drives technical and business outcomes worldwide.
### **What You'll Own**


• Be the global problem solver: Interact directly with customers across the US, Europe, APAC, LATAM, and the Middle East—understand their toughest autonomy challenges and turn them into executable solutions. • Own technical success: Lead onboarding, testing, deployment, and scaling of FlytBase systems—ensuring smooth, high\-impact rollouts for enterprise operations. • Drive customer conversations: You’ll be the technical face of FlytBase—running demos, guiding architecture discussions, and aligning on automation goals with CXOs and field engineers alike. • Go on\-site worldwide: Be hands\-on with live deployments—from configuring drone docks to testing mission automation in complex industrial environments. • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with product and engineering to convert customer feedback into tangible product improvements. • Design scalable workflows: Build automations and drone workflows that deliver measurable ROI for enterprises. • Leverage AI daily: Use ChatGPT, Claude, Rewind, and other AI tools to debug faster, analyze logs, automate responses, and scale your output. • Represent FlytBase globally: Attend trade shows, expos, and customer events to showcase how Physical AI is transforming industries. • Every customer, every mission, every trip—you’ll be operating at the intersection of AI, hardware, and global impact.
### **Best Suited For**


• Fresher or early\-career engineer with a technical background (Electronics, CS, Mechatronics, Robotics, or AI). • You’ve built something real—drones, robots, or AI/IoT systems—during college or internships. • Strong communication skills—you can talk code with engineers and clarity with executives. • Deep curiosity for how AI and autonomy can transform industries. • You take ownership—when something breaks, you fix it; when something’s unclear, you figure it out. Bonus Points • Hands\-on with PX4, ROS, Ardupilot, or DJI SDKs. • Experience using Postman, Python, APIs, or data integrations. • Exposure to AI/ML, computer vision, or autonomous navigation. • Comfortable documenting and explaining complex workflows through guides or videos. • Prior experience testing or flying drones (even hobby projects count).
### **What Makes You a Flyter**


• Deep curiosity for Physical AI: You have an insatiable appetite to learn about the Physical AI industry, drone autonomy, and emerging use cases. You're genuinely fascinated by how autonomous systems transform industrial operations. • High learning velocity: We know you might not know everything about our industry from day 1, but you have the grit and curiosity to learn fast. Once you've absorbed the knowledge, you work on autopilot mode (yes, like drones and robots) executing independently with minor course corrections. • Critical thinking \& needle\-moving focus: You think critically about priorities and focus your energy on activities that create real impact. You're not just busy—you're effective. • Ownership without oversight: We won't micromanage your customer conversations. We expect you to own technical outcomes and customer satisfaction, not just demo metrics. You plan milestones, stay proactive with customers, and anticipate their needs rather than just reacting to requests. • High trust, high candor: You give customers honest technical advice even when it's not what they want to hear. You surface implementation challenges early because you care about their success. The same applies internally—you maintain high trust and high candor with team members, giving and receiving direct feedback. • Velocity over perfection: You'd rather ship a working proof\-of\-concept this week than a perfect demo next month—customers buy solutions that solve problems today. • Full\-stack execution: When needed, you'll dive into code, build custom integrations, or jump on\-site for critical deployments. Job descriptions are starting points, not boundaries. • Joy in complexity: Enterprise drone deployments can be chaotic. But you find mazaa (fun) in turning customer confusion into clarity and technical challenges into competitive advantages.
### **What We Don't Want**


• Demo jockeys who celebrate presentation metrics over customer outcomes • "Relationship managers" who avoid getting their hands dirty with technical details • Feature showcasers who demo everything but solve nothing—we need problem solvers, not product tourists • Yes people who agree with every customer request without understanding feasibility, business impact, or the actual problem being solved • Handoff artists who disappear after the sale—we need partners who stay engaged through implementation and beyond • Documentation dodgers who avoid creating clear guides, tutorials, or technical content that scales customer success • Anyone who says "that's not my job" when customers need help • People who confuse being busy with being impactful—we care about customer success, not activity reports • One\-size\-fits\-all consultants who use the same approach for every customer instead of tailoring solutions to specific enterprise environments
### **Why FlytBase?**


• H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out. • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution. • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun. • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage. • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
### **The Perks**


• High agency team and sense of purpose • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet) • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most • Top\-tier health coverage for you • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out) • A damn good team to work with
### **Ready to Fly?**


If you're an engineer who wants to go global from Day 1, work with Fortune 500 customers, and learn how enterprise software gets deployed in the real world—this is your shot. FlytBase moves fast. Apply only if you're ready to match that speed.

**Role Overview**
 We're looking for a Data Enthusiast who combines strong data engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience applying machine learning in production. You'll build and scale data pipelines on Databricks, and partner closely with Data Science/Business Intelligence teams to operationalize models \- from feature engineering through deployment and monitoring as well as generating insights that create business impact
   

  

**Your Profile**
* Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Lakeflow/DLT, Unity Catalog)
* Develop and productionize feature pipelines for ML use cases, ensuring reliability, freshness, and reproducibility
* Collaborate with Data Scientists/ML Engineers to deploy models (batch and/or real\-time), including via Databricks Model Serving or ML flow
* Optimize Spark jobs, SQL warehouses, and cluster configurations for cost and performance
* Build and maintain system\-level observability for pipelines and ML jobs (usage, cost, quality, drift)
* Implement data quality checks, testing, and monitoring across the medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold)
* Own Unity Catalog governance for datasets and features — access controls, lineage, and PII masking
* Partner with platform/infra teams on job orchestration, CI/CD for data \& ML pipelines, and cost optimization
* Contribute to architecture decisions around lakehouse design, streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, and tool selection (build vs. buy)
* Perform analysis on top of the data you build, answer ad\-hoc business questions, validate metrics, and spot data quality issues before they reach stakeholders
* Evaluate and apply LLMs/agentic frameworks responsibly within the team, balancing accuracy, cost, and governance (e.g., row/column\-level access control on what an AI agent can query)


**Your Checklist**
* 1\-3 years of data engineering experience working on Databricks in production
* Strong proficiency in PySpark/Spark SQL and Python
* Solid understanding of Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow/DLT, and Databricks system tables (billing, compute, query history) Experience building and maintaining feature pipelines or ML data infrastructure (feature stores, training/serving data parity)
* Familiarity with MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry) and/or Databricks Model Serving
* Strong SQL skills and experience with warehouse performance tuning (query optimization, materialization strategies, cluster sizing)
* Understanding of ML fundamentals — enough to have real conversations with Data Scientists about features, drift, and model lifecycle (you don't need to be building models yourself, but you should understand what "good" looks like)


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with real\-time/streaming architectures (Structured Streaming, Kafka, Lakebase or similar)
* Exposure to LLM/agentic tooling (Databricks Genie, RAG pipelines, vector search)
* Experience with cost governance/FinOps for Databricks workloads

title: Call Center Senior Representative
description:
**Req ID:** 378847
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Call Center Senior Representative to join our team in Gurugram, Haryāna (IN\-HR), India (IN).
  
  

**"Job description:****About NTT DATA:**  

With people at the heart of our success, NTT DATA is committed to attracting and growing the best talent and providing an environment where everyone feels they can belong and their contribution matters. It’s our belief in possibility that drives us, but it’s our people that make it happen. At NTT DATA, what you do matters.
  
  

**A Career at NTT DATA Means:**  

* Having ongoing opportunities to GROW your career\- we offer barrier\-free learning with multiple self\-learning tools available.
* Being part of a global organization where you can BELONG \- in an inclusive working environment where you are free to be your best self. We’re committed to building a people\-focused environment where you can shine, no matter who you are.
* Belonging to a team where you can make a DIFFERENCE \- to your clients, colleagues, and communities. Your ideas are embraced, impactful, and keep us agile.
* Being part of a global PIONEER – where you gain exposure to our Fortune 500 clients and world\-leading global technology partners and work with a network of over 40,000 smart and diverse colleagues across 57 countries, delivering services in over 200 countries.


**Work Schedule Benefits:**  

* Shift Timing: US–Canada Shift (Night Shift – aligned to North American time zones)
* Working Hours: 10 hours per shift (including breaks as per company policy)
* Work Mode: 100% Work from Office
* Transportation: Company\-provided pick\-up and drop facility (for night shifts)


**Role Summary:**  

Entry\-level outbound sales role responsible for engaging Canada\-based customers, promoting telecom products/services, and driving revenue through consultative selling.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Make high\-volume outbound calls to prospective and existing customers
* Promote telecom products (plans, upgrades, bundles, retention offers)
* Understand customer needs and recommend tailored solutions
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets
* Handle objections and rejections professionally
* Maintain accurate CRM records (calls, conversions, follow\-ups)
* Ensure compliance with scripts, quality, and process standards
* Deliver strong customer experience while maximizing revenue


**Required Skills:**  

* Strong communication with neutral/clear English accent
* Sales mindset with persuasive ability
* Active listening and customer empathy
* Resilience and ability to handle rejection
* Basic system/CRM handling


**Eligibility:**  

* Graduate (flexible based on communication skills)
* 0–2 years of experience (freshers welcome; BPO/sales preferred)"


About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
  
  

NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
