description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.


* Manage the Indirect Channel Partners agreements and due diligence.
* Manage the Securimate platform and making sure it is always updated.
* Conduct the screening and evaluation the indirect channel partners.
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure business continuity.
* Leading the development, monitoring, coordination, and implementation of SOPs in India

**OFFICE SUPPORT CAREER STREAM:** Individual contributors who provide organizational related support or service (administrative or clerical) for other members within the organization. The majority of time is spent in the delivery of support services or activities, typically under supervision.


**DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS**

**Autonomy:** Entry\-level position typically requiring little to no prior experience.
  

Works on well\-defined administrative and clerical tasks.
  

Work is routine or follows standard procedures and is closely supervised.


**Organizational Impact:** Works to deliver on day\-to\-day objectives with some impact on achievement of results for the job area, including limited disruption or expense.
  

Delivers job responsibilities following a defined standard output or set of procedures.


**Innovation and Complexity:** Provides data and information when minor changes may be required based on review.
  

Problems faced are routine and solutions clearly prescribed.


**Communication and Influence:** Communicates with contacts typically within immediate job area.
  

Obtains and provides information requiring little explanation or interpretation.


**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* B.com/ BBA / BMS \- 2025 or 2026 pass out (freshers)
Should not hold PF account. No backlogs.  
* 

**Physical Job Requirements**  

  

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌


**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:  



  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.  



  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.  



  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.  



  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .
‌  



**Benefits \& Compensation**
============================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

title: Academic Career Counselor
description:
Job Description: Career Counselor – EdTech Company

**Job Title:** Career Counselor  
**Department:** Student Success / Admissions  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience Required:** 1–3 years  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamilnadu  
**Salary:** ₹10000 to ₹20000 per month

Job Summary

We are looking for an enthusiastic and student\-focused Career Counselor to guide students and working professionals in selecting suitable courses and career paths. The candidate will understand learners’ educational backgrounds, interests, skills, and career goals and recommend appropriate training programs.

Key Responsibilities

* Counsel students and professionals through phone calls, online meetings, and face\-to\-face interactions.
* Understand each learner’s educational background, interests, strengths, and career objectives.
* Recommend suitable technical, placement\-focused, and professional\-development courses.
* Clearly explain course curriculum, duration, fees, certifications, placement assistance, and career opportunities.
* Follow up with prospective learners and support them throughout the admission process.
* Convert qualified enquiries into course enrolments while maintaining ethical counseling practices.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, follow\-ups, counseling sessions, and enrolments in the CRM.
* Conduct career\-awareness sessions, seminars, webinars, and orientation programs.
* Coordinate with academic, training, marketing, and placement teams.
* Build positive relationships with students, parents, colleges, and institutional partners.
* Collect learner feedback and help improve the counseling and admission experience.
* Achieve assigned monthly counseling and enrolment targets.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Education, Human Resources, Marketing, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in career counseling, academic counseling, admissions, education sales, or EdTech.
* Freshers with excellent communication and counseling skills may also be considered.
* Good understanding of higher education, skill\-development programs, and employment trends.
* Fluency in English and at least one regional language.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and active\-listening skills.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, and persuasion abilities.
* Empathy and a genuine interest in helping learners build their careers.
* Ability to understand learner requirements and recommend appropriate programs.
* Good follow\-up, relationship\-management, and negotiation skills.
* Basic knowledge of CRM systems, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace.
* Ability to work independently and achieve enrolment targets without compromising counseling quality.

Preferred Skills

* Experience counseling students for IT, software development, placement training, or professional certification programs.
* Familiarity with courses such as Java, Python, C, C\+\+, Full\-Stack Development, Data Science, Cloud Computing, and DevOps.
* Experience working with colleges, training institutes, or online learning platforms.

Performance Indicators

* Number of counseling sessions completed.
* Lead\-to\-enrolment conversion rate.
* Quality and consistency of follow\-ups.
* Student satisfaction and retention.
* Accuracy of CRM records.
* Achievement of monthly enrolment targets.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Training on courses, counseling methods, and EdTech solutions.
* Professional growth opportunities in admissions, student success, and business development.
* Supportive and learner\-focused work environment.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Description – Accountant**

**Job Title:** Jr.Accountant  
**Department:** Finance \& Accounts  
**Location:** General park, Medical devices park, plot no G11 \& G12, IP, Sultanpur, Hyderabad, Telangana 502319  
**Company:** Vibrant Construction Equipments Pvt. Ltd.  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Shift:** Day Shift

**Intrested Candidates share your CV to:** hr@vibrantengineering.com or 9247571581

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and experienced Accountant to manage day\-to\-day accounting operations, statutory compliance, financial reporting, and payroll\-related activities. The ideal candidate should possess strong accounting knowledge, excellent analytical skills, and experience in a manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in maintaining day\-to\-day accounting records and financial transactions.
* Prepare and record journal entries, payment vouchers, and receipts.
* Support Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) activities.
* Assist in bank reconciliations and ledger reconciliations.
* Maintain invoices, bills, vouchers, and other financial documents.
* Support GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and Professional Tax documentation and filings.
* Assist in payroll data verification and salary\-related documentation.
* Prepare basic MIS reports using Microsoft Excel.
* Coordinate with internal departments for financial documentation.
* Support internal and statutory audit activities.
* Ensure proper filing and maintenance of financial records.
* Perform other accounting and administrative tasks assigned by the Finance team.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* B.Com / M.Com graduates (2024, 2025, or 2026 pass\-outs).
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with internship or training experience in Accounts will have an added advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of accounting principles.
* Familiarity with Tally ERP/Tally Prime is preferred.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new processes.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic understanding of GST, TDS, PF, and ESI.
* Exposure to ERP software through academic projects or internships.
* Knowledge of accounting documentation and bookkeeping.

**Key Competencies**

* Positive attitude and willingness to learn
* Integrity and confidentiality
* Time management
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Attention to detail
* Problem\-solving ability

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive salary as per company standards.
* On\-the\-job training and mentorship.
* Statutory benefits as per company policy.
* Career growth opportunities within the organization.

**Experience:** Fresher (0–1 Year)

**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com

**Industry Preference:** Freshers interested in Manufacturing / Engineering / Non\-IT Finance

Pay: ₹275,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented HR Executive to manage end\-to\-end recruitment, employee documentation, and onboarding activities. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, strong coordination abilities, and a good understanding of HR processes.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment for various positions.

* Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic interviews.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with hiring managers.
* Maintain candidate database and recruitment tracker.
* Follow up with shortlisted candidates and manage interview feedback.
* Coordinate salary negotiations and offer roll\-out.

Documentation

* Collect and verify employee documents before joining.
* Ensure completion of joining formalities and employment documentation.
* Maintain employee personal files and HR records.
* Update employee information in the HRMS.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and statutory documentation.

Onboarding

* Conduct employee induction and orientation sessions.
* Share company policies, code of conduct, and organizational information with new joiners.

HR Operations

* Prepare recruitment and onboarding reports.
* Maintain employee attendance and joining records.
* Coordinate with departments for probation confirmation and employee feedback.
* Support employee engagement and HR initiatives.
* Perform other HR\-related tasks assigned by management.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good knowledge of recruitment and onboarding processes.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Experience working with HRMS and job portals (Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, etc.).
* Good documentation and record management skills.
* Ability to multitask and work within deadlines.

Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or any graduate (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).

Experience

* **0–2 years** of experience in Recruitment and HR Operations.
* Freshers with good communication skills and HR knowledge may also apply.

Marketing

### **What We Do**


FlytBase builds the world's leading Physical AI drone autonomy platform, powering mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Its customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole and Statnett. Explore some of our key deployments here \- flytbase.com/case\-studies. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
### **The Role**


We're looking for a motion graphics intern who can jump in and start producing from day one—this is a working role, not a shadowing one. You'll be handed real briefs for product explainers, social content, and campaign videos, and expected to take them from concept to final render with the design team's support, not their supervision. You'll also be expected to use AI video and animation tools as part of your everyday workflow to move fast. If you need heavy hand\-holding to get started, this isn't the right fit—but if you're ready to own tasks end\-to\-end and learn on the job by actually doing the job, this is for you.
### **What You'll Own**


• AI\-Native Motion: Use tools like Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Veo 2, and AnimateDiff as part of your daily workflow to generate and refine motion assets. • Multi\-Format Animation: Independently produce motion graphics for social content, product explainers, ads, and internal videos, start to finish. • Storytelling: Turn product and technical ideas into clear, compelling animated content with minimal briefing. • 3D \& Editing: Animate and composite 3D renders and video edits for live campaigns. • Reusable Systems: Use and help build motion templates and design systems the team relies on.
### **Best Suited For**


• Working proficiency in After Effects and Premiere Pro (or equivalent)—comfortable enough to execute independently, not just follow tutorials. • Hands\-on experience with at least one AI video/motion tool, or the ability to pick one up and be productive within days. • A reel of real work—personal, freelance, or college projects—that shows you can take an idea through to a finished, polished piece on your own. • Solid grasp of timing, pacing, and visual storytelling fundamentals. • Comfortable taking a brief and running with it, asking sharp questions instead of waiting to be told each step. • You've seen every corner of Pinterest and have curated boards for all your visual ideas.
### **What Makes You a Flyter**


• AI\-first mindset: You already reach for AI tools to move faster, not just when told to. • Ready to ship: You can take a task from brief to final output without needing it broken down for you. • Ownership without oversight: You manage your own tasks and flag blockers early instead of waiting. • High trust, high candor: You give and receive sharp feedback early. • Reliable: You follow through on what you commit to, on time.
### **What We Don't Want**


• Interns looking for a resume line with no real involvement. • People who need step\-by\-step hand\-holding to get started on a task. • Those who avoid AI tools or treat them as optional. • Anyone who confuses hours worked with value created.
### **Why FlytBase?**


• H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out. • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution. • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun. • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage. • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
### **The Perks**


• High agency team and sense of purpose • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet) • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most • Top\-tier health coverage for you • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out) • A damn good team to work with
### **Ready to Fly?**


If you're tired of waiting for someone to give you a chance and ready to prove what you can do, let's talk. Send us your portfolio and show us why you're the kind of person who raises the bar.

title: Intern Recruitment
description:
**What you’d be doing?** 




  





**Recruitment for our clients \-** 



* when a brand trusts us to hire for them, we take that very
 **seriously**
* this means understanding the role properly, not just dumping candidate profiles on them
* screening candidates, shortlisting, and making sure we’re recommending the right people, not just more people
* speaking to candidates \- over calls, video calls, assessing intent, clarity, and fit



 (this is the part which gets a little grunt\-y, but matters the most)
 



  





 We still call ourselves 100% human led hiring, and no AI \- because you can’t fully “systemise” taste yet, especially for marketing, brand, design roles (what we specialise in) so we rely a lot on judgment, curation, conversations, and gut (we do rely on AI for our internal ops)
 



  





**What we do at Palette Hire ?** 




 We hire for some of the most interesting consumer brands in india right now. brands that you see on
 **Instagram, Zepto, Blinkit, Shark tank,** 
 or that one ad everyone’s talking about \- there’s a high chance we’re hiring for them or have hired for them. we sit at the intersection of hiring \+ internet \+ culture \& we care a lot about taste (which is mostly our edge)
 



  





 Who you are?
 


* have some prior internship / experience in recruitment or HR (nothing like it)
* chronically online (you just
 *know* 
 what’s happening/ pop culture references/ who’s funded who)
* fluent with communication \- this is a deal breaker unfortunately :/
* curious, sharp, and ask good questions (we don’t mind avg quality questions after office hours)
* don’t wait to be told every little thing
* generally positive, you figure things out
* you do not shy away from initiating conversations with people, the role requires getting on calls with candidates/ clients/ xyz vendors \- on a day to day basis



  





 What is it like, working with us?
 


* very collaborative \- we’ll talk through most things
* we’ll give context, not just tasks
* we care about good work and good taste (that’s why we get paid by clients)
* we’re direct, but fair
* curious about emerging tech (will make sure it passes on to you)
* if you’re curious and take initiative, you’ll genuinely enjoy this



  





  





 Apply only if you’re willing to commit a minimum of 90 days. this works best when you stay.
 



  





 Internship pays between 12 to 15k PM

title: Senior Payroll Manager of APAC Operations
description:
* Req ID \#: 234830
* Bengaluru, Karnataka, IN;
* Ahmedabad, Gujarat, IN;
  

Hyderabad, Telangana, IN;
  

Mumbai, Mumbai, IN
* 1st
* Full time


  
For 75 years, Charles River employees have worked together to assist in the discovery, development and safe manufacture of new drug therapies. When you join our family, you will have a significant impact on the health and well\-being of people across the globe. Whether your background is in life sciences, finance, IT, sales or another area, your skills will play an important role in the work we perform. In return, we’ll help you build a career that you can feel passionate about.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The **Senior Manager, APAC Payroll Operations** is responsible for leading payroll operations across the Asia\-Pacific (APAC) region, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery while supporting the organization’s global payroll strategy. This role provides leadership to regional payroll teams, drives operational excellence, oversees payroll implementations and transitions, and partners closely with HR, Finance, IT, and external payroll providers. The position reports directly to the Global Director, Payroll Operations.


Position will be located in India.


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
------------------------------------------


**Payroll \& T\&A Operations:**


* Lead end\-to\-end payroll operations across assigned APAC countries, ensuring payrolls are processed accurately, on time, and in compliance with local legislation.
* Manage payroll and Time \& Attendance operations, ensuring data integrity and identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.
* Standardize and continuously improve payroll processes while balancing global consistency with local country requirements.
* Ensure compliance with country\-specific tax regulations, statutory reporting, social insurance, and payroll\-related legislation.
* Oversee payroll reconciliations, audits, and year\-end activities while ensuring all payroll records are maintained in accordance with company policies.
* Manage relationships with external payroll providers to ensure service quality, compliance, and performance expectations are met.

**Payroll Implementations \& Projects:**


* Lead payroll implementations, system upgrades, and country transitions as part of global payroll transformation initiatives.
* Support mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and new country implementations across the APAC region.
* Participate in continuous process improvement initiatives that enhance payroll efficiency and employee experience

**Compliance \& Risk Management:**


* Monitor legislative and regulatory changes throughout the APAC region and ensure payroll operations remain fully compliant.
* Provide guidance and training to payroll teams regarding legislative changes and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the primary regional lead for Sarbanes\-Oxley (SOX) payroll controls and internal compliance activities.
* Identify operational risks, escalate issues appropriately, and implement sustainable corrective actions.

**Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration:**


* Develop strong partnerships with regional HR, Finance, Tax, Legal, IT, and external payroll vendors.
* Support the execution of the global payroll operating model while ensuring regional requirements are addressed.
* Monitor payroll KPIs, SLAs, and operational metrics, providing regular reporting and recommendations to leadership.
* Collaborate with global payroll leadership to drive consistency, governance, and best practices across all regions.

**Team Leadership \& Development:**


* Lead, coach, and develop the APAC Payroll Operations team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings, performance reviews, development planning, and succession planning.
* Promote employee engagement and professional development while maintaining high performance standards.
* Drive operational excellence through process optimization, technology adoption, and knowledge sharing.

**Other Responsibilities**:


* Monitor vendor performance, contractual obligations, and associated costs.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency while maintaining service quality and compliance.
**QUALIFICATIONS:**
-------------------


**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, or a related discipline required. MBA, CPA, CPP, or equivalent professional certification preferred.


**Experience:**


* Minimum of 10 years of progressive payroll leadership experience, including management of multi\-country payroll operations within the APAC region.
* Demonstrated experience leading payroll implementations, system migrations, or global payroll transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing outsourced payroll providers and vendor relationships.
* Strong knowledge of APAC payroll legislation, tax regulations, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Previous people leadership experience managing geographically dispersed teams.
* Experience working within a multinational, matrixed organization preferred.

**Preferred Experience:**


* Managing payroll operations across multiple APAC countries such as Australia, New Zealand, China, Japan, Singapore, India, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, South Korea, Vietnam, and Hong Kong.
* Experience implementing or supporting global payroll systems such as ADP GlobalView, ADP Celergo, SAP Payroll, or similar enterprise payroll solutions.
* Experience leading payroll transitions, acquisitions, divestitures, and payroll vendor consolidations.
* Experience driving payroll process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives within a global organization.

**Skills:**


* Fluent written and spoken English is required.
* Additional APAC language skills are considered an asset.
* Strong project management and implementation experience.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Experience with global payroll systems, HRIS platforms, and Time \& Attendance solutions.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and reporting skills preferred.
**About Corporate Functions**
  

The Corporate Functions provide operational support across Charles River in areas such as Human Resources, Finance, IT, Legal, Sales, Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Corporate Development. They partner with their colleagues across the company to develop and drive strategies and to set global standards. The functions are essential to providing a bridge between strategic vision and operational readiness, to ensure ongoing functional innovation and capability improvement.


**About Charles River**
  

Charles River is an early\-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non\-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.


With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.


At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. title: Asia Pacific Senior Finance Analyst
description:
**Locations**: Gurgaon \| Kuala Lumpur


Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


This role sits at the intersection of people analytics and AI\-enabled workflow automation, while also supporting selected strategic People initiatives across BCG’s Asia Pacific region.

  

You will own core regional people reporting and analytics, while working closely with your manager on high\-priority initiatives such as People Survey transformation, AP AI Boost Project, Talent 2030 and more. You will own defined analyses and project workstreams—from structuring the problem and conducting analysis to synthesizing insights and preparing materials for senior stakeholders.

  

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical rigor with structured problem solving, curiosity and a hands\-on approach to using AI tools to improve how work gets done.

 **Essential duties and responsibilities:**

 **1\. People Analytics and Reporting**

 **Monthly People Metrics Reporting**

* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of monthly capacity and attrition analyses, from processing source data to identifying key trends, surfacing discrepancies against the global dashboard, investigating underlying drivers, and aligning on the appropriate approach to resolution
* Coordinate inputs across AP people teams, manage release timelines, and ensure the monthly reporting is delivered accurately and on schedule
* Proactively translate analysis into clear insights and potential next steps, aligning with senior stakeholders where appropriate

**People Survey and Pulse Survey**

* Work closely with your manager to shape the design and execution of AP’s new People Survey analytics approach under the updated global survey tools, including identifying opportunities to enhance analysis and reporting with AI
* Develop targeted data cuts, trend views and follow\-up analyses to uncover underlying drivers and support interpretation and communication of People Survey results in AP
* Coordinate with the Global People Team on survey administration; Manage analytical requests from AP systems as part of the survey process (scope may evolve as new tools are rolled out)

**Planning Cycle Support**

* Act as PoC for People Function post planning process, obtaining plan data from Finance and coordinating across People and Finance stakeholders on data requests and validation
* Analyze how capacity and workforce composition evolve across the planning cycle, highlighting key movements and implications for the AP People function

**Other Regular/ad\-hoc Reporting**

* Own other recurring analytical reports, including BST ratios analysis, leverage analysis, APPT Scorecard, attrition analysis, FTE analysis and CDA survey analysis; take on additional ad\-hoc or regular analyses as business priorities evolve
* With oversight from your manager, prepare senior\-ready materials on attrition, recruiting and capacity for leadership discussions, and respond to follow\-up questions through targeted analysis

**2\. AI Workflow and Automation**

* Build and maintain AI\-enabled reporting workflows, including automating recurring reports and dashboards developed in collaboration with your manager
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify and automate recurring AP People function processes; propose and execute improvements under the guidance of your manager
* Document and share your approaches with the AP People team and regional office colleagues, enabling broader adoption and continuous improvement

**3\. Strategic People Projects Support**

* Provide analytical and project support across strategic regional People initiatives, including REACHES (AP HR transformation), AI Boost Talent Pillar (AP program to accelerate AI upskilling), Talent 2030, Strategic Workforce planning, as well as other projects that emerge over time
* Own defined analyses or project workstreams with oversight from your manager, from structuring the question and developing the approach to synthesizing findings into clear, senior\-ready outputs

**4\. Reporting Operations and Data Quality**

* Maintain clear documentation of data sources, definitions, methodologies and reporting processes to ensure continuity, consistency and transparency across People Analytics
* Proactively identify and resolve data discrepancies, working with source teams to investigate root causes and implement sustainable solutions

**5\. Network**

* Proactively engage with BCG’s global analytics team to stay current on available tools, reporting standards and best practices, while surfacing AP\-specific needs and perspectives
* Build working relationships with people analytics peers in EMESA and NAMR to share approaches and align on common methodologies where relevant
* Maintain strong relationship with BCG’s system HR teams, particularly in the context of people survey coordination and AP data analysis requests

  

What You'll Bring

**EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor degree in Business, Computer Science, Statistics, Human Resources, or related disciplines combined with 4 to 6 years working experience; Previous experience in consulting, analytics, or other structured problem\-solving environment is a strong plus
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (such as Claude Code) alongside Python and Power Automate to build, maintain and improve automated reporting workflows. Familiarity with HR data and Workday is a plus.
* Strong analytical acumen and rigor about data accuracy, with a habit of cross\-checking and triangulating figures before releasing outputs to stakeholders. Strong creative problem solving with ability to craft tailored solutions to meet the wide range of business needs.
* Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail; able to manage multiple workstreams, meet deadlines and flag issues proactively. Comfortable working in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment with direction from a senior manager.

  

Who You'll Work With


You will report into the Asia Pacific (AP) Consulting (CT) Performance \& Change Senior Manager and be part of the AP People Team.

  

You will work closely with your manager on a day\-to\-day basis. You will also work directly on requests from senior People function leaders including the AP Consulting People Team Executive Director, the AP CHRO and AP People Chair. Beyond this, you will interact with peers across the AP People function (recruiting, career development \& staffing, Teaming, etc.), AP Finance function, EMESA/NAMR People function and BCG’s global analytics teams

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Senior Manager, People & Culture (EAII Advisors)
description:
**This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.**
**About EAII**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
   

  

**About Evidence Action**
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel\-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

**The Role**
 EAII is seeking a Senior Manager to join our People \& Culture (P\&C) team. The Senior Manager will play a key role in supporting the Director of P\&C in developing and implementing P\&C strategies, policies, and programs. The Senior Manager will be responsible for overseeing various HR functions, including employee relations, HR Operations, talent management, performance management, payroll and multi\-state compliance. The Senior Manager will also contribute to shaping the organization's HR initiatives, driving employee engagement, and ensuring the effective management of our human capital.
   

  

 If you are a collaborative leader with a passion for HR excellence and a commitment to building a positive and inclusive workplace culture in a fast\-paced, growth\-focused environment, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 This role will have three direct reports, with the potential for additional direct reports based in Delhi / other states as the team grows.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
***Strategic HR Leadership***
* Partner with senior leadership to align HR strategies with organizational goals, ensuring a positive and high\-performing work environment
* Support employee engagement by developing programs that enhance morale, satisfaction, and overall experience
* Serve as a strategic advisor to the Director of P\&C, providing insights and recommendations on organizational design, workforce planning, and change management.
* Anticipate future talent and organizational needs as Evidence Action India scales across states, contributing to long\-term workforce planning.


***People Operations***
* Lead HR operations, ensuring compliance with all applicable labor laws, internal policies, and best practices
* Manage the end\-to\-end payroll process across all states for all employees, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant execution every cycle
* Oversee HR policies, procedures, and the employee handbook, keeping them up to date and relevant
* Oversee employee relations, ensuring fair conflict resolution, grievance handling, and disciplinary processes
* Lead and manage HR budgets, including quarterly budget reviews, and optimize resources to support strategic HR initiatives
* Streamline and standardize policies and processes across all states in which EAII operates, ensuring consistency, compliance, and operational efficiency throughout
* Own and manage Total Rewards end\-to\-end, including providing compensation structuring and benchmarking support, insurance management and renewals, and managing other employee benefits
* Drive process improvement and analytics across P\&C, using data\-driven insights to streamline workflows and inform decision\-making
* Own and drive the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle, from onboarding and integration through ongoing engagement, development, and offboarding, ensuring a seamless, consistent, and positive experience at every touchpoint


***Talent Development***
* Lead performance management, including goal setting, feedback cycles, and development plans
* Develop and implement training programs, supporting continuous learning and leadership growth
* Lead employee reward and recognition programs to ensure employees feel valued, appreciated and motivated


***Employee Engagement***
* Develop and implement employee engagement strategies, including annual engagement survey feedback analysis and other feedback mechanisms, to continuously enhance workplace culture
* Promote work\-life balance initiatives, wellness programs, and mental health support to ensure overall employee well\-being
* Foster a culture of open communication and transparency, creating an environment where employees feel heard, supported, and empowered
* Organize and facilitate team\-building activities, employee events, and leadership forums to strengthen Evidence Action culture


**Requirements**
* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field. Relevant HR certifications (e.g., SHRM\-CP/SCP, PHR) desirable
* Proven experience (minimum 12 years) in HR management roles, with a focus on payroll, labour law compliances, employee relations, talent management, and HR operations
* In\-depth knowledge of HR principles, practices, and employment laws and regulations
* Experience within the social impact or development sector is preferred, particularly in organizations involved in large\-scale program implementation Demonstrated leadership and team management abilities, with the capacity to motivate and develop HR professionals
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Experience in handling employee relations issues, conflict resolution, and maintaining a positive work environment
* Sound understanding of talent management and engagement strategies, performance management processes, and employee development initiatives
* Familiarity with HRIS systems and proficiency in HR data analysis and reporting
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously, delivering high\-quality results within deadlines
* Ethical and discreet handling of sensitive and confidential information
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to make informed decisions based on data and HR best practices


**Position Location**
 New Delhi, India.
   

  

 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.
   

  

**Benefits**
 EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:
   

  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Mental and physical well\-being benefits
* Learning and Development benefit
* Generous leave
* Avenues for engagement and recognition


 Compensation: Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
   

  

 All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.
   

  

 Note: This role will be open for applications until July 29, 2026\. Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.

title: [GSD] People Technology Manager - Workday Implementation Team (Bangkok based, relocation provided )
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get to Know our Team:** 
  

  

 The Global Service Delivery (GSD) team is responsible for Agoda’s office infrastructure and staff connectivity, providing the hardware, software, and system access that enable employees to work efficiently across our global offices. Operating across multiple countries, the team delivers reliable support to Agoda employees whether they are in the office, working remotely, or traveling.
   

  

 Within GSD, the
 **People Technology (HR Tech) team** 
 manages the systems that power Agoda’s people operations. Our platforms, including Workday, support key HR processes such as employee lifecycle management, performance reviews, and organizational data, helping the company scale efficiently while improving employee experience.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Agoda is looking for a
 **People Technology Manager (Implementation Team)** 
 to lead our
 **Workday Functional Team** 
 and play a pivotal role in transforming how technology supports our global People operations.
   

  

 Working across platforms such as
 **Workday, Zendesk, and Greenhouse** 
 , you will lead the implementation of new Workday modules, revamp existing capabilities, and drive continuous improvements across Agoda’s HR technology ecosystem.
   

  

 You will be a key driver of Agoda’s
 **HR Tech Transformation journey** 
 , helping implement solutions such as
 **Workday Journeys** 
 and contributing to the organization’s
 **Workday** 
**AI agent roadmap** 
 . You will also evaluate current module design, identify enhancement opportunities, and present strategic recommendations to senior leaders within the People team.
   

  

 In addition, this role offers the opportunity to work closely with Agoda’s Technology teams to explore and build hybrid solutions for emerging HR Tech use cases.
   

  

**In This Role, You'll Get To**
* Develop the technical roadmap and implementation plan for Agoda’s HR Tech transformation journey, in partnership with the People Tech PMO Manager.
* Assess current functional configurations and identify continuous improvement opportunities to reduce technical debt, while shaping governance for application management, change requests, and project implementation best practices in partnership with the People Tech Operational Excellence Manager.
* Lead a team of experienced SMEs in implementing, enhancing, and revamping Workday modules across Agoda.
* Strengthen team capability, technical portfolio, and organizational resiliency through talent development and capability building.
* Define and drive OKRs aligned to the HR Tech transformation journey together with People Tech Leadership
* Partner closely with key leaders across Agoda to align HR technology initiatives with business priorities.


**What You'll Need To Succeed**
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading cross\-functional teams, preferably in a Workday environment
* Proven experience driving HR digital transformation across platforms such as Workday, Zendesk, ServiceNow, and Greenhouse, including end\-to\-end implementation delivery
* Strong understanding of Scrum ceremonies and experience operating effectively in an Agile environment
* Good knowledge of the Workday SKU landscape, including Journeys, Recruiting, Position Management, AI Agents, and Adaptive Planning
* Solid understanding of the hire\-to\-retire lifecycle, with the ability to translate business requirements into an HR transformation roadmap
* Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving edge cases, dependencies, and potential risks
* Strong team player with a high sense of ownership, able to contribute subject\-matter expertise while collaborating to solve complex challenges
* Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement initiatives that simplify processes, enhance scalability, and reduce operational complexity
* Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities, with experience partnering effectively across cross\-functional teams
* Ability to use data and analytics to generate insights and support informed decision\-making
* Fluent in written and spoken English


**It's Great If You Have**
* Workday Techno\-functional skills

title: Benefits Analyst, Total Rewards
description:
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly\-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly\-Clark, it’s all here for you—innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.



You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground\-breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.



**About You**

You perform at the highest level possible, and you appreciate a performance culture fueled by authentic caring. You want to be part of a company actively dedicated to sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development.



In one of our professional roles, you’ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the center.



To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:



Provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to Kimberly\-Clark's International Benefits and Wellbeing programs. The role is responsible for coordinating benefit activities, maintaining accurate records, benefits inventory and documentation, supporting employee and stakeholder enquiries, managing vendor interactions, and ensuring the smooth administration of benefit and wellbeing programs across multiple countries.



Working closely with the International Benefits team, vendors, HR Operations, Payroll, and local country teams, the Benefits Administrator will help ensure benefits and wellbeing programs are delivered efficiently, accurately, and in line with established processes and timelines.



**Principal Accountabilities****:**


**Benefits Administration**


* Provide day\-to\-day administration and coordination support for International Benefits and Wellbeing programmes.
* Respond to routine enquiries and maintain accurate benefits records, documentation, and trackers.
* Take ownership of the global benefits inventory system, ensure information is accurate and up to date, managing regular periodic reviews and running reports as required
* Support the implementation and ongoing administration of benefit initiatives and programmes including the ownership and maintenance of a benefits inventory


**Benefits Renewals \& Governance**


* Maintain renewal trackers and support the coordination of annual benefit renewals.
* Communicate captive approvals and renewal updates to relevant stakeholders.
* Proactively engage country contacts to gather feedback and identify potential plan changes.
* Ensure benefit policy documentation is accurately maintained and stored \& benefits inventory updated as required.


**Benefits Platform Administration**


* Support People Solutions in the ongoing administration of KonneCted our UK Benefit administration platform
* Assist with annual enrolment project \& activities, system updates, testing, communications, and user support.


**Computershare / SharePlus Administration**


* Support the administration of SharePlus and other employee share plans.
* Coordinate monthly submissions with local country teams and vendors.
* Manage operational queries, access requests, reporting requirements, and issue resolution with Computershare.


**Vendor \& Financial Administration**


* Support benefit vendor administration incl onboarding \& set up, purchase order setup and maintenance.
* Liaise with vendors and internal stakeholders to facilitate timely processing of invoices and related activities.


**EAP \& Wellbeing Administration**


* Coordinate TELUS Health wellbeing activities, webinar requests, and training support.
* Monitor webinar utilisation against contracted hours and assist with query resolution.
* Maintain attendance records and distribute participation and feedback reports to stakeholders.


**Communications \& Content Management**


* Maintain benefits and wellbeing content on internal employee platforms\- KC\&ME.
* Support the publication and updating of articles, and resources.
* Coordinate requests and updates through established internal processes.


**Project \& Team Support**


* Provide administrative support for ad\-hoc benefit\- related projects and initiatives.
* Coordinate meetings, documentation, action tracking, and project activities as required.
* Undertake additional benefits administration and operational support activities as assigned.


**Employee Experience \& Stakeholder Support**


* Serve as a key contact for Regional Total Reward teams, and local stakeholders on benefit administration matters.
* Coordinate responses to routine benefit enquiries and support issue resolution with vendors and internal teams.


**Minimum Requirements****:**


* Experience in benefits administration, HR administration, payroll administration, or a similar operational support role.
* Demonstrated analytical and PC skills in performance of complex analysis and modeling
* Knowledge \& experience with Workday\& SAP, preferred.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
* Experience maintaining records, trackers, and process documentation.


***Critical Skills/Qualifications:***


* Strong organisational and administrative skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with global teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Ability to learn and use HR, benefits, and vendor management systems.
* High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion.


**Led by Purpose. Driven by You.**



**To Be Considered**  

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.



In the meantime, please check out the careers website.



**And finally, the fine print….**  

For Kimberly\-Clark to grow and prosper, we must be an inclusive organization that applies the diverse experiences and passions of its team members to brands that make life better for people all around the world, which is why we seek to build a workforce that encompasses the experiences of our consumers. When you bring your original thinking to Kimberly\-Clark, you fuel the continued success of our enterprise. We are a committed equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Employment is subject to verification of local policies.

title: HR Associate Partner
description:
**Description**
 The Human Resource Associate Partner role provides support to the management team in a variety of administrative and regular operation tasks.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Clear flags in systems and assess attendance point for associates for unexcused absences.
* Collect/organize time off request forms for Amazonians from managers and associates. Get approvals from managers for vacation requests as required.
* Ensure proper coding of “time paid not work” and “time not paid, not worked” such as Vacation (vacp)/Paid Personal Time (pers)/Voluntary
* Time\-off (vto)/Lack of Work (low) for Amazon associates.
* Make points corrections for staffing agency as directed by Amazon Human Resources (HR)
* Make points corrections for Amazon associates as directed by site leaders or Human Resources
* Identify, track and reconcile missing: in, out and lunch punches
* With manager approval, clear discrepancies associated with Time Off Task flags
* Enter punches for orientation time for staffing agency new hires.
* Input corrective action documentation into Amazon GAPS system
* Research associates counseling history as needed to confirm correct level for next counseling, dates of prior counselings, etc. or provide
* summary of performance history for manager to use in making a recommendation for termination.
* Submit counselings for both Amazonians and staffing agency associates (including tracking approval and printing for managers to deliver for Amazonians)
* Print Amazon attendance counselings sent out by HR and organize with other counselings so managers have one complete set of what they need to deliver
* Print/post rates throughout shift for all associates on set schedule
* Answer questions for Amazon associates on points/vacp/pers balances as required. Help escalate discrepancies to HR and resolve.
* Additional Responsibilities may also include:
* Assisting with safety and dock audits and/or type and publish them for managers
* Assisting managers run/track production reports, update operations reports as needed, work on projects for creating reports, etc.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ months of human resources experience
* 6\+ months of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
* Experience in confidential environments
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of human resources experience
* 1\+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

title: Associate Director-Talent Consultant
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Strategic** 
**Talent** 
**Consultant\- Associate Director**
 If you are looking for a rewarding career experience as a Strategic Talent Consultant in a high\-growth organization, we have a role here. In EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 As a trusted partner and advisor to the GDS Service Line/Functions, you are considered an extension of the business leaders, working closely with the leadership team to support growth objectives and help meet future talent needs.
   

  

 You will build a deep understanding of both the business direction and HR/Talent priorities to ensure successful implementation of key high\-touch people processes and initiatives.
   

  

 You will also partner closely with the other Center of Excellence within talent function, such as Talent Attraction \& Acquisition, Talent Development, Total Rewards etc. to ensure seamless execution of talent initiatives across the organization.
   

  

 You will also be responsible for managing and developing a team of Talent Consultants to deliver exceptional services to the client stakeholders.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Engage with Talent and Service Line Leadership to align business priorities with talent priorities
* Translate the business strategy into practical and innovative talent solutions at the business unit level
* Advise the business on developing a culture within the business unit that underpins our values, promote high performance teaming and enables the delivery of exceptional client service
* Challenge and coach lSenior Management to drive change and support the implementation and successful adoption of projects and initiatives at EY Global/GDS level
* Guide business leaders in effective change management strategies and the deployment of change (e.g. for restructuring, acquisitions)
* Act as a coach to leadership in relation to delivering the people strategy agenda
* Champion GDS D\&I agenda and embed within strategy
* Influence the Talent COEs in the development of best\-in\-class models and programs
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of talent initiatives within business unit
* Contribute to workforce planning activities in the context of understanding capability, skills development and manage workforce planning efforts to meet business unit needs
* Work with business leaders to develop and manage their long\-term talent pipeline (e.g. Talent Review, Succession Planning, Partner and Executive Director/Director promotions process etc.)
* Manage the development of leaders and contribute to the design of career path models and development programs along with Learning \& Talent Development Team

In Manufacturing, the company offers a comprehensive portfolio of products ranging from automotive components to mission\-critical Defense solutions. Known for quality, reliability, and innovation, Best Group is a trusted partner for esteemed clients across industries, including Automotive, Hospitality, and Government sectors.

 The
 **Vice President of Human Resources \& Administration** 
 is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Gurugram.
 



  





 As a head of the HR \& admin functions, your role involves leading HR initiatives and overseeing all aspects of human resource practices and processes, including developing strategies to enhance employee engagement, streamlining HR operations, and ensuring compliance with labor laws. Responsibilities also include overseeing employee relations programs, implementing HR technologies, managing employee benefits, and driving the development and execution of HR policies to support the organization's strategic goals.

 Strategic Human Capital Leadership

* Build leadership pipelines and succession plans for critical positions across the Group.
* Identify and plan future talent requirements to support business growth and expansion.



  





 HR Business Partnership
 


* Partner closely with leaders across all business units and all manufacturing locations to ensure seamless alignment between business objectives and people strategy.
* Serve as a trusted business partner to drive productivity, capability building, and organizational effectiveness.

* Factory administration
* Industrial relations
* Statutory and labor law compliance
* Contract labor management
* Employee engagement programs including Shop\-floor culture development
* Discipline and grievance handling
* Safety culture support and workforce participation
* Workforce deployment and optimization
* Manufacturing capability development



  





 Facilities \& Administration
 


* Oversee facilities preparedness and administration across locations.
* Ensure workplace infrastructure, employee services, and support systems operate efficiently.
* Drive continuous improvement in workplace experience, safety, and operational effectiveness.



  





 Organizational Development \& Culture
 


* Build a high\-performance culture rooted in accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Design leadership development and learning initiatives.
* Drive employee engagement and retention through measurable interventions.



  





 Data\-Driven HR Leadership
 


* Hands on experience in implementation of HRIS
* Establish robust HR analytics and people dashboards.
* Drive decision\-making through metrics, facts, and operational data.
* Track and improve key indicators including productivity, retention, engagement, absenteeism, hiring effectiveness, leadership readiness, and workforce capability.



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 We are seeking a leader who:
 



 ✔ Has 25\+ years of progressive HR leadership experience
 



 ✔ Has extensive experience in manufacturing and factory environments
 



 ✔ Has successfully partnered with business leaders to drive operational and financial performance
 



 ✔ Is equally comfortable in boardrooms, plants, and shop floors
 



 ✔ Demonstrates strong knowledge of industrial relations, factory administration, labor laws, and workforce management
 



 ✔ Believes in 
 **Gemba leadership** 
  and regularly engages with employees where value is created
 



 ✔ Uses data, facts, and measurable outcomes to drive decisions rather than assumptions
 



 ✔ Has successfully led organizational transformation, culture\-building, and leadership development initiatives
 



 ✔ Is highly execution\-oriented and capable of translating strategy into action
 



 ✔ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; additional certifications (e.g., SHRM\-CP, PHR) are a plus

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
Born in 2006, CompanyStore changed the way that brands interact with their stakeholders. Through one simple strategy: Merchandise. Over the last 20 years, we have worked with the world's best brands to enhance their merchandise strategy through quality product and technology enablement. 
 




  





**The Community You Will Join.** 





 CompanyStore is an exciting place to be, not just because of the people but because of the work. We are a creative, crazy and collaborative bunch.
 




  





**Job Overview** 





 The HRBP will help align the organization’s people and business strategies. Not only will you be the people champion and an administrative expert but also a strategic partner and change agent for the business. 
 





 We’ve grown with a strong tribal, relationship\-led culture and are now intentionally transitioning into a professionally managed, performance\-driven company. This next phase requires sharper systems, clearer accountability, and leaders who can balance empathy with execution.
 





 This HRBP role is pivotal in that journey.
 




  





**Human Resource Business Partner (HRBP)** 




  




**1\. Performance Management \& Org Effectiveness** 
* Design and implement a robust 360\-degree performance management framework across the organisation
* Establish clear KRAs and KPIs for all roles, ensuring alignment with business goals
* Drive cadence\-based reviews (half\-yearly/annual) and calibration discussions
* Coach managers on performance conversations, feedback, and accountability
* Identify high performers, skill gaps, and succession pipelines


- 

**2\. Strategic HR Business Partnering** 
* Partner closely with functional heads to align people strategy with department goals
* Act as a sounding board for leaders on team structure, capability building, and people challenges
* Support leadership during periods of change, growth, or performance shifts
* Translate business strategy into practical people initiatives


- 

**3\. Learning \& Development (L\&D)** 
* Own the end\-to\-end L\&D strategy for the organisation
* Identify training needs at individual, team, and leadership levels
* Design and manage leadership development programs
* Track learning impact and ensure ROI on L\&D investments



  




**4\. Onboarding \& Employee Experience** 
* Redesign and elevate the onboarding experience to reflect CompanyStore.IO’s culture and expectations
* Ensure new hires ramp up effectively in both performance and cultural alignment
* Continuously improve the employee lifecycle experience (joining → growth → progression)



  




**5\. Culture, Communication \& Alignment** 
* Play a key role in evolving the culture from tribal to performance\-led, without losing our human core
* Drive department alignment through structured rituals, reviews, and communication forums
* Own company\-wide townhalls, internal communication, and leadership messaging
* Reinforce values through systems, behaviours, and recognition



  




**6\. HR Operations \& Team Management** 
* Lead and mentor two HR team members, ensuring clear ownership and development
* Oversee core HR processes: policies, compliance, payroll coordination, and employee relations
* Ensure consistency, fairness, and transparency across HR practices

Leadzo is hiring a QA Analyst to own manual testing and quality across the platform.
 



**About Leadzo** 




 Leadzo (www.leadzo.co.in) is a lead generation and service marketplace connecting customers with verified professionals across categories such as Marketing and Technology, Legal and Business, Home Services, Health and Wellbeing, Construction and Trades, and more. The platform is live across India with active buyers and sellers. We are now in a scale and stabilisation phase, and quality is critical since every bug that reaches a user affects trust and revenue directly.
 



**About the Role** 




 As a QA Analyst, you will build our test suites and testing process from the ground up while working directly with engineers and founders. Leadzo is a credit based marketplace where buyers raise enquiries for free and sellers spend credits to unlock leads. Because real money and trust are involved in nearly every flow, testing accuracy matters a great deal. This is an on site role based in our Bengaluru office.
 



**Responsibilities** 




 Test design and planning
 



 Write clear manual test cases covering standard flows, edge cases, and negative scenarios.
 



 Build test plans for each release with defined coverage of key user journeys.
 



**Test execution** 




 Run regression, exploratory, and usability testing on every release.
 



 Test across browsers and devices to confirm consistent UI and behaviour.

title: Junior Software Developer (Web & Automation)
description:
The House of Sunita Shekhawat is a luxury high\-jewellery house in Jaipur, with a growing digital presence across our main site (sunitashekhawat.com) and our Museum of Meenakari Heritage site (momhindia.org). Digital is a genuine strategic priority for us, and we build on a modern stack and use AI tooling like Claude Code and MCP workflows every day on real production work.
 



 We are looking for a Junior Software Developer to take on the day\-to\-day building and maintenance of these websites, dashboards and automation. You will start with small, well\-scoped tickets, learn our stack through code review, and grow into larger pieces of work over time. This is a launchpad on a small, trusting team, not maintenance work hidden away. Above all, we want someone who is a quick learner, flexible, and eager to pick up new tools and skills as the work grows.
 



**What you'll do** 




 You will not be expected to know all of this on day one. You will start with the smaller, well\-scoped pieces and grow into the rest through review.
 



 · Build and edit content, blocks and small features in Payload CMS (our headless, Postgres\-backed CMS) for sunitashekhawat.com, momhindia.org and other brand\-related properties.
 



 · Render new sections and components on the frontend in Next.js 15, React and TypeScript, and fix layout, styling and responsive bugs. Much of this is done with AI tooling like Claude Code, so what matters most is strong fundamentals: enough depth to read, review and correct AI\-generated code with confidence, rather than writing every line by hand.
 



 · Keep our automation and scripts running: maintain existing Python and Playwright jobs, fix breakage when selectors change or tokens expire, and help with light analytics checks (for example, confirming Meta Pixel and GA4 events fire correctly).
 



 · Run QA on Vercel preview deploys, do cross\-device checks, then trigger and smoke\-test production builds once a pull request is approved.
 



 · Work in a clean Git and GitHub flow: branch, commit in small focused steps, and raise well\-described pull requests with screenshots or preview links.
 



**What we're looking for** 




 You should be able to pick up small, well\-scoped tickets and carry them to a clean pull request with review. We are looking for roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, so you are past the fresher stage but still early in your career. You do not need to tick every box below, and you certainly do not need to know our whole stack on day one.
 



**Must\-have** 




 · Around 1 year of professional experience building or shipping web and React applications.
 



 · Working knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript: comfortable reading and writing typed code.
 



 · React fundamentals (components, props, state, hooks) and basic Next.js (routing, data fetching, and deploying to a host like Vercel). Our codebase is Next.js 15 on the App Router, so exposure to modern Next is a plus.
 



 · Solid HTML and CSS, including responsive, mobile\-first layout.
 



 · A working Git and GitHub workflow: branches, commits, pull requests, resolving merge conflicts, and responding to review.
 



 · Basic debugging discipline: read the error, reproduce it, use browser devtools, and ask good questions when stuck.
 



 · Clear written communication for pull request descriptions and status updates.
 



**Nice\-to\-have (genuine bonuses, not requirements)** 




 These are things you will learn here, so treat any of them as a plus rather than a bar. One or two is a strong signal.
 



 · Payload CMS or any other headless CMS.
 



 · Basic SQL and a sense of how database migrations work; PostgreSQL exposure.
 



 · Vercel or Railway deployment experience, and basic environment and secrets handling.
 



 · Twenty CRM or other self\-hosted tools.
 



**The details** 




 ·
 **Location:** 
 In\-office, at our flagship and HQ: Shekhawat Haveli, E\-141, Sardar Patel Marg, C\-Scheme, Jaipur 302001\. Being on site means in\-person mentorship and close proximity to the work, which is a genuine part of the offer.
 



 ·
 **Employment:** 
 Full\-time, permanent role.
 



 ·
 **Timings:** 
 Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM IST, in office.
 



 ·
 **Compensation:** 
 Competitive, based on experience, and benchmarked to the Jaipur market for your level.
