title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Who we are** 






 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 





**Job summary** 




* The Network Infrastructure team is responsible for the operation, monitoring, maintenance, and support of DigiCert's global production network.
* This position serves as a first responder for network incidents and operational requests, providing initial troubleshooting, monitoring, and administration of production network systems.




**What you will do** 




* Network Operations \& Monitoring
* Monitor the health, performance, and availability of global production network infrastructure.
* Review device logs, alerts, and monitoring systems to identify and respond to operational issues.
* Perform initial troubleshooting and incident response for network\-related events.
* Troubleshoot network, application, database, DNS, load balancing, and service connectivity issues across data center and cloud environments.
* Work with Internet service providers, telecommunications carriers, cloud providers, application teams, database administrators, and third\-party vendors to diagnose and resolve connectivity, routing, latency, and service\-impacting issues.
* Participate in incident response activities and assist with service restoration efforts during production outages.
* Escalate complex issues to senior engineers while providing accurate documentation and diagnostics.
* Participate in root cause analysis activities following service\-impacting incidents
* Implement routine network configuration changes following established procedures.
* Perform basic firewall policy modifications and access control changes.
   

  


**What you will have**


* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of experience supporting enterprise, service provider, or data center network environments.
* Understanding of: TCP/IP, DNS, Routing and switching fundamentals, VLANs and network segmentation, Firewall concepts, VPN technologies
* Understand routing protocols and route troubleshooting concepts.
* Experience using network monitoring, logging, and observability platforms to identify, investigate, and respond to infrastructure issues.
* Experience reviewing system and device logs to assist with troubleshooting and incident response activities.
* Experience responding to operational incidents and working within established incident management processes.
* Experience troubleshooting network, application, database, DNS, and service connectivity issues in collaboration with service providers, cloud providers, vendors, and internal technical teams.
* Ability to perform network troubleshooting and isolate issues across routing, switching, firewall, load balancing, and cloud\-connected environments.
   



 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to follow operational procedures in a highly controlled production environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to participate in on\-call support rotation and monthly maintenance.



  
 




**Nice to have** 




* Familiarity with Linux\-based systems.
* Exposure to modern data center networking architectures, including Leaf\-Spine fabric designs.
* Familiarity with data center networking technologies such as:
   



 Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)
   



 Virtual Extensible LAN (VXLAN)
   



 Ethernet VPN (EVPN)
* Understanding of overlay and underlay networking concepts within modern data center environments.
   



 Experience supporting Arista EOS\-based switching environments.
* Experience using Arista CloudVision for network management, monitoring, automation, and operational visibility.
* Ability to perform under pressure during incidents.
* Ability to work effectively within a global infrastructure team.



  
 




**Benefits** 




* Generous time off policies
* Top shelf benefits
* Education, wellness and lifestyle support

title: Network Engineer
description:
**About Aion**
 Aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full\-stack solution for building, fine\-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI\-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, Aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform.
   

  

 We work differently than most AI companies: our teams deploy alongside our customers, turning production\-ready AI into real business outcomes in weeks, not quarters.
   

  

 We're a fast\-growing, VC\-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we're building the next generation of enterprise AI and we're looking for exceptional people to help us scale.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You're an experienced Network Engineer with a strong foundation in designing, implementing, and operating highly available, secure, and scalable network infrastructure. You understand that networking is the backbone of distributed AI systems and have experience building resilient environments that support high\-performance computing, cloud\-native applications, and large\-scale enterprise deployments.
   

  

 You're comfortable working across cloud and on\-premises environments, troubleshooting complex networking issues, and automating network operations. You think beyond connectivity. You optimize for performance, security, observability, and operational excellence.
   

  

 You're product\-minded and collaborative. Whether you're designing multi\-region network architecture, optimizing traffic flow for AI workloads, supporting customer deployments, or working closely with platform and infrastructure engineers, you take ownership and focus on delivering reliable infrastructure that enables developers and customers to succeed.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Network Architecture \& Infrastructure**
* Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available network infrastructure across cloud and on\-premises environments
* Architect enterprise\-grade networking solutions supporting AI infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, GPU workloads, and customer deployments
* Design network topologies, routing strategies, segmentation, and redundancy to ensure high availability and fault tolerance
* Drive network architecture decisions while balancing scalability, security, performance, and operational simplicity


**Cloud \& Hybrid Networking**
* Build and manage networking across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments
* Design secure hybrid connectivity between cloud infrastructure, customer VPCs, and on\-premises environments using VPNs, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, or similar technologies
* Implement secure multi\-region and multi\-cloud networking architectures
* Support enterprise customer deployments in private cloud and on\-premises environments


**Network Operations \& Reliability**
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize network performance across production environments
* Investigate latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization, and connectivity issues impacting AI workloads
* Build resilient networking with automated failover, redundancy, and disaster recovery strategies
* Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous infrastructure improvements


**Network Security**
* Implement secure networking practices including firewalls, network segmentation, Zero Trust principles, IDS/IPS, and DDoS protection
* Configure and maintain load balancers, reverse proxies, WAFs, and secure ingress and egress policies
* Partner with security teams to ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and customer requirements
* Support authentication, access control, certificate management, and secure service communication


**Automation \& Observability**
* Automate network provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure\-as\-Code and network automation tools
* Build monitoring dashboards for network health, latency, throughput, utilization, and availability
* Improve observability through metrics, logging, tracing, and proactive alerting
* Document network architecture, operational procedures, and best practices


**Requirements**
**Technical Skills \& Experience**
* 4\+ years of experience designing and managing enterprise or cloud network infrastructure
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), VLANs, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and load balancing
* Experience with cloud networking across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes networking, CNI plugins, ingress controllers, and service meshes is highly desirable
* Experience with firewalls, network security appliances, VPN gateways, and network access control
* Familiarity with Linux networking, packet analysis, and troubleshooting tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, iperf, and traceroute
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible
* Knowledge of container networking using Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience with observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent monitoring platforms
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation
* Understanding of high\-availability networking, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills in distributed production environments


**Bonus/ Good to Have**
* AI \& High\-Performance Infrastructure:
* Experience supporting networking for AI/ML infrastructure, GPU clusters, or high\-performance computing (HPC) environments
* Familiarity with InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, or high\-speed data center networking
* Cloud \& Platform Engineering:
* Experience supporting Kubernetes production clusters and cloud\-native networking
* Exposure to service meshes such as Istio or Linkerd
* Experience with SDN technologies and software\-defined networking platforms
* Automation:
* Experience developing automation using Python, Go, or Bash
* Knowledge of GitOps workflows and infrastructure lifecycle management


**Benefits**
**Preferred Attributes:**
* Founder\-level ownership and bias for action
* Strong strategic thinking and ability to connect technical decisions to business impact
* Excellent communication and mentoring skills
* Thrives in ambiguity, fast\-paced environments, and early\-stage startup culture


**Why Join aion?**
* Work directly with high\-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy
* Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally
* Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions
* Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits

title: Director Network Engineering
description:
About the Business Unit
 



  





 At the core of everything Epsilon does is a team that builds and operates the foundation of our enterprise technology platforms. ETS drives innovation across Epsilon's infrastructure through cloud, automation, and AI, delivering scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that power revenue\-generating platforms. The team provides end\-to\-end infrastructure services while defining the architectural direction for enterprise deployments across the organization.
 



  





 As a
 **Principal Cloud Network Engineer** 
 , you will define and drive Epsilon's enterprise cloud and hybrid network architecture across AWS, GCP, and Azure. You will establish scalable, secure, and resilient networking standards for multi\-cloud environments while modernizing legacy networking using cloud\-native services such as AWS Transit Gateway, VPC Lattice, Private Service Connect, Azure Virtual WAN, Route 53 Resolver, and cloud edge security services.
 



 Working closely with Cloud Engineering, Security, Platform Engineering, and Application teams, you will define landing zone architectures, hybrid connectivity strategies, network observability, automation standards, and operational best practices. You will provide technical leadership for enterprise\-wide networking initiatives, mentor engineering teams, and lead the resolution of complex production networking challenges.
 



 Your work will directly improve platform reliability, security, scalability, operational efficiency, and developer productivity across Epsilon's global cloud platforms.
 



 Responsibilities
 



 Enterprise Cloud Network Architecture
 


* Define and evolve enterprise cloud network architecture across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including hub\-and\-spoke, mesh, and centralized egress models.
* Establish multi\-account landing zone networking standards, including shared services, centralized inspection, and routing governance.
* Design secure private connectivity using AWS PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, GCP Private Service Connect, and Azure Private Link.
* Architect zero\-trust networking and identity\-aware connectivity aligned with enterprise security standards.
* Evaluate emerging cloud networking technologies and drive adoption aligned with business objectives.



 Hybrid Connectivity \& DNS
 


* Own hybrid connectivity architecture using AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect, VPN, and resilient hybrid networking patterns.
* Define enterprise DNS architecture using Route 53, Cloud DNS, Azure Private DNS, Resolver endpoints, split\-horizon DNS, and on\-premises integration.
* Lead architecture reviews for complex routing, BGP, DNS, and cross\-cloud connectivity.



 Network Security
 


* Define standards for AWS WAF, AWS Shield, CloudFront, GCP Cloud Armor, Azure Front Door, Application Gateway WAF, and related edge security technologies.
* Design segmentation using Security Groups, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, Azure Firewall, and GCP Firewall Policies.
* Partner with Security teams on DDoS protection, certificate lifecycle, logging, compliance, and threat detection.



 Automation \& Platform Engineering
 


* Define Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop Python\-based network automation and API\-driven services for provisioning, validation, and operational workflows.
* Design self\-service networking capabilities that improve consistency, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Define network observability using Flow Logs, Reachability Analyzer, Cloud Monitoring, synthetic monitoring, SLOs, and operational metrics.
* Guide networking architecture for Kubernetes platforms including EKS, AKS, and GKE.



 Technical Leadership
 


* Lead enterprise network modernization initiatives and establish technical direction.
* Mentor senior engineers and architects while driving engineering excellence.
* Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvements for critical networking issues.
* Own enterprise network documentation, architecture standards, and Well\-Architected Reviews.
* Drive network cost optimization through FinOps best practices.
* Participate in on\-call support for critical production incidents.



 Required Qualifications
 


* 10\+ years of network engineering or infrastructure experience, including 5\+ years designing and operating cloud networking in large\-scale production environments.
* Expert knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, BGP, VPN, DNS, TLS, load balancing, and hybrid networking.
* Deep hands\-on experience with AWS networking services including VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, Resolver, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, Network Firewall, WAF, and CloudFront.
* Strong experience with GCP networking including Private Service Connect, Cloud DNS, Cloud Armor, Shared VPC, and Azure networking including Virtual WAN, Private Link, Azure Firewall, and Application Gateway.
* Experience designing enterprise landing zones with centralized networking and governance.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code expertise using Terraform and version\-controlled deployment pipelines.
* Strong Python programming skills for automation, orchestration, and API\-based networking solutions.
* Experience implementing network observability, capacity planning, SLOs, and operational metrics.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, DNS, routing, security, TLS, NAT, and application connectivity.
* Experience working within regulated environments using change management, least privilege, and audit\-ready processes.
* Excellent communication, leadership, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, GCP Professional Cloud Network Engineer, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience implementing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SASE, or Identity\-Aware Proxy architectures.
* Deep experience with Kubernetes networking, service mesh, and container networking across EKS, GKE, and AKS.
* Experience building enterprise network automation platforms, APIs, and self\-service networking capabilities using Python and additional scripting languages such as Bash or Go.
* Experience leading enterprise network transformation initiatives, including data center migrations, cloud modernization, or landing zone implementations.
* Background in SRE, NOC, or incident command for large\-scale production environments.
* Experience contributing to enterprise standards, architecture governance, and engineering best practices.
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure networking, including high\-performance GPU and low\-latency networking environments.

title: Full stack engineer I
description:
**Duties**
* You will build out a new AI\-powered web product on top of an existing, production\-proven platform. The infrastructure, DevOps pipeline, architecture patterns, and core abstractions are already in place and meant to be reused — your job is to implement new product features, not to design or stand up systems from scratch.
* Concretely, you will: Implement backend API routes, services, and database models by porting and adapting established patterns (FastAPI, SQLModel, Alembic, Celery/Redis) from the reference codebase
* Build the product's primary user\-facing frontend — a multi\-stage guided journey — using the existing Next.js 15 / React 19 App Router shell, component library, state management, and API\-client patterns
* Wire LLM\-powered scoring and evaluation logic as plain Python inside a Celery worker, following an established pattern for structured LangChain calls with Pydantic\-typed outputs
* Integrate with the team's AI Gateway (Azure OpenAI\-compatible) and existing observability tooling (Langfuse tracing)
* Write unit and integration tests following patterns already established in the repo; contribute migrations via Alembic
* You are expected to interact directly with internal product stakeholders and technical leads to understand requirements, translate them into well\-scoped implementations, and flag scope or design questions early. You will be delivering production code that routes through an existing CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions \-\> JFrog \-\> cloud redeploy on merge to main), but may need to contribute to the initial DevOps and Infra setup as well.


**Skills**
* AI\-augmented development mindset is required. You are expected to use AI coding tools actively and fluently throughout your workflow — for code generation, exploration, review, and documentation. The codebase and patterns are designed to be readable and transferable; use every tool available to move fast.
* Solid Python (3\.10\+) and TypeScript/JavaScript with React and NextJS. Familiarity with Python async patterns (FastAPI, Celery), SQLModel or SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic typing; comfort with React and Next.js App Router.
* Working understanding of microservices and container\-based development (Docker / docker\-compose). You will use these every day; you will not be designing them.
* Comfort reading and adapting existing patterns rather than inventing new ones — this role rewards developers who recognise a good solution and apply it correctly over those who prefer to build from first principles.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI\-compatible), prompt engineering basics, and structured output patterns (e.g. .with\_structured\_output(PydanticModel) via LangChain) is a strong plus.
* Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), schema migrations, and basic SQL.
* Ability to communicate clearly with non\-technical stakeholders; comfort raising questions and flagging blockers early rather than silently working around them.


**Stack you will work in day\-to\-day**
* Python 3\.13
* FastAPI
* Celery
* Redis
* PostgreSQL
* SQLModel
* Alembic
* LangChain
* Azure OpenAI
* Next.js 15 (App Router)
* React 19
* TypeScript
* Zustand
* Tailwind CSS v4
* Radix UI
* Bun
* uv
* Ruff
* Docker
* GitHub Actions

 India's ₹40\+ lakh crore lending ecosystem runs on one thing after disbursal: collections.

 We are hiring an

 Go deep inside AVIO, the conversation flows, the models, the outcomes data and identify precisely where it can become smarter, more robust, and more autonomous.

 The APM who does this well becomes the product leader of a category\-defining platform. That path is measured in months here, not years.

 Skip the cover letter. Send us:
 




  




1. Your resume/LinkedIn

description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data\-driven.
   

  

**About Us**
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
   

  

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a passionate and motivated
 **Senior Technical Writer** 
 to join our Product Documentation team as we support the company in achieving top\-priority objectives \& key results
   

  

 Documentation at dbt is both a community asset and a foundational product surface. The Documentation team accelerates product adoption and user success by helping data practitioners learn, explore, and confidently use dbt.
   

  

 We operate using a docs\-as\-code and docs\-as\-a\-product approach within an open\-source model, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Developer Experience, and customer\-facing teams. By balancing deep product knowledge with a beginner’s lens, we not only create accurate, easy\-to\-read documentation for humans and bots alike, but also surface insights that drive product improvements.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll help new users reach their “a\-ha” moment faster, support experienced practitioners as they expand into new areas of the ecosystem, and uphold the clarity, accuracy, and trust that our community depends on.
   

  

 If you are looking for an exciting opportunity at a collaborative, dynamic and fast\-growing company, this role could be for you!
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 New feature writing for Product \- 45%
   

  

* Consistently creates effective docs plans for new feature writing projects
* Starts conversations in key places, and involves stakeholders to keep everyone well\-informed and focused on a world\-class customer experience
* Raises issues or suggests improvements to new features that advocate for user needs


 Docs projects writing \- 20%
   

  

* Identifies and advocates for medium to large docs projects
* Mentors less\-senior writers on how to manage their time spent in docs\-driven projects alongside new feature ships
* Independently prioritizes the highest impact work beyond new feature ships


 Addressing ongoing issues \- 20%
   

  

* Independently troubleshoots issue requests, and helps less\-senior writers learn how to do the same
* Has a solid understanding of when a swathe of issues can be folded into a larger content strategy improvement project instead of addressing each issue singularly
* Independently notices overarching issues in our docs and figures out how to address them
* Focuses on more complex issues, while analyzing data across multiple dimensions to evaluate solutions and drive decisions
* Triages and reviews open source PRs and issues, and alerts the team when these are piling up


 Peer reviewing \- 15%
   

  

* Provides and explains their insightful and compassionate editorial and technical feedback when reviewing the work of peers
* When providing feedback, consistently notices gaps in pages outside of the pages contained in the pull request they’re reviewing. They evaluate the problem being solved instead of just the pages being submitted for review.
* Gains agreement, consolidates differing opinions, and enables team to move forward
* Reviews are consistently centered around clarifying the experience for users


**Skills We're Looking For**
 Required:
   

  

* Minimum 5 years writing technical documentation for developer tools, including a solid understanding of version control and single\-sourcing content, and experience managing documentation systems.
* Strong ability to plan, prioritize, and carry out complex writing projects with high attention to detail along the way.
* Ability to compassionately give and receive editorial and technical feedback.
* Communicate clearly and concisely, especially when working asynchronously or with a distributed team.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience with dbt or data
* Previous experience as a senior member of a formal documentation team working collaboratively with other writers, editors, and teams.
* Worked asynchronously as part of a fully\-remote, distributed team
* A plus if you have experience contributing to or maintaining an open source project


**Perks And Benefits**
 100% employer\-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time\-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays, and volunteer days off

- RSU stock grants\*

- Professional development and training opportunities

- Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team\-building activities

- Monthly cell phone stipend

- Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self\-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

 \*May vary by country and worker type \- please reach out to your recruiter for more information
   

  

*Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*
 We’re honored to be valued at over $5\.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as
   

  

 packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St.
   

  

 Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.

 In India, Barry\-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centres of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
   

  

**Our culture is built on:**
* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.


**Career Development and Global Exposure**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership
   

  

 development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
   

  

 If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Technical Writer II \- Role Overview**
 As a Technical Writer II, you will own end\-to\-end documentation tasks/projects for Barry\-Wehmiller machinery/product lines using structured authoring applications to scale quality, consistency, and speed. You’ll partner closely with global Engineering, Product Line Managers, and other cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality product documentation. A key component of this role involves contributing to our ongoing Content Management System (CMS) implementation and driving documentation excellence across the full product lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Technical Content Development:
   

  

* Create, review, and maintain comprehensive and well\-structured documentation for Barry\- Wehmiller machinery/products, services, and processes.
* Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and user\-friendly content, tailored to a wide range of audiences, including customers, internal teams, and for training purposes.
* Work with global teams to understand and learn about the products and write procedures in technical documentation.
* Own end\-to\-end documentation tasks using desktop and structured authoring applications to scale quality, consistency, and speed.
* Ensure timely execution of documentation tasks in compliance with guidelines, best practices, and deliver defect free output.
* Ensure all documentation adheres to applicable technical writing standards and guidelines such as ASD\-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) and company style guides.


 Content Management System:
   

  

* Play an active role in the upcoming CCMS implementation program, contributing across all phases of the implementation roadmap from Foundation G Strategy through Optimization G Governance.
* Work closely with the CCMS project team to do the pilot projects and develop the documentation workflows.
* Support the migration of legacy content into the CCMS, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and proper metadata tagging throughout the transition.


 Stakeholder Collaboration:
   

  

* Partner closely with global Engineering, Product Line Managers, and other cross\-functional teams to deliver product documentation.
* Coordinate with translation and localization teams to prepare documentation for multilingual publication in global markets.


 Continuous Improvement:
   

  

* Identify the opportunities for process improvements and workflow innovations and drive the activities to achieve meaningful results.


**Qualifications G Skills**
 Essential:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Technical Communication, Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 7\+ years of active, hands\-on technical writing experience with demonstrable content authoring across previous roles — portfolio or writing samples required.
* Strong domain knowledge of engineering industrial machinery, including mechanical systems, hydraulics, electronics, or automation equipment.
* Proven experience working with Content Management Systems (CCMS/CMS), including hands\-on use of tools such as SchemaST4, Paligo, Author\-it, IXIASOFT, Adobe Experience Manager, or equivalent platforms.
* Proficiency in using desktop publishing tools like Adobe InDesign, Adobe FrameMaker (including XML driven), and Microsoft Office.
* Experience contributing to new product development (NPD) projects and managing documentation deliverables against engineering development milestones.
* Experience collaborating with global, cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple time zones and cultures


 Good to have:
   

  

* 
+ Familiarity with translation management workflows and localization processes for multilingual documentation.
+ Knowledge of PLM tools like Windchill, Teamcenter, Infor XA, or BlueStar PLM is good to have.
+ Familiarity with CAD tools is an advantage.
+ Knowledge of the best practices used in the technical documentation industry would be a plus.


**Soft Skills**
* 
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills
+ Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
+ Detail\-oriented with a focus on accuracy and consistency
+ Time Management
+ Adaptability


**Travel:**
 Work – related travel may be necessary.
   

  

* What is in for you?


 This role is more than just a job. It’s an opportunity to be part of a global team that values people excellence, innovative solutions, and operational excellence. Barry Wehmiller provides a unique environment where you can grow your skills, work on impactful projects, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. In addition, we are deeply committed to your personal and professional growth, fostering a culture that helps you achieve your full potential.
   

  

 We offer a culture that values autonomy, ownership, and flexibility. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, influence product decisions, and see your work through—from idea to delivery. Our teams are collaborative, agile, and outcome driven, with trust placed in every individual to make a meaningful impact.

**Job Description**
 Job Role: Business Analyst
   

  

 Key Accountabilities: Primarily focussed on Systems Analysis and preparation of functional specifications / User Stories, the Business Analyst will also be responsible for contributing to System Testing and providing analysis and support throughout the full development lifecycle
   

  

 Role \& Responsibilities
   

  

* To act as the primary contact and source of knowledge for the offshore development and test teams for all matters relating to the business functionality on selected large\-scale applications for the Public Safety market.
* To analyse customer requirements and to create appropriate high quality functional definitions for use by the development and test teams – either in the form of Functional Specifications or User Stories depending on the development methodology being used.
* To provide a strong link between the offshore development/test teams and the onshore teams regarding business requirements and functionality.
* To work closely with the Product Owners/Product Managers and the onshore BAs to ensure that the software built offshore meets the necessary functional requirements.
* To work closely with the QA teams to ensure that the solution is adequately tested and that it meets the stated business requirements.
* To respond quickly and accurately to queries from the development teams regarding product functionality, liaising with the Product Owners/Managers/onshore BAs as necessary to derive an appropriate response.
* To assist with the prioritisation of features to be developed.
* To Work with and assist the UK\-based team in understanding, categorising and prioritising internal and external change requests and defects.
* To assist in the preparation of system test plans, defining test scenarios for appropriate features and collaborating with the QA team on the feature scope of the next release/sprint.
* To analyse and document business processes and workflows.


**Essential Requirements**
* Ability to connect, communicate and collaborate effectively with the end users and business team at onshore.
* Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with members of development and QA teams at onshore and offshore.
* Ability to write, present and articulate functional requirements either as formal documents for waterfall development or user stories for Agile methodology.
* A self\-starter with an insatiable desire to resolve issues promptly and satisfactorily.
* Ability to analyse and co\-relate multiple business functionalities with cascading effect across the applications for change requests raised by the customers.


 Job Specification
   

  

* Knowledge of prioritising tasks, estimating them and scheduling them based on sprints timelines and business priorities.


 Desirable requirements
   

  

* Familiarity with Public Safety domain is preferable.
* Experience in Agile project development methodology particularly SCRUM, which includes writing user stories, managing product backlog, discussing and finalizing on the sprint feature and taking the team through planned functionality for estimation.

* Promptly escalates issues which may impact scope and delivery schedules and come up with alternatives to contribute to their resolution.
* Implement and adheres to existing process and pro\-actively suggest improvements and implement agreed process improvements to enhance performance, productivity and morale of the team.

 Dakshata

Leveraging AI and machine learning, our intelligent procurement solutions provide enterprise buyers and suppliers with smart\-match recommendations that align buyer needs with supplier capabilities.

**Role Snapshot**
 Role \- Junior Consultant / Associate Solution Consultant
   

  

 Experience \- Fresh graduate or 1\+ year of IT experience
   

  

 Competence \- Set up web\-based solutions; communication with clients

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Support delivery by validating technical feasibility and helping optimize solution design
* Assist with drafting solution design documents and participating in solution build activities
* Build positive working relationships with the Professional Services team, clients, and partners
* Understand project management needs, project tasks, and deliverables
* Engage with Professional Services stakeholders and relevant internal teams to update processes and documentation
* Contribute to process improvement and delivery efficiency
* Learn existing and emerging technologies and JAGGAER products on a regular basis
* Provide feedback to help improve solution delivery


**Responsibilities**
* Develop an understanding of existing JAGGAER solutions and IT infrastructure to support the delivery of client solutions
* Identify, interpret, and document customer requirements; communicate with customers and partners to understand expectations and clarify needs
* Support the hands\-on development of "as is / to be" process models, solution architecture diagrams, and solution design documents
* Participate as a project delivery team member in the design and implementation of solutions spanning business processes and JAGGAER solutions
* Help ensure recommended solutions can be successfully implemented across JAGGAER customer environments and technical landscapes
* Communicate with technical and business team members, client stakeholders, and partners in a clear and professional manner
* Collaborate with subject matter experts to identify and mitigate problem areas
* Work primarily with the Professional Services team, clients, and partners; interact with Sales, Pre\-Sales, Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success teams as needed
* Support process and documentation updates within Professional Services
* Share customer feedback and observations with relevant internal teams to support product and delivery improvements


**Position Requirements**
**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Fresh graduates or candidates with 1\+ year of IT experience are encouraged to apply
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, ora related discipline is preferred
* Basic understanding of web\-based solutions, SaaS technologies, operating systems, and databases
* Ability and willingness to set up web\-based solutions and learn JAGGAER product configuration
* Strong interpersonal and client\-facing skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Effective organizational and collaboration skills
* Analytical and critical thinking skills
* Detail\-oriented with the ability to rapidly learn new concepts, business models, and technologies
* A great listener with the ability to communicate professionally with people in diverse roles, including clients, partners, technical teams, and internal stakeholders
* Previous project management, business analysis, software delivery, or customer\-facing IT experience is a plus


**Our Values \- T.E.A.M**
 At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.
   

  

* Transparency \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem\-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* Metrics\-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

 JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

 As a Software Engineer I at JPMorgan Chase within the Model Risk Governance \& Review (MRGR) team, you will be developing tools for MRGR Analytics to improve efficiency and reduce duplication of effort, including resource management and cost optimization tools. You will be delivering high\-quality solutions by emphasizing the importance of data controls, testing, user experience and continuously seek input from users to align efforts with their objectives. Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient.
   

  

 The team is responsible for conducting independent model validation and model governance activities to help identify, measure, and mitigate Model Risk in the firm. Within MRGR, the Chief Operating Office (COO) supports model risk stakeholders in their review and governance activities, and drives certain governance activities itself, with responsibility for: product ownership, process engineering and software development for model risk technology and analytics; model risk reporting; administration of oversight committees; project management of the review and governance pipeline; coordination of regulatory/audit deliverables including capital stress testing exercises; and general business management. * Develop tools to automate various tasks in the model governance and review lifecycle.

* Translate the existing business requirements in model risk management space into business applications using applied development work mostly in Python using in\-house built Python framework.
* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into existing systems to enhance automation, reporting capabilities and decision\-making processes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities for LLM integration and develop solutions that leverage LLM capabilities.
* Build intelligent solutions to support the activities of MRGR staff.

* Experience with integrating machine learning models, including LLMs, into enterprise applications.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interface with other functional areas in the firm on business requirements.
* Risk and control mindset: ability to think critically, assess user needs and create design solutions to meet user needs.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Experience in working with large data sets.
* Exposure to LLM integration and deployment in real\-world applications.
* Strong UI/UX designing skills.
* Experience in model risk management or financial services space.

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Data Analyst – Client Success
description:
**Data Analyst – Client Success \| Finovate Global** 




 Location: Gurugram (in\-office), Bengaluru (in\-office) \| Experience: 0–3 years \| Function: Analytics \& Client Success
   





**The opportunity:** 




  





 India's ₹40\+ lakh crore lending ecosystem runs on one thing after disbursal: collections.
 



 It is one of the largest, most manual, most broken workflows in financial services and Finovate Global is rebuilding it with agentic AI.
 



  





 AVIO, our AI platform, autonomously conducts collections conversations for India's leading NBFCs and financial institutions. It has crossed 10 Lakh\+ (1 million) calls per day with ZERO Humans involved and is scaling toward 3 million calls a day. Also, interacting via Whatsapp, Emails, SMS and holding billions of interactions in a month.
 



  





 Every one of those interactions generates data: who answered, what was said, what was promised, what was paid. Buried in that data is the answer to the only question our clients care about,
 *how do we recover more, faster, at lower cost?* 




  





 We're hiring a
 **Data Analyst – Client Success** 
 to own that question end to end.
 



  





  





**What you'll own** 



* **Campaign design.** 
 Take client portfolio data and design the calling strategy: segmentation, timing, channel mix, retry logic, bot persona selection. You decide who gets called, when, and how.
* **Outcome analytics.** 
 Measure everything: connect rates, PTP rates, kept rates, recovery percentages, cost per rupee collected. Diagnose what's working, kill what isn't, and run the next iteration.
* **Client reporting.** 
 Build and present the reports our clients run their reviews on. You'll sit across from client teams, walk them through the numbers, defend the strategy, and convert their feedback into the next campaign.
* **Continuous improvement.** 
 This is not one\-and\-done reporting. You'll run a standing measure \> analyse \> improve loop on every live portfolio, and your campaigns' recovery numbers are your scorecard.



**Why this role is different** 




  




* **Your analysis moves crores.** 
 A 1% lift in recovery rate on our portfolio is not a dashboard metric, it's real money our clients see in their books. Few analyst roles anywhere offer feedback loops this direct.
* **You own the client room.** 
 Most analysts hand their work to someone else to present. Here, the person who did the analysis is the person the client hears it from. You'll build genuine client\-management skill years before your peers.
* **Production AI, not spreadsheet theatre.** 
 You'll work on top of a live agentic AI system, tuning how autonomous voice agents behave at scale through the campaigns you design.
* **Founder proximity.** 
 You work directly with the CEO. Good analysis becomes strategy in days.



  





**Who we're looking for** 



* 0–3 years of experience. Exceptional freshers with demonstrated analytical rigour are strongly encouraged.
* Deep, genuine love for data — you're fluent in Excel/Google Sheets at an advanced level; SQL and Python/dashboarding (Power BI, Metabase, or similar) are strong pluses.
* Execution bias. You'd rather ship the campaign and learn from the numbers than perfect the plan.
* Client\-ready communication — you can turn a messy analysis into a crisp narrative and hold your ground in a review meeting.
* Structured, first\-principles thinking; comfort with ambiguity and ownership.
* Exposure to lending, collections, or BFSI data is a plus, not a requirement — we'll teach you the domain.



  





  





**How to apply** 




  





 Skip the cover letter. Send us:
 


1. Your resume/LinkedIn
2. **One short exercise:** 
 we'll share a small anonymised sample of call\-outcome data. Send back one page: what you see, what you'd change in the next campaign, and why.



 The exercise matters more than the resume.
 



  





 Write to: careers@finovateglobal.com
 



  





  





 📩 Apply: https://www.finovateglobal.com/company/careers
 



*Finovate Global Private Limited \| ISO 27001:2022 certified \| Gurugram \|* 

 Bengaluru

The WBG Budget and Procurement (WBP) is organized into five Departments: WBP Centers of Excellence (WBPCE) with teams supporting the corporate strategic business and budget planning process, providing WBP systems, knowledge, and shared services; WBP IBRD/IDA Regional Units (WBPRU) with teams supporting IBRD/IDA clients in the regions; WBP IFC/MIGA Budget Partners (CSRDR) with teams supporting IFC/MIGA clients in the HQ and the regions; WBP Corporate Units (WBPCU) with teams supporting the Knowledge Bank and corporate units and providing capital budget support; and WBP Corporate Procurement (WBPCP) with teams providing group\-wide procurement services.


**Unit Context**


Steps to continue evolving the management structure of WBPCP with its strategic priorities present the opportunity to recruit for an expanded managerial role in the Department. In line with the WBP global footprint strategy and delivery model, the location of the positions may be Washington D.C., Chennai, or Sofia. In accordance with World Bank Group policy, positions in Country Offices, irrespective of level, are subject to local recruitment. Selections to positions outside of Washington D.C. will be LRS. Business needs and candidate preference will be considered in determining the actual location of each of the positions described below:


Manager, Procurement Operations \& Advisory is responsible for all operational and advisory functions within the Corporate Procurement department. These include the Corporate Procurement Service Desk, Order Management, Vendor Management, governance monitoring, systems support and administration, and regional procurement advisory, amongst others. Manages a global team of 35 staff based in the HQ, Global Business Centers (GBC), and in each of the seven regions of the WBG to support the decentralized footprint of WBG clients.


**Duties and accountabilities:**


Manager, WBPPS has the following three areas of responsibility:


**A)Business Management Responsibilities**


* Manage the teams providing planning, budgeting, and performance reporting services; conducting analytical work and providing advisory services in areas of focus (e.g., operations, investments in technology); and providing other services as needed over time.


* Is an active member of the WBP Leadership Team, participates in cross cutting activities, and from time to time, takes on leadership roles in WBP\-wide activities, such as recruitment and other HR initiatives.


* Provides support and advice to the Vice President and the Director of WBP, Corporate Procurement as requested.


**B)Talent Management Responsibilities**


* Manages the unit staff, including recruitment, evaluation, and career development of staff.


* Provides leadership and support to her/his staff to build sustainable finance skills and capacity to effectively deliver WBP services.


* Manages and oversees the engagement and evaluation of technical consultants within the WBPCP unit, as needed.


**C)Budget Management Responsibilities**


* Effectively and efficiently manages his/her unit’s resources, ensuring its effective formulation and input into budget decisions.


* Advocates and drives cost\-effective delivery of business finance services, promoting transparency, simplicity, standardization, and automation.

**Selection Criteria**


The successful candidate should be recognized for an ability to get things done, strategic thinking and execution leadership, reputation and track record leading large business transformation initiatives, being a problem\-solver, and possessing accomplishments relevant to the WBG’s strategic agenda.


The successful candidate will have an active interest in the activities of the World Bank Group, its mission, products and services in addition to having a strong work ethics and unquestionable integrity, and should possess strong leadership in multicultural environment, and analytical abilities as well as excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills adaptable to all audiences, including Board level.


The candidate should have a minimum of a Master’s degree in relevant field/discipline (e.g., Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law, etc.), coupled with a minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in procurement, with a strong track record of success in leading and managing complex procurement operations.


The ideal candidate should also possess as many of the following professional and personal characteristics as possible:


* Deep understanding of procurement principles, practices, and regulations, including international procurement standards.


* Strong strategic orientation and ability to manage successfully large work programs and extensively decentralized teams.


* Demonstrated ability to conceptualize complex issues with future focused systematic thinking and frame problems as actionable issues with ability to develop consensus among diverse constituents.


* Proven ability to balance client concerns with wider corporate concerns as well as proven ability to interact effectively with WBG and external counterparts.


* Proven change integrator with ability to effectively lead and implement complex change management initiatives.


* Strong understanding of the workings of the organizational context including the matrix environment with deep functional knowledge of the challenges of resource deployment in Operations.


* Demonstrated effectiveness in collaboration across the Organization including Operations and Corporate functions and proven ability to build common goals and solutions while managing different views.


WBG Managerial Competencies

**WBG Culture Attributes:**


1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  

2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  

3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.



**POSITION SUMMARY**  

We're looking for a highly creative and self\-motivated Senior Product Designer to join EarnIn's Financial Intelligence Platform team. This is a structured, quality\-focused group responsible for designing and improving the foundational experiences that power EarnIn's modern platform for financial flexibility and financial wellness for its community members. You'll work closely with product, engineering, design, compliance, risk, and finance partners to define and drive design excellence across core features like bank connectivity, earnings tracking, and repayment experiences. This role bridges deep design leadership with cross\-functional execution, championing both customer and business value while ensuring quality, simplicity, and regulatory compliance. Your work will directly influence customer satisfaction and retention across our core experiences.

This position will be a hybrid role based in our Bengaluru office, with 2 days on\-site as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Palo Alto HQ. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
* Design and refine core experiences across the full customer journey—from bank connection and account setup to earnings tracking and repayment experiences
* Partner with PMs, engineering, and data teams to define design requirements and validate solutions through research and usability testing
* Establish and maintain design patterns and systems that ensure consistency and simplicity across Financial Intelligence Platform features
* Identify friction points in critical flows and design thoughtful solutions that improve usability, clarity, confidence, and compliance
* Leverage research findings and customer feedback to inform design strategy and prioritize improvements that deliver measurable impact
* Champion quality and polish, ensuring every interaction reflects EarnIn's commitment to reliability, trust, and regulatory standards
* Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, and Finance teams to ensure designs meet industry and regulatory requirements
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and design excellence within the team

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
* 7\+ years of experience designing consumer\-facing digital products, with demonstrated success on core experiences or core functionality
* A strong portfolio showcasing thoughtful problem\-solving, systematic design, and measurable improvements to user satisfaction and retention
* Deep understanding of financial products, user trust, and how to design for clarity in complex workflows
* Ability to balance creative thinking with research\-driven validation, comfortable collaborating with data teams to measure impact
* Excellent storytelling and communication skills, particularly in articulating design rationale to cross\-functional stakeholders at all levels
* Skilled in Figma, prototyping tools, and modern design workflows
* Comfortable in structured environments where roadmaps are planned across product areas, with the ability to drive projects to completion
* Passion for solving real customer problems and improving financial wellness for everyday people
* Background in systems design, design patterns, or design operations preferred
* Experience improving user satisfaction and retention metrics through design\-driven solutions is preferred

\#LI\-Hybrid
A Note on AI in the Hiring Process: EarnIn may use Artificial Intelligence (AI)\-powered tools during the hiring process, including tools that generate summaries or notes for interviewers, review resumes, assist with scheduling, or help identify themes across candidate responses and profiles for a given role. Final hiring decisions are made by human interviewers and hiring managers. If you have any concerns about the use of AI in our hiring process, please connect with your recruiter. With your consent, EarnIn may use AI tools to help transcribe or summarize interviews. Recordings are treated as confidential candidate data and are accessible only to authorized hiring personnel. Declining to be recorded will not negatively affect your candidacy or evaluation.  


At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E\-Verify participant.

  



EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

title: APAC Benefits Coordinator
description:
Barracuda is looking for a Regional Employee Benefits Manager to support the accurate, compliant and employee\-focused delivery of benefit programs across assigned countries. This role combines operational benefits administration, employee support, vendor coordination and process discipline to deliver a consistent benefits experience aligned with regional requirements and globalb benefits standards.


This role will act as the first point of contact for employee and manager inquiries related to benefits and will primarily support APAC plan operations and employee lifecycle events. The role will work closely with the Director, Global Benefits and brokers/consultants, who will retain ownership of plan strategy, renewals, and vendor management.


This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys operational excellence, employee interaction, and building scalable processes in a global environment.

**What You’ll Be Working On**

* **Administer regional benefits programmes**: Deliver day\-to\-day administration for health, wellbeing, retirement, insurance, leave and other employee benefit programmes across assigned countries or markets.
* **Manage enrolment and employee changes**: Process benefit enrolments, life event changes, eligibility updates, employee contributions and data submissions in partnership with HR Operations, Payroll and external providers.
* **Resolve employee and HR enquiries**: Serve as a point of contact for benefits questions, providing clear guidance to employees, managers and HR partners and escalating complex or sensitive matters where needed.
* **Coordinate vendors and brokers**: Work with benefit providers, brokers and internal stakeholders to resolve service issues, track deliverables, support renewals and maintain reliable service delivery.
* **Maintain compliance and governance**: Keep accurate records, support audits, monitor local statutory and regulatory requirements, and help ensure plans are administered in line with company policy and regional obligations.
* **Support communications and continuous improvement**: Contribute to employee communications, open enrolment activities, reporting and process improvements that increase benefits awareness, engagement and operational effectiveness.

**What You Bring to the Role**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field; or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of experience in benefits administration, HR operations, or a similar support role
* Experience supporting APAC benefits programs or working in a multi\-country environment strongly preferred (Australia, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, and India)
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in data management
* Customer\-first mindset with a strong commitment to delivering excellent employee support
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively in a fast\-paced, global environment
* Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information simply
* Experience working with HRIS systems and ticketing tools preferred
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work cross\-functionally with HR, Payroll, Finance, and external vendors

 **Scope \& Role Clarity**

* This role is focused on operations, administration, and Tier 1 support
* Plan design, renewals, and vendor strategy will be owned by the Global Benefits team
* The role may expand over time to include additional regional or HR operational support

Applicare is a home appliance repair \& service company. We're looking for an HR Manager to own the full employee lifecycle for our field technician workforce and office staff — from hiring through attendance, payroll, and offboarding — using our in\-house HR management system.

Our India office serves as a strategic operations support center, providing real\-time assistance to our US restaurant teams in operations, administration, marketing, HR, accounting, and project management.

**Job Summary**

The US Process Operations Executive will be responsible for providing operational support to multiple restaurant locations across the United States during US business hours. This role acts as the communication bridge between restaurant managers, vendors, franchise partners, and the corporate office to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining excellent communication with US\-based teams.

**Restaurant Operations**

* Monitor daily restaurant operations across assigned locations.
* Coordinate with Restaurant General Managers regarding operational issues.
* Track store opening and closing compliance.
* Follow up on maintenance requests until resolution.
* Monitor service quality and operational performance.
* Ensure operational SOPs are followed across locations.

Number of successful hires or closures completed.

Hiring\-manager and candidate satisfaction.

title: Sr. Manager, Accounting (India)
description:
**About Vercel:**
-----------------



Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what's next.



For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.



Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.



We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like **OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide**. Whether you're building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you'll help define what comes next.

**About the Role:**



Vercel is scaling fast, and the Senior Manager, Accounting will be a critical hire as we build out the financial infrastructure that supports our global growth and path to the public markets. You will own end\-to\-end accounting operations for Vercel's statutory accounting across current and future entities, from monthly close and statutory compliance to audit support and process improvement. Working closely with the Head of Finance, India Center of Excellence, the US\-based Controller and global finance team, you'll bring rigor, ownership, and a builder's mindset to a function that is growing quickly.



This role is fully remote from your home office in India, with regular overlap hours with the US team. You will report to the Head of Finance, CoE who is also based in India.


**What You Will Do:**


* Lead the full\-cycle monthly and quarterly close for Vercel's current and future international entities, setting clear standards for accuracy, completeness, and timeliness in accordance with both local and US GAAP.
* Guide and support accounts payable and accounts receivable teams for correct accounting, manage payroll accounting and intercompany transactions in coordination with the global finance team.
* Own statutory compliance including preparation and supporting filing of FS, auditsTDS/TCS returns,, and coordination with external auditors and tax advisors. Also coordinate with the corporate secretaries for various secretarial compliance.
* Partner with the US\-based Controller and CAO on the global close; prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial statements.
* Partner with SOX leader helping with Design, implement, and evolve SOX\-aligned controls and internal accounting policies for the international entities as the business scales amd execute these controls consistently
* Lead close process improvements and accelerate the closing process; identify automation and AI opportunities, simplify workflows, and build scalable infrastructure for the finance function.
* Own the audit relationship for these international entities; preparing materials, answering auditor questions, and keeping audits running smoothly.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Legal, HR, FP\&A, and Revenue Operations on new business initiatives with accounting implications.
* Mentor and develop junior accounting staff as the CoE team grows.
* Support the US GAAP Accounting for the US based entity(s) as and when required in different areas.
* Help the organization in pre and post merger and acquisition activities such as due diligence, integrating the acquired entities, supporting compliance, data migration, etc.
* Lead the new entities setup in different countries representing the accounting team and having these entities operational.
* Monitor changes in local GAAP, tax, regulatory, and corporate compliance requirements for international entities and ensure timely implementation in accounting processes.
* Support cash, banking, treasury accounting, and foreign exchange accounting matters for international entities, including bank reconciliations, revaluations, realized/unrealized FX, and cash reporting.


**About You:**


* 12\+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 5\+ years in managing a team.
* CA (Chartered Accountant) designation required; CPA or equivalent international qualification is a plus.
* Deep expertise in technical accounting, including IFRS and US GAAP, with the ability to research, interpret, and apply local GAAP, statutory accounting requirements, tax regulations, and regulatory reporting obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems; NetSuite strongly preferred.
* Proven track record managing or supporting Big 4 / top\-tier audits.
* Experience at a high\-growth technology or SaaS company; must have prior exposure to multi\-entity, international accounting structures.
* Process\-minded and curious, with experience leveraging AI, automation, and systems to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Clear, confident communicator who collaborates effectively across remote, cross\-functional, and cross\-cultural teams.
* Self\-starter who thrives in an async\-first environment with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable working in a builder environment where processes may be evolving, documentation may need to be created from scratch, and the role requires both strategic thinking and hands\-on execution.


The India annual base pay range for this role is 6,942,000\.00 to 8,678,000\.00 (INR). The total compensation package may include benefits, equity\-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.



Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

Multi\-Unit Production Oversight

* **Plan, organize, and monitor day\-to\-day production activities across all assigned** manufacturing units
* Ensure production schedules are met across units while balancing capacity, demand, and resource allocation

* Resolve escalations from individual units and ensure consistent HR/IR practices

Cost \& Resource Management

* **Monitor machine uptime, maintenance schedules, and capital equipment needs across** plants
* Optimize production capacity utilization across the unit network

Reporting \& Coordination

* **Consolidate and present production MIS, KPIs, and performance dashboards across all** **units to senior management**
* Liaise with Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, and Sales teams to align production with demand forecasts
* **Drive continuous improvement (Kaizen/Lean) initiatives across the manufacturing** network

Key Skills \& Competencies

* **Strong multi\-site/multi\-unit operations management experience**
* Sound knowledge of food manufacturing processes, FSSAI norms, and quality systems(HACCP, ISO 22000\)
* **Excellent people management and cross\-location team leadership skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* **Proficiency in MS Excel/ERP systems (SAP preferred)**
* Willingness to travel frequently between units

Qualifications \& Experience

* **Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering, Food Technology, or related field; MBA**
* preferred
* 8–14 years of experience in factory/plant management, with at least 3–4 years managing
* multiple units
* **Experience in FMCG/Food/Sweets \& Confectionery manufacturing preferred(5\-6 years experience)**
