title: HR Partner, Ops Field HRP
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, our HR Regional Partners are known for their knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as the front\-line consultants to the business supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They operate independently and are seen as subject matter experts, having deep knowledge in local programs, processes, and policies. They offer strong, credible and compelling advice to business leaders on how to manage their team. They are committed to collaboration with multiple HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees in across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases. Analyze data and trends on Employee Relations and performance management, in order to provide input to the business strategy with the relevant HR Business Partner to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Manage employees’ programs and support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience. Provide support to HR Business Partners and the business on change initiatives


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. The HRP team’s role is also to standardize best practices across India, due to our extensive insights across business lines.

**Job Description:**  

Job Description
  
  

Wipro is seeking a senior Learning \& Development Leader to lead enterprise\-wide workforce skilling and capability\-building for a large Global Business Line or Strategic Market Unit. The role will be responsible for shaping and executing skilling strategy, enabling business readiness, workforce transformation, and deployment preparedness.
  
  

The leader will also represent Talent Skilling in client\-facing forums, position Wipro's skilling capabilities as a strategic business differentiator, and help build market\-facing skilling offerings that can be taken to existing and new customers.
  
  

͏
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Enterprise Talent Skilling Leadership
  
Own and drive the skilling strategy for a large business unit, GBL or SMU.
  
Lead capability transformation across technology skills, future skills and business\-critical workforce priorities.
  
Partner with senior business stakeholders to identify skill gaps and build strategic skilling roadmaps.
  
Enable reskilling, upskilling, deployment readiness, bench capability development and workforce mobility.
  
Measure skilling outcomes, adoption and impact at scale across a large employee base.
  
Learning Ecosystem \& Partner Management
  
Engage and manage platform partners, assessment partners, lab partners, skilling partners and certification providers.
  
Identify and integrate external learning capabilities that improve speed, quality and relevance of workforce readiness.
  
Optimize learning investments and drive scalable capability\-building models.
  
Customer Engagement \& Client Representation
  
Represent Wipro Talent Skilling in customer visits, executive forums, client presentations and strategic workshops.
  
Articulate Wipro's skilling strengths, workforce transformation capabilities and talent readiness value proposition to customers.
  
Partner with business and sales stakeholders to position skilling as an enabler of customer transformation outcomes.
  
͏
  
Skilling as a Service / Offering Development
  
Build and shape reusable skilling offerings that Wipro can take to existing and new customers.
  
Design learning solutions embedded into customer transformation programs
  
Develop offering constructs, solution models, cost models, pricing models and execution frameworks.

title: HR Payroll Executive
description:
**HR PAYROLL EXECUTIVE**

Company: **Eltro Cyberchrome Private Limited**  
Location: Chengannur, Alappuzha District, Kerala

Employment Type: Full\-time, Permanent  
Monthly Salary: ₹20,000  
Experience: Minimum 2 years preferred

Working Days: Monday to Saturday  
Office Hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM  
Weekly Off: Sunday

We are looking for a responsible, organised, and experienced HR \& Payroll Executive to manage recruitment, payroll, PF/ESI coordination, employee attendance, staff performance tracking, employee documentation and day\-to\-day human resource operations.

The selected candidate will work from the company’s new office in Chengannur and coordinate directly with employees, management, accountants and statutory compliance consultants.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The HR \& Payroll Executive will support the complete employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, attendance, payroll, statutory documentation, performance monitoring, employee relations and exit formalities.

The ideal candidate should have practical HR and payroll knowledge, excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential employee information professionally.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**(1\)** *Payroll Management*

* Collect and verify monthly attendance, leave, overtime, incentives and salary information
* Prepare and process monthly employee payroll accurately and on time
* Calculate salary, loss of pay, overtime, incentives, reimbursements and deductions
* Prepare monthly salary sheets and employee payslips
* Verify employee bank and salary details
* Coordinate with the accounts department for salary disbursement
* Maintain payroll registers and month\-wise salary records
* Respond to employee salary queries professionally
* Submit the final payroll statement to management for approval
* Maintain complete confidentiality of employee salary information

**(2\)** *PF, ESI and Statutory Coordination*

* Calculate employee and employer PF/ESI contributions, where applicable
* Maintain employee UAN, PF, ESI and KYC records
* Support new\-employee UAN and statutory registrations
* Update employee details in statutory records
* Prepare information required for monthly PF/ESI challans and returns
* Coordinate monthly filings and payments with the accountant or compliance consultant
* Maintain copies of challans, returns and related compliance documents
* Assist employees with routine PF, UAN and ESI queries
* Monitor monthly statutory deadlines
* Report missing documents or compliance concerns to management

**(3\)** *Attendance and Leave Management*

* Monitor employees’ daily attendance and working hours
* Maintain login, logout, late arrival and early departure records
* Record employee absences and approved leave
* Review leave applications and obtain the necessary approval
* Maintain individual leave balances
* Follow up regarding missing attendance or unauthorised absence
* Calculate loss of pay according to company policy
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly attendance reports
* Maintain holiday and weekly\-off records

**(4\)** *Staff Monitoring and Performance Tracking*

* Collect daily or weekly work reports from employees
* Maintain department\-wise task and performance trackers
* Monitor assigned duties, deadlines and task\-completion status
* Follow up on delayed, incomplete or unreported work
* Monitor punctuality, responsiveness and workplace discipline
* Prepare weekly and monthly employee performance reports
* Coordinate performance\-review meetings
* Document performance feedback and improvement requirements
* Report repeated attendance, discipline or performance concerns to management
* Ensure monitoring is based on attendance, assigned responsibilities and measurable work output

**(5\)** *Recruitment and Selection*

* Discuss manpower requirements with management
* Prepare job descriptions for approved vacancies
* Publish advertisements on Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri and other authorised platforms
* Source candidates through job portals, social media and referrals
* Review CVs and shortlist suitable candidates
* Conduct preliminary telephone or in\-person HR interviews
* Evaluate candidates’ qualifications, experience, communication and availability
* Schedule final interviews with management
* Follow up with candidates regarding interview status
* Conduct reference or previous\-employment checks when authorised
* Communicate offers within the salary approved by management
* Maintain an accurate recruitment tracker
* Prepare weekly recruitment\-status reports

**(6\)** *Employee Onboarding*

* Prepare approved offer letters and appointment letters
* Collect identity, address, education, employment and bank documents
* Verify that required joining documents have been submitted
* Create individual employee files
* Complete payroll, PF, ESI and employee\-record formalities
* Conduct employee induction and orientation
* Explain office hours, attendance, leave, reporting and company policies
* Coordinate employee email, system and workplace access
* Update the employee master database
* Follow up with new employees during probation

**(7\)** *Employee Records and HR Documentation*

* Maintain complete physical and digital employee files
* Keep the employee master database accurate and updated
* Maintain copies of employment contracts and employee correspondence
* Prepare confirmation, increment and designation\-change letters
* Prepare approved warning, show\-cause and disciplinary letters
* Issue salary certificates and other authorised HR documents
* Maintain records of management approvals
* Update changes in salary, designation, department and reporting manager
* Ensure employee records are securely stored
* Protect confidential employee and company information

**(8\)** *Employee Relations*

* Serve as the first point of contact for routine employee HR queries
* Communicate company policies and management instructions
* Receive and document employee grievances
* Escalate serious or sensitive matters to management
* Support the professional resolution of workplace concerns
* Maintain confidentiality when handling employee complaints
* Encourage professional conduct and respectful communication
* Coordinate employee announcements, meetings and engagement activities

**(9\)** *HR Policies and Workplace Discipline*

* Assist management in preparing and updating basic HR policies
* Communicate approved policies to employees
* Collect employee acknowledgement of important policies
* Monitor compliance with attendance, leave and reporting procedures
* Document workplace misconduct and policy violations
* Prepare authorised notices and warnings
* Maintain records of disciplinary action and employee responses
* Ensure that major disciplinary decisions receive management approval

**(10\)** *Performance Review and Development*

* Maintain employee goals and performance indicators
* Coordinate probation and periodic performance reviews
* Collect performance feedback from reporting managers
* Prepare performance\-review summaries
* Track probation confirmation and salary\-review dates
* Monitor approved performance\-improvement plans
* Follow up on employee improvement actions
* Identify basic training requirements
* Coordinate employee training and development activities
* Maintain training and performance records

**(11\)** *Resignation and Exit Formalities*

* Receive and acknowledge employee resignations
* Verify the applicable notice period
* Coordinate work handover and department clearance
* Ensure the return of company property and documents
* Coordinate deactivation of company access
* Conduct or coordinate exit interviews
* Prepare an employee exit summary
* Provide payroll information for final settlement
* Coordinate full\-and\-final settlement with accounts and management
* Prepare approved experience and relieving letters
* Update the employee master database and exit records

**(12\)** *HR Reports and Management Support*

* Prepare daily attendance reports
* Prepare weekly recruitment and staff\-status reports
* Prepare monthly payroll, leave and compliance reports
* Maintain recruitment, onboarding, performance and exit trackers
* Highlight pending approvals and statutory deadlines
* Report important employee concerns to management
* Support management with HR and related administrative activities

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce or a related field
* Minimum two years of practical HR or payroll experience preferred
* Practical experience in monthly payroll preparation
* Working knowledge of PF, ESI, UAN and employee KYC procedures
* Experience in recruitment, interviewing and employee onboarding
* Knowledge of attendance, leave and employee\-documentation processes
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and Google Sheets
* Ability to prepare salary sheets, reports and HR trackers
* Good written and spoken English
* Good Malayalam communication skills
* Strong organisational and time\-management ability
* Professional communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
* High level of confidentiality, integrity and attention to detail

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Previous experience as an HR Executive, Payroll Executive or HR Generalist
* Experience coordinating with accountants or statutory consultants
* Familiarity with HRMS, attendance and payroll software
* Knowledge of applicable labour and employment requirements
* Ability to prepare professional HR letters and reports
* Experience handling employee grievances and workplace concerns
* Strong interviewing and candidate\-screening ability

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 per month

If you would like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. Workforce Staffing (WFS), a division of Worldwide Operations People, Product \& Tech, manages Amazon’s Tier 1 talent (Front\-line associates) supply chain. We attract, hire, and onboard the associates who, by fulfilling orders at the frontlines of the company, make Amazon a global leader in delivery and logistics. This encompasses market analytics, candidate attraction and communication, strategic sourcing, staffing execution at scale, and vendor management. These processes enable our business partners to meet customer expectations by matching talent supply with demand.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Role: Business Analyst (0–2 Years)**

**Company:** FSC

**Location:** Surat (Remote)

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Experience:** 0 to 2 Years (Freshers Welcome!)

About the Role

The **Business Analyst** is the "engine room" of our consulting engagements. In this role, you will gather ground\-zero facts, conduct data analysis, and build the analytical foundation for our client solutions. You will work directly on client sites across diverse industries, rotating through Operations, HR, Sales, and Audit Consulting.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Data Collection \& Fact\-Gathering**

* Visit client factories and offices to collect production, quality, inventory, HR, and sales data.
* Issue data requests to client teams, follow up consistently, and maintain data trackers.
* Clean, structure, and reconcile raw data while flagging gaps or inconsistencies.
* Maintain engagement data rooms with proper file\-naming and version control.

**2\. Analysis \& Modeling**

* Build robust Excel models (cost sheets, capacity utilization, attrition, sales pipelines).
* Calculate and track engagement KPIs (OEE, cycle time, defect rates, gross margins, etc.).
* Run first\-level root\-cause analysis and perform benchmarking comparisons.

**3\. Client Deliverables**

* Draft high\-quality PowerPoint slides, dashboards, and report sections using FSC templates.
* Build clear, self\-explanatory charts, tables, and exhibits.
* Rigorously proofread all data, formatting, and content before submissions.

**4\. Audit \& Operations Support**

* Complete FSC Pro Audit checklists and digital\-maturity assessments.
* Capture site evidence (photos, documents, readings) and populate 90\-day implementation roadmaps.

Who We Are Looking For

**Education Qualification:**

* **Must\-Have:** Bachelor's degree — B.E. / B.Tech (Mechanical, Production, Industrial), B.Com, BBA, or MBA (Any Specialization).
* **Preferred:** Engineering with manufacturing/shop\-floor exposure, MBA\-HR / MSW, or BBA/MBA\-Marketing.

**Technical \& Core Skills:**

* Advanced MS Excel \& data handling skills
* Professional PowerPoint slide\-writing
* Basic process mapping \& manufacturing KPIs knowledge
* Ability to read basic P\&L / financial statements
* **Preferred:** Lean/5S awareness, basic Power BI, and fluency in Hindi/Gujarati for shop\-floor interaction.

**Key Traits:**

* Detail\-obsessed, structured, and analytical thinker
* High curiosity, coachability, and strong work ethic
* Dependable and self\-driven

What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months)

* Delivers clean, error\-free analysis on time with minimal rework.
* Trusted to independently manage site data collection at client locations.

Compensation \& Benefits

* **Fixed CTC:** ₹3\.0 LPA – ₹6\.0 LPA (Based on experience \& capability)
* **Monthly Take\-Home:** Approx. ₹25,000 – ₹50,000 / month
* Performance\-linked variable bonus included.

**How to Apply:**

Send your updated resume to **vrundafsc@gmail.com** with the subject line **"Application: Business Analyst \- \[Your Name]"** or apply directly on this post!

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Software Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
  
  

MuleSoft – Fresher / Entry\-Level
  
  

Role Overview
  
  

We are seeking a motivated MuleSoft Fresher to join our integration team. The candidate will assist in designing, developing, and deploying APIs and integrations using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. This role is ideal for individuals with a foundational understanding of APIs, integration concepts, and Java who are eager to build scalable enterprise solutions.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Assist in developing APIs and integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (Mule 4\)
* Support the design and implementation of RESTful and SOAP web services
* Work with Anypoint Studio for development and debugging
* Participate in API\-led connectivity (System, Process, Experience layers)

* Collaborate with senior developers, architects, and business analysts
* Assist in deployment and monitoring via Anypoint Runtime Manager / CloudHub
* Work with DataWeave for data transformation (JSON, XML, CSV)
* Maintain technical documentation for APIs and integration solutions
* Follow best practices for error handling, logging, and security


Required Skills Qualifications
  
  

Educational Background
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field


Technical Skills
  
* Basic understanding of:
* APIs (REST/SOAP)
* HTTP/HTTPS protocols
* JSON, XML data formats
* Familiarity with Java (preferred but not mandatory)
* Exposure to MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (training/certification is a plus)
* Knowledge of DataWeave basics
* Understanding of integration concepts and middleware


Preferred Skills (Good to Have)
  
* MuleSoft Certification (e.g., MuleSoft Certified Developer – Level 1\)
* Exposure to:
* Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Git/version control systems
* CI/CD pipelines
* Basic understanding of:
* RAML / OpenAPI specifications
* Microservices architecture


Soft Skills
  
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Good communication and teamwork skills
* Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Attention to detail


Key Tools Technologies

As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.

description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

title: Software Engineer (Data Engineering)
description:
**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India
   

  

**About Nference**
 nference is an AI\-first healthcare technology company dedicated to accelerating biomedical discovery and transforming healthcare through cutting\-edge artificial intelligence and large\-scale computing. Our platforms help pharmaceutical companies, healthcare providers, and research organizations unlock insights from complex clinical, molecular, and imaging data to drive better decisions and improve patient outcomes.
   

  

 Founded with the vision of solving some of healthcare's most challenging problems, nference combines deep expertise in software engineering, machine learning, data science, and life sciences to build products that make a meaningful impact on global healthcare. Recognized by The Washington Post as the "Google of Biomedicine," we continue to push the boundaries of innovation by partnering with leading healthcare institutions and industry pioneers.
   

  

**Our People**
 Our people are our greatest strength. At nference, you'll work alongside exceptional software engineers, AI researchers, physicians, scientists, and product leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful, real\-world problems.
   

  

 We foster a culture built on ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Engineers are encouraged to challenge assumptions, contribute ideas, influence technical direction, and take ownership of their work from concept to production. Whether you're building scalable data pipelines, enabling analytics platforms, or developing cloud\-native data solutions, you'll collaborate with some of the brightest minds in technology and healthcare.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We're looking for a
 **Software Engineer (Data Engineering)** 
 who is passionate about building scalable data pipelines and enabling reliable, high\-quality data platforms. In this role, you'll contribute to the development of data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration workflows that power our AI\-driven healthcare products.
   

  

 You'll collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, AI researchers, and product teams to solve data engineering challenges while building reliable, maintainable, and scalable data solutions. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, cloud technologies, and modern data engineering tools.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build and maintain batch ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest and transform data from internal and external sources.
* Write and optimize SQL queries for data cleaning, transformation, and aggregation.
* Implement data quality checks, including schema validation, null checks, and deduplication within data pipelines.
* Support orchestration workflows using Airflow, dbt, ADF, or similar tools by scheduling, monitoring, and troubleshooting job runs.
* Debug pipeline failures using logs and resolve issues related to data inconsistencies, schema changes, or infrastructure failures.
* Collaborate with analysts, data scientists, backend engineers, and cross\-functional teams to understand and deliver data requirements.
* Work with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift for data storage and querying.
* Contribute to data modeling using fact and dimension tables while maintaining documentation for datasets and pipelines.
* Automate repetitive data engineering tasks using Python and scripting.
* Continuously improve data pipeline reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 1–3 years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related role.
* Proficiency in Python (preferred) or another programming language.
* Strong knowledge of SQL.
* Working knowledge or exposure to orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory (ADF), or similar technologies.
* Basic understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data pipeline workflows.
* Familiarity with relational databases and data warehousing concepts, including fact and dimension tables.
* Exposure to at least one cloud platform (AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure) and cloud data warehouses.
* Basic debugging skills for identifying and resolving data and pipeline issues.
* Basic understanding of database performance optimization and query tuning.
* Working knowledge of development tools, version control systems, and basic software testing practices.
* Exposure to big data technologies such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, or Kafka.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB.
* Experience working with cloud\-native data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to AI/ML or data\-intensive applications.
* Contributions to open\-source projects are a plus.


**Why Join nference?**
 At nference, you'll work on technology that has the potential to transform healthcare and improve lives across the world. Every engineering challenge you solve contributes to advancing biomedical research, accelerating drug discovery, and enabling better clinical decisions.
   

  

 You'll be part of a team that values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, where you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge data engineering technologies, solve complex data challenges, and grow alongside some of the brightest minds in software engineering, artificial intelligence, and life sciences.
   

  

 If you're excited about building scalable data platforms and software that create meaningful real\-world impact, nference is the place for you.
   

  

**Benefits \& Perks**
* Industry Prestige: Build your career at the "Google of Biomedicine" (as recognized by The Washington Post), working alongside exceptional software engineers, physicians, scientists, and researchers.
* Cutting\-Edge Innovation: Solve complex healthcare challenges using advanced AI, machine learning, and large\-scale clinical, molecular, and imaging datasets.
* Meaningful Impact: Contribute to technologies that accelerate drug discovery and biomedical research, with opportunities to be recognized as a contributing author on high\-impact scientific publications where applicable.
* Growth \& Flexibility: Thrive in a collaborative, innovation\-driven culture with continuous learning opportunities and a hybrid work model for eligible employees after successful completion of the three\-month probation period.
* Wellness \& Perks: Enjoy reimbursements for gym memberships, technology gadgets, high\-speed internet, professional development, comprehensive health insurance, and complimentary breakfast, lunch, and snacks at our Bangalore office.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 nference is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We celebrate different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences because they strengthen our teams and drive innovation. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in building technology that transforms healthcare.

**Are you a mechanical engineering fresher eager to start your career in the manufacturing industry?** 

Join ELECTROMECH as a **Trainee Mechanical Engineer** and gain practical experience in machine \`\-\+building and precision part manufacturing – all while working closely with a **small, skilled engineering team**.

**Role: Trainee Mechanical Engineer**

**Qualification : BE/DIP in Mechanical, Industrial Production,Industrial Engineering**

**Aeronatical Engineering,Automobile Engineeirng** 

**You Will Be Trained On**

* Manufacturing processes including turning, milling, drilling, and grinding.
* Preparing and understanding part drawings and tolerance analysis.
* Learn shop floor practices including CNC operations, conventional machining, and quality control.
* Hands\-on training in part fabrication, fitting, and sub\-assembly work.
* Working with a **small, experienced team** during machine assembly and testing
* Basics of mechanical design, machine drawing interpretation, Solid works

**Why a Small Team is an Advantage:**

* **Faster learning** through close interaction and one\-on\-one mentorship.
* **Greater exposure** to all stages of machine and part manufacturing.
* **Opportunities to contribute** directly and take ownership of tasks.
* **Stronger team bonding** and a more collaborative environment.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹16,500\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

title: QAE

description:
**Description**
 Tax Services responsible for the tax calculation platform, we provide the core services that calculate the accurate amount of transactional taxes (sales tax and VAT) on Amazon and share the invoices with both sellers and customers. We thrive on providing the correct tax amounts to the customer at order time, provide the accurate invoices to sellers and make sure audit records are stored safely to meet tax law requirements around the globe. Our challenges include staying on top of the complex and ever\-changing global tax rates and laws as well as computing calculations correctly and quickly, thousands of times a second, and each one needs to be right.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* We are looking for Quality Assurance Engineers who thrive on testing complex systems and relish the challenge of operating complex and mission critical systems under high loads.
* Our systems manage hundreds of millions of records, and responds to millions of service requests per minute.
* Quality Assurance Engineers at Amazon test applications and products at the user level and code level, both manually and with automated tools.
* Our QAEs are not pure black box testers, they are able to understand software internals, debug problems using log files, and write automated tests with Scripting tools and/or user\-level automated tools.
* QAEs at Amazon are excellent individual contributors capable of taking up tasks from start to completion with minimal help.
* QAEs would be responsible for understanding the domain and the product in detail and coming up with the test strategy/planning, coming up with the test cases, driving the test case sign\-off processes with the stakeholders, contributing to code level unit tests, test execution and reporting


**Job Requirements**
* Demonstrated experience in test planning, test design, test strategy, and test execution of highly complex systems.
* Ability to design and plan testing conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Demonstrated experience in writing clean scripts/code quickly.
* Preferably Java coding. Experience in various automation tools and frameworks.
* Understanding of QA methodologies, life cycle and processes Strong organizational skills, able to track multiple test executions simultaneously and synthesize the results.
* Comfortable communicating cross\-functionally and across management levels in formal and informal settings to report on test progress, metrics, issues, and risks.
* Experience in Agile/Scrum.
* Automation framework development experience.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in manual testing
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in API \& Mobile testing
* Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

description:
Customer Support Executive

**Company:** Hypha Care  
**Location:** Remote \- Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 0–3 years \| Freshers welcome  
**Salary:** ₹14,000 – ₹20,000 per month

**About the Role**

Hypha is looking for a smart, proactive **Customer Support Executive** to join our growing healthcare technology team.

This is a combined **Customer Support \+ Customer Success** role where you will work directly with clinics and healthcare teams using Hypha. You will help customers get started with the product, answer questions, solve problems, conduct training, and make sure they get the best value from the platform.

This is **not a traditional call\-centre or BPO role**. You will work closely with our customer success, product, and engineering teams and gain hands\-on exposure to **SaaS, healthcare technology, software support, product operations, customer onboarding, troubleshooting, and basic QA/testing**.

This is a full\-time **remote / work\-from\-home position for candidates currently based in Kerala**.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide customer support through WhatsApp, phone, email, and online meetings.
* Help customers understand and use Hypha's features and workflows.
* Conduct onboarding and product training for new customers.
* Troubleshoot common software and product\-related issues.
* Proactively follow up with customers and support product adoption.
* Document customer issues, bugs, feedback, and feature requests clearly.
* Coordinate with product and engineering teams to resolve technical issues.
* Test product fixes and new features when required.
* Help improve customer satisfaction, engagement, and retention.

**What We're Looking For**

* 0–3 years of experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Customer Service, Client Support, SaaS Support, Technical Support, or a related role.
* Fresh graduates with excellent communication skills and an interest in technology are encouraged to apply.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with customers through phone calls, WhatsApp, and online meetings.
* Good problem\-solving ability and attention to detail.
* Comfortable learning and using software products.
* Patient and empathetic when helping customers solve problems.
* Organized and able to follow up on multiple tasks and customer requests.
* Proactive mindset with a willingness to take ownership of problems until they are resolved.
* Ability to work independently in a remote work environment.
* Currently based in Kerala.

Candidates with previous experience as a **Customer Support Executive, Customer Service Executive, Customer Success Associate, Client Support Executive, Technical Support Executive, or Product Support Executive** are encouraged to apply.

**Remote Work Requirements**

Candidates must have:

* A personal laptop in good working condition.
* A working smartphone.
* A reliable, high\-speed internet connection.
* A suitable environment for customer calls and online meetings.

You may have an advantage if you:

* Background in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with SaaS products, CRM tools, software testing, QA, or technical troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of web or software applications.
* Ability to reproduce and clearly explain software issues to technical teams.

**Who Will Do Well in This Role?**

You could be a great fit if you are someone who:

* Enjoys talking to and helping people.
* Likes solving problems instead of simply forwarding them to someone else.
* Is naturally curious about technology.
* Can communicate clearly and patiently.
* Takes responsibility for getting things done.
* Wants to build a career in SaaS, customer success, product, or technology.

**Why Join Hypha?**

Hypha is building an **AI\-powered healthcare technology platform** that helps clinics automate workflows, improve patient engagement, and run smarter operations.

At Hypha, you will:

* Gain hands\-on exposure to **AI, SaaS, healthcare technology, and automation**.
* Work closely with product, engineering, and customer teams.
* Learn Customer Success, Product Operations, software troubleshooting, and basic QA.
* Work directly with real customers and see the impact of your work.
* Take meaningful ownership early in your career and grow as Hypha expands.

This is a great opportunity for someone interested in building a career in **SaaS, Customer Success, Product Operations, Technical Support, AI, or technology**.

Candidates from **Kozhikode, Kochi, Thrissur, Malappuram, Kannur, Palakkad, Trivandrum, and other locations across Kerala** are welcome to apply.

If you are a strong communicator, enjoy solving problems, and are excited about technology, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Manage Domain / Hosting / Email solutions for our client.
* Need you to take care of internal office Network / Server / Assets etc.
* Installation of the softwares like apache, nginx, Basic PHP, JAVA, NodeJs, React Js, Angular JS etc.
* Work with the development team to design and implement infrastructure solutions for new and existing applications.
* Set up and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS and Azure.
* Help automate the software development and deployment processes using tools like Jenkins and Gitlab.
* Build and maintain monitoring and alerting systems to ensure the reliability and availability of our applications and services using tools like Grafana, Prometheus and Zabbix or any other.
* Continuously identify and implement improvements to our infrastructure and processes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve queries.
* Coordinate with clients to understand their query and troubleshoot the same.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 
 HireNext specializes in providing MSP\-ready technical professionals who are fully aligned with managed services environments from day one. The company delivers dedicated, pre\-vetted, co\-managed talent across NOC, SOC, Cloud, Helpdesk, and Automation, integrated into clients’ tools, workflows, and service delivery models. Built by industry practitioners with over 15 years of experience running MSPs and delivering managed services at scale, HireNext understands the operational realities of world\-class NOC and SOC coverage. HireNext partners with MSPs that want to scale intelligently and efficiently, offering workforce strategies tailored to their business needs. The focus is not just on hiring, but on being a long\-term partner who has experienced the same challenges and expectations as its clients.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Security Operations Center (SOC) role based in the Mohali district. The SOC professional will monitor security events and alerts, analyze logs and network traffic, and identify potential threats or anomalies in real time. Daily responsibilities include triaging and responding to security incidents, performing initial investigation and escalation, and documenting findings and actions in accordance with established procedures and SLAs. The role involves collaborating with cybersecurity, network, and infrastructure teams to contain and remediate incidents, improve detection rules, and enhance overall security posture. The SOC team member will also contribute to continuous improvement by updating playbooks, participating in post\-incident reviews, and staying current with emerging threats and security best practices.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Monitor security alerts that are reported by the various security tools and Endpoint
* Detection and Response (EDR) platforms
* Determine the severity and urgency of the alerts and perform initial triage
* Run various scans on workstations and remediate any issue with infections
* Escalate threats to Level 2 or the SOC Manager when necessary
* Review client’s emails to determine their legitimacy to prevent phishing or malicious from being released to the end user
* Determine if changes to email filter settings are required in end user profiles to reduce false positives
* Document incidents and remediation steps taken during the triage process
* Isolate endpoints and block IPs that are potential risks
* Control conditional access policies to block security risks such as impossible travel
* Manage country blocking rules to allow users access when traveling



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience: 2\-4 years of experience in IT security operations, with a strong emphasis on SOC operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science
* Basic understanding of networking and cybersecurity principles
* Experience with monitoring and initial incident triage processes.
* Experience with modern aiSIEM and event aggregation tools, such as CrowdStrike, Splunk, Arctic Wolf, AlienVault, or Seceon
* Firm understanding of the capabilities of the email and web filtering platforms that are utilized in client environments
* Familiarity with TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs, and reviewing logs
* Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
* Excellent communication skills for incident reporting
* Ability to explain the necessary steps taken to the end users when taking measures to protect their environment
* Willingness to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as SOC
 
 operations
 
 are 24x7x365\.



  





**MSP Tools Familiarity** 



* ConnectWise Manage
* ConnectWise RMM
* IT Glue – Documentation



  





**Behavioral Skills** 




 • Longevity and commitment in previous work
 



 • Team player.
 



 • Ability to meet target under pressure and time bound deadlines.
 



 • Dynamic and pleasing attitude and personality.
 



  





**Benefits** 




 • Competitive salary and benefits
 



 • Great work\-life balance
 



 • Comprehensive on\-job training, best\-in\-industry communications training, and sponsorship for skill development.

title: Security Engineer, AWS Security Incident Response
description:
**Description**
 AWS Security Incident Response is looking for technical Security Engineers that are passionate about learning new concepts and work well within a team environment to keep customers secure. We value engineers that can work through ambiguity to identify suspicious activity, lead security response, and can explain technical security concepts to non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 AWS Services provides developers and small to large businesses access to the horizontally scalable state of the art cloud infrastructure like S3, EC2, AMI, Cloud Front and Simple DB, that powers Amazon.com. Developers can build any type of business on AWS Platform and scale their application with growing business needs. We want you to help share and shape our mission to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Our evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of invention that is part of our DNA. We do every day by inventing elegant and simple solutions to complex technical and business problems. We're making history and the good news is that we've only just begun.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Respond to threat findings that indicate unauthorized activity has occurred
* Identify, evaluate and communicate security threats, risks and vulnerabilities, and propose recommended remediation for security issues.
* Contribute to the development of security automation and security posture improvements.
* Track and report on the effectiveness of AWS detective controls such as Amazon GuardDuty and partner products such as CrowdStrike Falcon or Wiz Defend
* Develop processes and policies to increase security response effectiveness.
* On\-call support: This role requires periodic on\-call responsibilities including weekends.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Security Engineer in AWS Security Incident Response, your responsibilities include monitoring networks and systems for potential threats, performing triage for security alerts, documenting suspicious activity, and reporting issues so they can be adequately handled. You will work alongside our security engineers and partner teams to perform daily threat detection and incident response, using the full capability of AWS technologies and services to detect and mitigate cyber threats at a massive scale and help protect AWS Customers. You should also enjoy learning about the most up\-to\-date new technologies and procedures to protect information systems and data.
   

  

**About The Team**
 AWS Security Incident Response provides 24/7 threat monitoring, investigation, and response across for customer’s AWS environments. The service enhances existing security capabilities by providing security monitoring for all native AWS services and supports vendor agnostic detective and protective controls to provide holistic security controls for customers. This is done by leveraging data on common attack techniques to enhance detective controls and incident response, then building auto\-remediation capabilities to minimize disruption to customer workloads. When a security event does happen, you will be there provide guidance.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

* 2\+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non\-internship) experience
* 2\+ years of troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non\-internship) experience

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations**

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support**

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.

We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Education**:

title: Network Engineer I, Just Walk Out Tech
description:
**Description**
 As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 Amazon Physical Stores is a store with no lines and no checkout, you just grab and go! Customers use the Amazon Physical Stores app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go! Check it out at amazon.com/go.
   

  

 Our approach to problems is entrepreneurial. You will be challenged to invent, create and solve challenging problems as well as wear many hats and collaborate in an environment that's more startup than big company. You will need a strong ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues.
   

  

 As a Network Support Engineer, you seek resolution to Networking problems and mitigate risk, always ensuring a Customer Obsessed experience has occurred. You will be working on services with a direct impact on the customer experience. If you are excited about the opportunity to learn and work on networks, distributed systems, enjoy trouble shooting and solving complex problems, consider the opportunities to work with Amazon Physical Stores and the Just Walk Out Technology.
   

  

 You will help solve a variety of challenges and offer your expertise in growing the knowledge of your peers via team collaboration. We consistently whiteboard so be comfortable writing and supporting your ideas on the team board. You will play an active role in defining the support processes for technologies in partnership with other technology leaders within and possibly outside the team. You should be comfortable with a level of ambiguity that's higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving big challenges. You will also mentor other engineers in your area of expertise. Along the way, we guarantee that you'll work hard, have fun and impact many customers.
   

  

 This role requires the flexibility to work 5 days a week in a rotational shift (Morning, Afternoon and Night shift).
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Monitor and triage automated network alarms (BGP, heartbeat, LTE, WAN, temperature, switch failures) across retail stores.
   

  

 Execute established runbooks for incident resolution including device power\- cycling via PDU/SNMP, LTE modem reboots, BGP peer troubleshooting, and switch recovery.
   

  

 Execute network bring\-up tasks for new JWO store launches: WAN monitoring and configuration,
   

  

 and WAN sharing setup. Provision network devices (switches, routers, APs, LTE gateways) and validate device provisioning.
   

  

 Configure and validate VLAN assignments, IP addressing, and routing for new store deployments.
   

  

 Coordinate field services teams for store deployment.
   

  

 Open and track trouble tickets with LTE carriers for signal issues, SIM replacements, and antenna concerns.
   

  

 Coordinate with ISPs for WAN circuit troubleshooting.
   

  

 Manage hardware replacement workflows for routers, switches, LTE devices, UPS/PDU, and access points through EFS dispatch.
   

  

 Partner with engineering team for escalations.
   

  

 Provide network support for store decommissions and retrofits. Participate in 24/7 on\-call rotation for network operations
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 As a Network Engineer on CRT, you execute capacity restoration workflows across Amazon’s global network. You troubleshoot link and device failures. You coordinate with cross\-functional teams. You drive TTR down for out\-of\-service capacity. This role is focused on operational execution using existing tools and processes. You work at the component level, solving straightforward problems with guidance from your team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Execute link restoration workflows for Regional Border and Backbone spans.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software failures on network devices.
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on repairs.
* Monitor capacity health using operational event monitoring systems, network health monitoring systems, and workflow orchestration engines.
* Perform device health checks and link tests to validate restoration.
* Maintain accurate records of restoration progress, backlog status, and TTR metrics.
* Identify patterns in recurring failures and escalate to engineering teams.
* Contribute to operational runbooks and process documentation.
* Participate in on\-call rotations for follow\-the\-sun coverage.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Monitor capacity health dashboards and respond to out\-of\-service alerts
* Troubleshoot hardware/software failures on backbone and border network devices
* Execute restoration workflows using established automation and runbooks
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on link repairs
* Document incidents and contribute to post\-event reviews
* Participate in on\-call rotations supporting high severity calls and operational events.


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end\-to\-end restoration of out\-of\-service inter\-metro and intra\-metro network capacity.
   

  

 CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time\-to\-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
   

  

 We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow\-the\-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.

description:
**About the opportunity**  
Srileo Technologies, a Coimbatore\-based software company, is expanding its reach across the city and nearby towns through independent Client Partners. We are looking for well\-connected, self\-driven individuals to introduce our business solution to local businesses. Full details of the product are shared with shortlisted partners.

This is **not** a salaried job. There is **no fixed pay, no attendance, no fixed hours, and no employment relationship.**You work as an independent referral partner under a simple one\-page agreement, at your own pace, and are paid purely on results.

**How you earn**

* A **fixed commission for every client you bring who registers** for our service.

**What you do**

* Introduce our solution to local businesses in your network and area.

* People who **already have connections with local business owners and managers** in Coimbatore.
* Self\-motivated individuals who prefer earning by results over a fixed salary.
* Anyone comfortable making warm introductions and following up. Freshers with strong local connections are welcome.

**What we provide**

* Simple materials and a live product the client can try directly, so you never have to pitch or explain technical details.
* A clear referral agreement and prompt commission payouts.
* Full briefing and support from our team.

**Not for you if**

* You need a monthly salary or fixed working hours.

**How to apply**

*Srileo welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.*

* Flexible schedule
